Leveraging advanced analytics, forecasting models, and data-driven insights, you will help improve forecast accuracy while supporting our broader supply chain transformation agenda.

You Will

  • Own and continuously improve the statistical forecast for your portfolio by reviewing system-generated outputs, resolving exceptions, and collaborating closely with OpCo teams, CoE, and external partners to ensure accuracy and reliability across the full planning horizon
  • Build trust and adoption of statistical forecasts by clearly communicating insights to OpCo stakeholders and minimizing unnecessary overrides
  • Leverage data-driven insights to strengthen forecasting accuracy and efficiency within Infor Demand Forecasting tool.
  • Identify demand drivers and explore external data sources that can enhance forecasting quality and business insights.
  • Own and continuously refine segmentation and forecasting models to ensure the right methods are applied, enabling accurate and responsive forecasts aligned with evolving business needs and demand patterns
  • Safeguard forecasting reliability by ensuring data integrity, proactively addressing outliers, and maintaining high-quality master data through structured collaboration with OpCo stakeholders
  • Develop and maintain performance reporting, tracking KPIs such as Forecast Accuracy, Bias and Forecast Value Add across multiple levels and time horizons
  • Accelerate forecasting excellence by driving continuous improvement, translating insights into action, and empowering business users through targeted training and clear, impactful guidance

What You'll Bring

We're looking for someone who is responsible, accountable, and ready to Own this role. Someone who enjoys working with data, thrives in a continuously evolving environment, and is motivated by the opportunity to build something new.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field
  • 3+ years of experience in forecasting, demand planning, or statistical modelling (preferably in complex, high-SKU environments)
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and identify patterns, drivers, and variability
  • Experience with statistical forecasting tools and data-driven planning solutions
  • Experience working with ERP or Advanced Planning Systems
  • Ability to translate complex analyses into clear, actionable insights for business stakeholders
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data accuracy
  • Passion for building and contributing to a global Center of Excellence and enabling others to succeed
  • Fluent in English

Nice-to-Have

  • Master’s degree in a quantitative or business discipline
  • Experience in demand sensing and machine learning applications in forecasting
  • Familiarity with Forecast Value Add (FVA) frameworks and KPI-based performance management
  • Experience with Infor Demand Forecasting or similar advance forecasting tool
  • Understanding of Lean, Six Sigma, or structured problem-solving methodologies (e.g., root cause analysis, 5 Whys)
  • Knowledge of demand drivers and market dynamics within the animal nutrition/feed industry
  • Relevant certifications (preferred), such as: IBF CPF, ACPF

Why Join Us?

As part of Nutreco, you'll be a member of the SHV family, a diverse group of companies with a global footprint. Join us and you'll gain access to a wide network of experts, meaningful career opportunities, and the backing of one of the world's largest privately owned businesses, known for its stability and long-term vision.

In addition, you’ll receive 

  • A competitive package with 30 vacation days and a solid pension scheme. 
  • Flexible work environment (hybrid) 
  • Access to learning (incl. internal training and e‑learning), peer communities, and opportunities across Nutreco and SHV. 
  • An inclusive culture where you’ll be encouraged to Own it: your ideas, your development, and your impact. 

How And Why To Find Out More 

We can offer you a career with real meaning and impact. If you’re ready to shape how teams embrace new ways of working and bring digital transformation to life, then get ready to Own your leadership, your influence and your next step. #OwnIt

Title: Air and Missile Defense Data Visualization Analyst
Description:
Job Number: R0246839

Air and Missile Defense Data Visualization Analyst

The Opportunity:

As a client-facing Data Visualization Analyst on our team, you’ll work closely with our Integrated Air and Missile defense customers across the joint force, planners, analysts, and mission partners to understand their questions and needs, then dig into data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deeper understanding of their data, but you’ll also advise the client on what the information means and how it can be used to improve planning, assessment, partner engagement, and senior leader decision-making. Through gaining efficiency and accuracy, this position will enable leaders within the Joint Integrated Air and Missile Defense community better understand and display trends, gaps, risks, and opportunities across U.S., Allied, partner nation programs and operational activities.

How You’ll Contribute:


Use your data analytics expertise to support client and stakeholder relationships with respect to Integrated Air and Missile Defense (IAMD).
Research, develop, and test data methodologies, and generate cross-functional solutions through collection, cleaning, interpretation, evaluation, integration, and analysis of operational and assessment data.
Contribute to impactful work and guide rapid decision-making across IAMD planners, assessment analysts, operational environment analysts, and senior stakeholders.
Collaborate with Service components to institute common operational pictures to provide real-time data-driven information to enable customers to make rapid assessments and accelerate decision-making cycles.
Apply communication skills and data analytics expertise by simplifying technical requirements, data trends, and analytical findings based on audience.
Present data findings and recommendations to clients and stakeholders using your knowledge of databases, Maven, scripting languages such as SQL, Python, or R, visualization tools, and Microsoft Office Suite.
Apply data visualization through formats including, but not limited to Maven, dashboards, graphs, tables, trackers, maps, and PowerPoint.
Grow your communication and technical skills by creating data-centric solutions across the Integrated Air and Missile defense enterprise in the US European Command Area of responsibility through campaign assessments, Allied and partner nation engagements, and operational planning missions.



Work with us to drive large-scale decisions through data insights, specializing in IAMD information.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have: 


3+ years of experience in application development, AI and ML engineering, software engineering, or data science
3+ years of experience designing, developing, operationalizing, and maintaining complex software or machine learning applications at enterprise scale
1+ years of experience creating software for retrieving, parsing, and processing structured and unstructured data to support machine learning workflows
1+ years of experience with building scalable data pipelines, ETL and ELT workflows, or model training and deployment pipelines
Experience creating solutions within a collaborative and cross-functional team environment
Ability to code and develop scalable solutions from scratch using languages such as Python or TypeScript
Ability to navigate ambiguity, problem-solve creatively, and operate with minimal supervision
Ability to develop scripts and programs for converting various types of data into usable formats and support project teams to scale, monitor, and operate AI/ML platforms
TS/SCI clearance
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or Mathematics and 3+ years of experience in a professional work environment, or 7+ years of experience in a professional work environment in lieu of a degree



Nice If You Have: 


Experience with Palantir tools, such as Foundry
Experience with Full-Stack application development for deploying ML models
Experience with distributed data or computing tools, including Databricks
Experience working on real-time data, streaming applications, or AI model deployment
Knowledge of U.S. Joint Force Integrated Air and Missile Defense (IAMD) or Ballistic Missile Defense (BMD) combat systems, data architectures, Command and Control, and IAMD information concepts



Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required.

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Description:
Techtronic Industries (TTI) is a world leader in cordless technology spanning power tools, accessories, hand tools, outdoor power equipment, as well as floorcare & cleaning products. Our focus is on end-users that range from professionals in the industrial, construction and infrastructure sectors to DIYers in home improvement, repair, and maintenance. TTI’s powerful brand portfolio includes MILWAUKEE®, RYOBI®, AEG® - recognized worldwide for their deep heritage and innovative product platforms of superior quality.

The company maintains a global manufacturing and product development footprint, with record world-wide sales of approximately US$15.2 billion and around 50,000 employees in 2026. Hiring exceptional people is a top focus at TTI. This drives a high-performance culture across all levels of our organization and helps to achieve our vision of being number one in the industries we serve. Our unique high-speed decision-making process supports our acute focus on developing superior products and meeting high customer expectations. We view our winning culture as a competitive advantage that powers our growth.

Key Responsibilities:


Collaborate with business stakeholders and leadership to gather requirements, develop, and support data modelling and BI solutions for organizational stakeholders
Integrate different data sources into a cohesive data fabric, ensuring data consistency, accuracy and reliability
Conduct business analysis activities to understand business user requirements and translate data and information flows within business processes
Analyze sustainability, quality & regulatory data to identify trends, patterns and areas for improvement
Provide insights and recommendations based on data analysis to support informed decision-making in sustainability initiatives
Perform data profiling, validation and cleaning to ensure accuracy, completeness, and quality of enterprise data
Maintain data quality standards and enforce data governance policies, standards and best practices
Maintain clear documentation for data orchestrations, highlighting their value and contribution to improved data modeling and governance


Requirements:


Bachelor's or similar degree in Data Science, Environmental Science, Sustainability Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
Proven experience with Power BI, Power Automate, VBA, C++ programming, Python, and SAP QuickViewer
Good communication skills in German and English, both written and spoken
Knowledge of Qlik Sense and IBM Envizi is considered an advantage
Relevant experience in data analysis, reporting, and data visualization

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Global Dimensions is currently seeking a Data Scientist for a position in Stuttgart, Germany, to support mission-critical data analysis and intelligence requirements.

Essential Job Functions:

Perform data cleaning, preprocessing, integration, and quality assurance to ensure data accuracy and usability.

Conduct data analysis and prepare datasets for visualization and reporting.

Develop dashboards and complex data visualizations using tools such as Tableau and Power BI.

Perform routine data quality checks and identify data inconsistencies or anomalies.

Apply statistical methods, hypothesis testing, and machine learning techniques to support analytical requirements.

Apply AI/ML models to analyze structured and unstructured data.

Utilize Activity-Based Intelligence (ABI) tools and tradecraft to support mission requirements.

Communicate analytical findings and technical information clearly to stakeholders.

Required Skills:

Due to the sensitivity of customer related requirements, U.S. Citizenship is required.

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Data Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Science, or a related field from an accredited institution; or

Minimum 7 years of data science support experience, with a portion of the experience occurring within the last two years.

Experience with Python and automated methodologies.

Knowledge and experience with hypothesis testing, statistical analysis, machine learning, and training solutions.

Knowledge of communication tradecraft techniques.

Experience utilizing ABI tools and tradecraft.

Experience with data preprocessing, integration, quality assurance, and visualization.

Desired Skills:

Previous Intelligence Community (IC) experience.

Experience developing dashboards using Tableau and/or Power BI.

Experience applying AI/ML techniques to unstructured data analysis.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Data Engineer bei audit.neo GmbH

Anforderungen

Bitte beachte, dass für diese Stelle eine Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland erforderlich ist.

Sprache: Deutsch - Verhandlungssicher (C2)

Must-have:


Interesse an Datentransformation und Datenaufbereitung (z. B. mit Python, KNIME oder BI-Tools)
Freude daran, pragmatische Lösungen für reale Datenprobleme zu entwickeln
Strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ein gutes Verständnis für Datenqualität und Datenlogik


Nice to have:


Kenntnisse in der Wirtschaftsprüfung oder einem verwandten Umfeld
Programmierkenntnisse in Python


Tätigkeiten


Rohdaten in saubere, strukturierte Zielsysteme überführen – von der Analyse der Datenstruktur bis zur fertigen Transformation.
Datenaufbereitungs- und Verarbeitungsprozesse automatisieren und so manuelle Aufwände dauerhaft reduzieren.
Tools und Skripte zur effizienten Datenbearbeitung entwickeln und kontinuierlich verbessern.
Datenflüsse qualitätssichern und optimieren – mit Blick auf Korrektheit, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Performance.
Im direkten Austausch mit Kunden deren Fragen und Anforderungen aufnehmen und in konkrete Datenlösungen übersetzen.


Unser Tech-Stack: KNIME


Python
SQL
Cloud-Infrastruktur (Azure)
Git
BI-Tools
Automatisierung


Team

Wir sind ein kleines, eingespieltes Data-Team – mit kurzen Wegen, direkter Kommunikation und ohne unnötige Prozesse. Die Rolle ist bei uns keine Randrolle: Du arbeitest produktnah, bringst dich in technische Entscheidungen ein und hast direkten Einfluss darauf, wie unsere Datenflüsse und -prozesse wachsen. Datenpipelines werden gemeinsam gedacht, Lösungen end-to-end entwickelt und zusammen live gebracht.

Das Team sitzt in Stuttgart und arbeitet hybrid. Wie oft du ins Büro kommst, stimmen wir individuell ab – alles zwischen einmal pro Woche und einmal im Monat ist möglich.

Über das Unternehmen

audit.neo entwickelt die All-in-One-Plattform für Wirtschaftsprüfer. Unsere Software bildet den gesamten Prüfungsprozess digital ab – von Auftragsannahme und Risikoanalyse über Datenanalyse und Dokumentation bis zum fertigen Prüfungsbericht. Alles in einem System, ohne Medienbruch.

Was wir bauen

Wirtschaftsprüfung ist hochreguliert, datenintensiv und technisch anspruchsvoller, als viele denken. Unsere Plattform verarbeitet große Datenmengen aus ERP-Systemen, erkennt Auffälligkeiten mit KI und führt Prüfungsteams durch komplexe, mehrstufige Workflows.

Warum audit.neo?

Wir sind ein kleines Team mit hoher Geschwindigkeit und viel Verantwortung. Wer bei uns arbeitet, sieht die eigene Arbeit direkt im Produkt – und das Produkt direkt beim Kunden.

Kurze Entscheidungswege, wenig Overhead, keine Buzzword-Architektur – dafür echter Produktfokus und technische Herausforderungen mit unmittelbarem Impact.

Klicke auf "Bewerben" für Details zu den Benefits, dem Team und dem Bewerbungsprozess.

Title: Data Management Specialist (m/w/d)
Description:
Standort: Satteldorf, Göppingen

Ihre Aufgaben

Sie arbeiten an der operativen Umsetzung von Data-Governance- und Datenmanagement-Aktivitäten im Unternehmen mit
Sie unterstützen den Datenarchitekten bei der Umsetzung der Datenstrategie und der Weiterentwicklung der Datenarchitektur und führen Workshops und Schulungen durch
Sie arbeiten mit den Fachbereichen zur Inventarisierung, Beschreibung und Dokumentation von Datenbeständen zusammen und pflegen den unternehmensweiten Datenkatalog
Sie erstellen und pflegen konzeptionelle sowie logische Datenmodelle und analysieren Datenstrukturen und Datenflüsse in Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen und der IT
Sie identifizieren, analysieren und dokumentieren Datenqualitätsprobleme, initiieren Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Datenqualität und entwickeln Data-Governance-Prozesse weiter


Ihr Profil

Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
Erfahrung im Datenmanagement, in Data Governance oder im Business Intelligence-Umfeld sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Datenprozesse und Datenqualitätsmanagement
Grundkenntnisse in der Datenmodellierung, z. B. in ER-Modellen und relationalen Modellen sowie idealerweise Erfahrung mit Datenkatalogen oder Metadatenmanagement-Tools
Erste Kenntnisse in SQL und Datenanalyse sowie eine hohe Affinität zu Daten, Strukturen und Prozessen
Analytisches Denkvermögen, eine strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit


Unser Angebot

Bessere Work-Life-Balance durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit in Kombination mit Arbeitszeitkonto +/- 40 Stunden. Mobiles Arbeiten möglich
Verpflegungsmöglichkeiten, z. B. Casino, Essensgutscheine
Übertarifliche Leistungen z. B. 13. Monatseinkommen, Auslösung 45,00 €, Verpflegungszuschuss 8,00 € - 15,00 €
Ergebnisbeteiligung bzw. Prämie und zusätzliches Urlaubsgeld
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten durch unsere LEONHARD WEISS-Akademie
Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement
Flexible und innovative Arbeitsplätze mit modernster Technik
Vielfältige Mitarbeiterrabatte und Fitnesskooperationen z. B. Hansefit, Wellpass
Firmenevents wie z. B. Ausflüge, Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier
Flexibles Zeitwertkonto für Ihre Work-Life-Balance
JobRad mit attraktiven Konditionen

Title: Consultant Digital Analytics (all genders)
Description:
Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE


Analytics-Konzeption: Entwickle Analytics-Strategien und konzipiere individuelle Lösungen für komplexe Herausforderungen in Web- und App-Projekten.
Implementierung: Implementiere Analytics-Tools und richte Tag-Management-, Tracking- und Consent-Management-Systeme für unsere Kunden ein.
Reporting & Dashboards: Erstelle Berichte und interaktive Dashboards, visualisiere Ergebnisse und interpretiere diese gemeinsam mit internen Teams im Online Marketing.
Compliance & Prozesse: Optimiere Prozesse und unterstütze unsere Kunden dabei, technische und rechtliche Anforderungen wie die Cookie-Compliance einzuhalten.
Wissensvermittlung: Vermittle Wissen, indem du interne und externe Schulungen zu Analytics-Themen durchführst.
Strategische Beratung: Berate Kunden und begleite sie beim strategischen Ausbau ihres Trackings.


DEIN PROFIL


Analytics- und Tracking-Systeme: Durch deine mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (mind. 3 Jahre) kennst du bereits Tools wie Piwik PRO, Matomo oder Google Analytics und bist mit Tag-Management- und Dashboard-Systemen vertraut. Aber auch Consent Management Plattformen sind dir nicht unbekannt und du verstehst die Funktion von Cookie Bannern auf Webseiten und in Mobile Apps.
Online-Marketing Expertise: Insbesondere datengetriebene Kampagnen gehören zu deinem Fachwissen.
Technisches Verständnis: Du bringst fundiertes Know-how in Webtechnologien und Programmiersprachen wie HTML, CSS und JavaScript mit.
Kenntnisse zur strategischen Analytics-Beratung: Idealerweise bringst du erste Erfahrung mit ganzheitlichen Datenstrategien für Unternehmen mit und bist begeisterungsfähig für technologische Entwicklungen und Trends im Analytics-Bereich.
Kommunikationsstärke: Du bist vertriebsorientiert und begeisterst andere für das Thema Digital Marketing.
KI Kompetenz: Du setzt KI-Tools in deinem Fachgebiet souverän ein, bewertest die Ergebnisse kritisch und unterstützt Kunden und adessi dabei, Potenziale von KI zu nutzen.
Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation.


Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

Title: Analytics Engineer

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What We're Looking For

We’re looking for an Analytics Engineer with a background in Data Engineering or Analytics Engineering who operates as a true full-stack analyst, owning everything from raw data to insights to operationalization.

You bring:


Strong SQL and analytical data modeling skills (ideally dbt or SQLMesh).
Experience with ELT/ETL workflows and cloud warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks).
Comfort with Python for automation and light data engineering.
Experience with dashboards, BI tools, and self-serve analytics.
Clear communication, collaboration, and comfort working in ambiguity.
Nice to have: experience with AI/LLM products, instrumentation, experimentation, or early-stage startups.


What You'll Do


Partner with Sales and CS on data and reporting needs. Translate ambiguous business questions into structured data models, analysis and actionable insights, and data-fueled products.
Build and maintain data warehouse models that serve as the source of truth for product usage and GTM metrics.
Model CRM data, usage data, and billing data to power Sales and CS automation, CRM enrichment, lead definition and creation, and GTM tooling.
Design metrics, dashboards, and data UIs in Hex and Lovable for GTM leadership and teams to access and operationalize data.
Partner with Product and Engineering on event instrumentation and schema design.
Improve documentation, observability, governance, and data best practices.
Contribute to forecasting models, KPI definitions, and experimentation frameworks.
Own and improve data pipelines, ingestion workflows, and data quality testing.


You’ll thrive here if you


Enjoy building clean, reliable, reusable data models.
Have experience partnering closely with cross-functional GTM teams to solve real problems with data.
Prefer simplicity over complexity in data and tooling design.
Communicate clearly and proactively with technical and non-technical teams.
Take ownership, move quickly, and iterate often.
Want to help define and scale Lovable’s data foundations and culture.
Care about the rep experience and view analytics as a product.


How We Hire


Fill in a short form then jump on an initial exploratory call.
Discuss your experience in more depth during a round of interviews with us.


About Your Application


Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal.

Title: Data Analyst - Team Intelligence
Description:
At Voyado, hundreds of retailers rely on dashboards, exports and shared analytics experiences to understand their business and make decisions. Behind every metric, dashboard and export sits a series of product decisions: what should be measured, how it should be defined, and how it should work consistently across customers, markets and products.

We’re now looking for Data Analysts to join Team Intelligence in Stockholm and help shape the analytics products our customers will rely on for years to come.

About The Role

As a Data Analyst in Team Intelligence, you will work with analytics products that scale across Voyado’s product portfolio. You will help harmonise how data, KPIs and analytics surfaces work across products such as dashboards, BI Export and DeltaShare.

Your focus will be on building analytics experiences that are accurate, consistent and useful for many customers — not creating one-off reports for individual stakeholders.

You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Analytics Engineers and domain teams to understand customer needs, investigate data discrepancies, define shared metrics and contribute to the broader product roadmap for analytics across Voyado.

Who you are

You have a product mindset and see dashboards, metrics and analytics experiences as products that need ownership and continuous improvement. You’re comfortable working closely with Product Managers, engineers and other stakeholders, and you enjoy creating clarity where definitions, data or expectations differ.

You’re curious, analytical and enjoy understanding how data works beneath the surface. When numbers don’t add up, you want to find out why.

Most importantly, you care about building analytics that people can trust. We'd love to see that you also have:


Experience working as a Data Analyst, BI Analyst or in a similar analytics-focused role.
Strong SQL skills.
Experience with BI tools such as Sigma, Looker, Tableau, Power BI or similar.
Experience owning dashboards, reports or data products over time.
Ability to translate business and customer questions into clear data requirements.
Strong communication skills and experience working with multiple stakeholders.


High Impact. Great People. Real Growth.

You’ll join a company with strong momentum, modern technology, and a collaborative culture where ideas and initiatives are encouraged.

At Voyado, we care about creating an environment where people can grow, collaborate, and enjoy the journey together. We move quickly, challenge ideas, and work closely across teams to deliver meaningful impact.

Some of our benefits:


30 days of vacation
Wellness allowance
Personal development opportunities
Summits and team activities


Four days from the office and one day from home

About Voyado

Voyado is the Agentic Customer Experience Suite for retail.

More than 500 retail brands across 100 markets use Voyado to unite CRM, loyalty, product discovery, e-commerce personalization, and retail media with retail-trained AI that acts on real-time shopper intent.

By combining customer data with product intelligence, Voyado helps retailers deliver more relevant experiences across every channel — online and in-store. The result is more traffic, higher conversions, stronger customer relationships, and measurable business impact.

We’re growing across Europe and are looking for people who want to help shape the future of retail technology.

Ready to make an impact?

Fantastic! 🎉

A quick note about our recruitment timeline: As many of us will be taking some well-deserved summer vacation, this process will move a bit slower than usual.

We’d still love to hear from you as soon as possible!

Thank you for your understanding, and we hope you’ll apply! 🌞

Additional information

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct a background check on the final candidate.

Making it personal with AI

We believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself, with support from AI where it makes sense. Later in the process, you may even be expected to use AI. At the end of the day, what matters is meeting you — the person behind the application.

There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human, so please bring your authentic self. Don’t let AI over-polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice, because that’s what we care about most.

In today’s hyper-competitive market, we help over 500 retail brands across 100 markets attract, convert, and retain loyal customers.

With AI-driven CRM, loyalty, e-commerce personalization, and retail media, Voyado turns every interaction - online or in-store - into lasting growth.

By combining customer data with product intelligence, we empower retailers to deliver the right message, product, or offer at exactly the right time. The result? Stronger customer relationships and measurable business impact.

Title: Data Specialist
Description:
We are Posti, a versatile, modern, and international logistics expert with 400 years of experience. Today, we connect people and businesses by delivering information, emotions, and goods with the help of 13,000 experts across the Nordics and Baltics. We make everyday life easier for you, businesses, and society while building a more sustainable future for us all.

Är du noggrann och trivs med att arbeta i olika projekt? Har du stark samarbetsförmåga? Är du duktig på att omvandla verksamhetsbehov till flexibla tekniska tjänster? Arbetar du obehindrat i en internationell leverantörsmiljö och vet hur man framgångsrikt leder outsourcade tjänster?

Då borde du söka rollen som Data Specialist och ansluta till vårt mycket kompetenta och lösningsfokuserade team inom Business Data & Insights (BDI).

Vårt BDI-team är en central del av affärsenheten Fulfillment and Logistics Services (FLS), som verkar i Finland, Sverige och Norge. Som ett multinationellt team spelar vi en nyckelroll i att utveckla lagerverksamheten och driva digitaliseringsinitiativ. I denna roll får du möjlighet att bidra i engagerande projekt och arbeta med mycket varierande och omfattande datamängder. Vi är engagerade i din professionella utveckling genom kontinuerliga lärandemöjligheter, inklusive utbildningar, kurser och branschcertifieringar.

Din Profil


Relevant högskole- eller universitetsutbildning (ekonomi, industriell ekonomi, business intelligence)
Erfarenhet av SQL och Power BI
Viss erfarenhet av versionshantering (GitHub)
Starka kvantitativa, analytiska och problemlösande färdigheter
Förmåga att ta initiativ och vara innovativ
God kommunikativ förmåga i tal och skrift på engelska och svenska
Intresse för logistik och materialflöden


Meriterande


Kunskap om Python och Spark
Erfarenhet av Confluence och JIRA


Du kommer att ansvara för att stödja och samarbeta med operativa och affärsinriktade kollegor, samla in och tolka krav samt översätta verksamhetens behov till robusta datatjänster. Med din kompetens inom data och programmering kommer du att designa och implementera effektiva datalösningar. I rollen som data specialist kommer du att samla in data från flera källor, säkerställa datakvalitet och integritet samt förbereda data för användning i verksamheten.

Du arbetar nära kollegor med olika professionella bakgrunder, vilket gör att god samarbets- och kommunikationsförmåga är avgörande. Vi söker en öppen och nyfiken person som tar initiativ, bidrar med nya perspektiv och vidareutvecklar befintliga lösningar. Du bör trivas med att arbeta med olika teknologier och vara flexibel i en dynamisk och föränderlig miljö. Vårt team består av både data specialists och data scientists, vilket ger möjlighet att arbeta i spännande och affärskritiska projekt. Du kommer även att samarbeta nära med IT-avdelningen och externa konsulter i en integrerad och framåtblickande arbetsmiljö.

Placering

Stockholm eller Jönköping

Skicka in din ansökan (Vi ser gärna att CV/Personligt brev är på engelska ) inklusive löneanspråk, senast den 16/8 via Postis rekryteringssystem Workday.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Join our highly skilled team of engineers, designers and product managers — breaking new ground and shaping the future of retail.




We dare to dream big, we have the courage to keep raising the bar, and we’re committed to being a force for good in retail - helping both established and fast-growing brands meet the ever-changing expectations of their customers.




Sitoo is a fast-growing technology company exploring how far we can take innovation to deliver the world’s best Unified Commerce Platform and Point of Sale. Our technology is used in more than 20 countries - a number that keeps growing thanks to our incredible teams in Engineering & Product. And we have no intention of slowing down. Are you the Data Analyst we’re looking for?




*This is a position for candidates with a permanent residency in Sweden*




Your mission at Sitoo




As a Data Analyst at Sitoo, you will be a foundational member of the Data & Analytics team, responsible for turning data into trusted insights that guide product, commercial, and operational decisions across the company.




This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you will help shape how Sitoo defines success, measures performance, and uses data in everyday decision-making. You’ll work closely with Product, Commercial, Operations, and Engineering to make data clear, actionable, and decision-ready. If you enjoy ownership, close collaboration with stakeholders, and seeing your insights directly influence how a company builds, operates, and grows, this role is for you.




What you’ll bring to the table




You are a curious and hands-on Data Analyst who enjoys working close to the business and learning how data drives product and commercial decisions. You like taking ownership of analyses, working from a vaguely defined question to a well-communicated insight, and improving how data is used over time and impacting the business.




You’re comfortable collaborating with Product, Commercial, and Engineering teams and motivated by seeing your work used in real decisions. You value clarity over complexity and are developing your ability to explain insights, assumptions, and limitations to different audiences.




3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Product Data Analyst, or similar role, supporting product, commercial, or operational decisions.
Experience working directly with stakeholders, translating business or product questions into clear analyses, defining metrics and KPIS, and communicating insights and recommendations clearly.
Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring reports in a BI or analytics tool like Metabase, Looker, Power BI, Tableau etc.
Solid working knowledge of SQL, with experience working in modern cloud data warehouses (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Databricks, or similar).
Familiarity with core analytics concepts such as funnels, cohorts, retention, and basic growth metrics.
Basic understanding of experimentation and A/B testing, including metric selection and interpretation of results.




What you'll do




Act as a trusted analytics partner to Product, Engineering and Commercial teams, turning business and product questions into clear analyses and decision-ready insights with measurable business impact. Collaborating closely with data engineer, PM’s and engineers.
Define, develop and standardize core KPIs and metric definitions, helping establish a shared language for growth, retention, engagement, and revenue.
Build and maintain dashboards and insights reports that the organisation and teams rely on to run the business and evaluate product performance.
Perform deep-dive analyses on user behavior, funnels, cohorts, retention, and feature performance to inform prioritization and strategy.
Support experimentation and A/B testing, from hypothesis and success metrics to analysis, learnings, and recommendations.
Work closely with Product and Engineering to improve tracking, event schemas, and data quality, contributing to a scalable analytics foundation.




Why Sitoo




We are forward thinkers. By turning curiosity into knowledge — and knowledge into continuous improvement — we break new ground and shape the future of retail.




We believe in an inclusive culture where everyone feels like they belong. We support each other, win together, celebrate success together, and overcome challenges together.




Today, we are close to 100 dedicated experts with a positive and solution-oriented mindset. Most importantly, we take care of each other, and we never forget to have fun.

  • Experience working directly with stakeholders, translating business or product questions into clear analyses, defining metrics and KPIS, and communicating insights and recommendations clearly.
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring reports in a BI or analytics tool like Metabase, Looker, Power BI, Tableau etc.
  • Solid working knowledge of SQL, with experience working in modern cloud data warehouses (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Databricks, or similar).
  • Familiarity with core analytics concepts such as funnels, cohorts, retention, and basic growth metrics.
  • Basic understanding of experimentation and A/B testing, including metric selection and interpretation of results.


What you'll do


  • Act as a trusted analytics partner to Product, Engineering and Commercial teams, turning business and product questions into clear analyses and decision-ready insights with measurable business impact. Collaborating closely with data engineer, PM’s and engineers.
  • Define, develop and standardize core KPIs and metric definitions, helping establish a shared language for growth, retention, engagement, and revenue.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and insights reports that the organisation and teams rely on to run the business and evaluate product performance.
  • Perform deep-dive analyses on user behavior, funnels, cohorts, retention, and feature performance to inform prioritization and strategy.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing, from hypothesis and success metrics to analysis, learnings, and recommendations.
  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to improve tracking, event schemas, and data quality, contributing to a scalable analytics foundation.


Why Sitoo


We are forward thinkers. By turning curiosity into knowledge — and knowledge into continuous improvement — we break new ground and shape the future of retail.


We believe in an inclusive culture where everyone feels like they belong. We support each other, win together, celebrate success together, and overcome challenges together.


Today, we are close to 100 dedicated experts with a positive and solution-oriented mindset. Most importantly, we take care of each other, and we never forget to have fun.

Title: Data Scientist

Our story begins with Shadi Bitar and Ninos Malki, who came to Sweden from Syria as kids and discovered that books could be a bridge - helping them learn the language, understand the culture, and explore new worlds.

A thought emerged, what if everyone could have that? And just like that, Nextory was born - your all-access pass to read, listen, and discover new perspectives without limits.

And now, we're on a quest to find a Data Scientist.

Let Us Tell You About The Role 📖

As a Data Scientist at Nextory, you will be part of our centralized data team, supporting our Business value stream with an analytical mindset and tech-savvy approach to drive sustainable subscriber growth. You will work closely with stakeholders across Business, Marketing, and Product to create data-driven insights and models that improve decision-making and business performance.

Some examples of what you might be spending your time on:


Owning projections and forecasts related to activations and new paying subscribers
Supporting budgeting, forecasting, and ad hoc business analysis with actionable insights
Building and improving Nextory’s central data capabilities and ways of working
Supporting the Performance Marketing team with MMM, attribution models, and other analytical frameworks to improve marketing efficiency
Drive data-informed growth by analyzing user behavior, optimizing funnels, and running A/B tests to improve acquisition and conversion.
Build dashboards, reporting tools, and measurement frameworks in collaboration with Product and Business to provide clear performance insights and support Nextory’s growth strategy.


The main character we’re looking for 👀

Several years of experience working as a Data Scientist or Data Analyst
Strong knowledge of SQL and Python
Experience working with performance marketing, attribution modeling, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), or related analytical methods

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
TL;DR - We are looking for a data scientist to build Lovable's data and analytics muscle. You'll work cross-functionally across all teams to level up our understanding of users, uncover opportunities and empower everyone with the insights they need for data-driven decision making. Must combine analytical rigor with the ability to turn complex data into winning product bets.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What We’re Looking For


A business-minded data scientist who's excited to level up our analytics efforts: metrics frameworks, behavioral models, and hypothesis testing
Solid technical foundation (SQL, Python, statistical analysis) - comfortable working with data at scale and translating it into insights
Deep curiosity about user behavior and what actually drives growth and retention
Ability to move between exploratory analysis, building behavioral models, hypothesis testing, and strategic recommendations


What You’ll Do


Work closely with growth, product, and marketing to identify key levers in the customer journey
Analyze funnels, cohorts, and user behaviors to surface insights that drive decisions
Build dashboards, alerts, and automated reporting to keep the team informed and aligned
Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, growth tests) to understand, impact and inform strategy
Monitor data quality and collaborate with engineering to maintain reliability
Leverage AI tools and automation to scale your analysis and focus on high-impact questions
Translate data into clear, actionable narratives that drive product and business decisions


Our tech stack

We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:


Frontend: React
Backend: Golang and Rust
Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Many LLM providers
DevOps & Tooling: Github Actions, Grafana, OTEL, , infra-as-code (Terraform)


And always on the lookout for what's next!

How We Hire


Fill in a short form then jump on an initial exploratory call.
Discuss your experience in more depth during a round of interviews with us.
Join us for a workshop lasting 1-2 days remote or onsite. We'll see how you tick and you get to meet the team and explore whether joining Lovable feels right for you.


About Your Application


Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal.

Title: Quantitative Analyst
Description:
Om tjänsten

Myntro söker nu en engagerad kvantitativ analytiker som vill vara med och forma nästa steg i vår utveckling. Du kommer att vara med och utveckla den finansiella infrastrukturen i vårt kreditmarknadsbolag. Tillsammans utvecklar vi de modeller, informationsflöden och processer som krävs för en modern treasuryfunktion och för rapportering till Finansinspektionen. Här får du inte bara analysera data – du är också med och definierar vilken data vi behöver, hur den ska flöda genom organisationen och hur vi skapar rätt beslutsunderlag för verksamheten.

Du blir en del av ett litet team där du kommer att spela en nyckelroll i att analysera och modellera data kopplade till våra finansiella produkter och kommer att arbeta nära våra experter inom risk, affärsutveckling och inköp av portföljer. En viktig del av arbetet innebär att kravställa mot IT där vi håller samman data för redovisning, affärsbeslut och riskbedömning. Det är en roll där du får kombinera analytiskt djup med ett nära samarbete över flera funktioner.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:


Kravställa och samarbeta med IT och verksamheten för att utveckla datalösningar som stödjer treasuryfunktionen och den regulatoriska rapporteringen.
Bidra till utvecklingen av processer och rutiner för datainsamling och analys.
Kontinuerlig uppföljning och hantering av finansiella risker såsom likviditets-, valuta- och ränterisk.
Analysera och utvärdera data för att identifiera trender och mönster i NPL-portföljerna.
Presentera analyser och rekommendationer till ledningen för att stödja strategiska beslut.


Vem söker vi?

Vi tror att du har arbetat några år i en liknande analytisk roll och trivs i miljöer där du får kombinera teknisk problemlösning med affärsförståelse. Du motiveras av att sätta dig in i komplexa frågeställningar och tycker om att hitta smarta lösningar tillsammans med andra.

Du är en person som gärna tar initiativ, ställer frågor och ser möjligheter till förbättring. Du kan förklara avancerade analyser och tekniska resonemang på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt, oavsett mottagare. För att lyckas i rollen ser vi också att du har en stark analytisk förmåga och god erfarenhet av att arbeta med stora datamängder, analysverktyg och programmering. Du uppskattar en miljö där mycket fortfarande byggs upp och där du får vara med och påverka hur lösningarna ska se ut.

Vi ser gärna att du har:


Akademisk examen inom finans, matematik, statistik, ingenjörsvetenskap eller motsvarande.
Flerårig erfarenhet av kvantitativ analys och datamodellering, gärna inom finansiella tjänster.
Goda kunskaper i Python, SQL, C# eller andra relevanta analys- och programmeringsverktyg. Erfarenhet av att arbete i Cloud-miljö och med API-lösningar är meriterande.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med stora datamängder.
God förmåga att kommunicera komplexa analysresultat på ett tydligt sätt.


Vad erbjuder vi dig?

Vi på Myntro vet att våra medarbetare är nyckeln till vår framgång. Vår kultur präglas av omtanke, ansvar och en stark tro på att vi lyckas bäst när vi gör det tillsammans. På vårt kontor i Stockholm välkomnas du till ljusa, moderna lokaler med goda pendlingsmöjligheter och närhet till både kollegor och stadskärnan. Här får du en arbetsmiljö där energi och framåtanda präglar vardagen och där våra centrala värden – collaboration, customer focus, personal accountability och simplicity – är en självklar del av hur vi arbetar tillsammans varje dag.

Intresserad? Varmt välkommen att ansöka!

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med placering i Stockholm i gruppen Capital Management som ansvarar för treasury, kapitalplanering och regulatorisk rapportering. Sista ansökningsdag är 1.9.2026. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

För mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef, Olle Mattsson, Financial Director Investments & Deposits, olle.mattsson@myntro.com.

För mer information om rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen kontakta Azra Semic, Talent Acquisition Specialist: azra.semic@myntro.com.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
Born autonomous. Born electric.

Since 2016, our technology has connected global communities with the things they need – and all without the emissions. We’re made up of experts in multiple fields and that’s how we’ve developed a new way to move goods. This is technology purpose-built for the industry. This is safer, cleaner, and more reliable movement.

We are Einride and this is how we build a better future.

Want to be part of transforming road freight – for good? Einride is showing the world a new way to move, based on the latest digital, electric and autonomous technologies. Through freight capacity as a service, we enable businesses around the world to accelerate towards their sustainability goals.

Founded in 2016, Einride became the first company in the world to deploy a cab-less autonomous electric vehicle on a public road (Sweden, 2019). In 2022, we were the first to successfully operate such a vehicle on a US public road. Today our award-winning technology has been launched across 8 countries (and counting). Our clients are some of the world’s biggest shippers, including Fortune 500 companies. We are also operating Sweden’s largest truck dedicated public charging network and counting.

We are looking for an enthusiastic, creative Analytics Engineer to join our growing Analytics Platform team. As our second hire in this role, you will partner closely with our existing Analytics Engineer, Data Engineers, and Business Analysts to scale our data foundations and elevate our analytics practices.

You won’t just be writing code; you will be a key player in shaping our data architecture, championing data literacy, and empowering the transport industry to go electric through simple, beautiful, and highly effective data solutions.

You Will


Anticipate business needs: Work proactively with stakeholders to not just understand, but predict their future needs in terms of datasets and dashboards.
Scale our data foundations: Design robust data models and build reliable pipelines alongside our engineering teams.
Drive business insights: Define and implement key metrics to assess business performance and enhance our analytics-driven products.
Optimize our stack: Continuously improve our analytics frameworks, BI tools, and data documentation.
Champion data literacy: Educate colleagues across the organization on data modeling and BI tooling to empower them to do their jobs more efficiently.


We Expect You To Have


Passion for high data quality and experience scaling analytics workflows.
Strong skills in SQL, data modeling, and version control (Git).
Proficiency in modern data warehousing and orchestration. Our core stack is BigQuery, dbt, and Dagster - you don't need to be a day-one expert in these exact tools, but you must have solid experience with them or their direct equivalents.
Solid end-to-end development experience with BI tools. We use Looker, but expertise in similar tools (like Tableau or Qlik Sense) is perfectly fine.
A proven ability to thrive in both collaborative team settings and independent work.


Ideally, You Also Bring


Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (we use Terraform).
Experience with a programming language for data analysis (e.g., Python, R).
A strong eye for UI/UX design in dashboards and data visualization.
Solid business acumen, financial literacy, and an understanding of predictive modeling.


This is a full-time position based anywhere in Stockholm or Gothenburg. You will be part of a truly diverse, high performing team with a common passion for sustainability and making things happen in an innovative way. We recommend that you submit your application as soon as possible since selection and interviews are held continually.

At Einride, we are innovators, building solutions the world has never seen before – but urgently needs. That’s why we take action, and it’s why we are always eager to be challenged. We know that our best innovations come from having a diverse mix of people, including those of different experiences, career paths, and walks of life. By coming together and sharing our perspectives openly – by disagreeing, discussing, and committing – we deliver greater impact.

Please note: Our recruitment process includes an online candidate assessment via Alva Labs and a standard background check prior to employment.

  • A strong eye for UI/UX design in dashboards and data visualization.
  • Solid business acumen, financial literacy, and an understanding of predictive modeling.

This is a full-time position based anywhere in Stockholm or Gothenburg. You will be part of a truly diverse, high performing team with a common passion for sustainability and making things happen in an innovative way. We recommend that you submit your application as soon as possible since selection and interviews are held continually.

At Einride, we are innovators, building solutions the world has never seen before – but urgently needs. That’s why we take action, and it’s why we are always eager to be challenged. We know that our best innovations come from having a diverse mix of people, including those of different experiences, career paths, and walks of life. By coming together and sharing our perspectives openly – by disagreeing, discussing, and committing – we deliver greater impact.

Title: Decision Analyst
Description:
About The Role

As a Decision Analyst at Instabee, you’ll play a key role in helping us make smarter, faster decisions across the business. You’ll partner with teams across the company from product, operations, to tech and beyond - to understand challenges, gather insights, and co-create solutions. Whether it’s structuring an ambiguous problem, evaluating new data sources, or communicating a compelling recommendation, you’ll bring clarity and impact. This role is perfect for someone who loves solving problems, is comfortable navigating complexity, and sees data as a powerful tool, not an end in itself.

Some of the things you’ll do


Tackle complex and ambiguous problems by bringing structure and taking clear, decisive action
Translate complex data and information into concise, actionable insights using both qualitative and quantitative methods
Collaborate across diverse teams to co-create smart solutions and drive real change
Communicate insights clearly and confidently to stakeholders at all levels, from junior teams to senior leadership
Continuously explore and integrate new internal and external data sources to strengthen our decision-making foundation
Analyze data from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities
Partner with teams to understand business challenges and build tailored tools or frameworks that improve how we work
Act as a go-to person for analytical support—sharing knowledge, guiding ad-hoc analysis, and elevating decision quality across the company


Your future team

You’ll join a tight-knit team working on Instabee’s most critical challenges. We collaborate across departments, drive clarity in ambiguity, and value real-world impact over theoretical perfection. Curiosity, humility, and a strong drive to make things better are what bring us together.

What We’re Looking For


Bachelor’s degree within engineering, information technology, finance, economics or other relevant field
Experience presenting solutions to senior management
Experience working within a data heavy environment for at least 4 years
Experience working with solving business problems and improving ways of working
Experience driving real impact, leading stakeholders to materialise the change that the insight points to
Experience using AI coding tools
Experience working with data processing tools including Front End visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI, PowerPoint, Google Slides) and generic tools (e.g. SQL, Python, Excel/Google Sheets)


The cherry on top


You bring a strong blend of business and data understanding—and know how to connect the two
You’re curious, always learning, and stay on top of evolving best practices
You care about creating real-world results and know when “good enough” is enough
You’re confident challenging the status quo and backing it up with structured thinking
You communicate clearly and effectively in English—even when things get complex


If this is you, then we can’t wait to meet you!

What You’ll Get

We can promise you that you will be challenged, develop your skills and have the opportunity to work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like change and want to set new processes and ways of working—this is the place for you!

Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we also offer:

🌇 Sky-High Office: Modern and newly renovated with a 360-degree view around Stockholm

🐶 Puppy Friendly: Bring your dog to work—we’ve got a whole floor for our furry friends!

🏓 Fun & Games: Ping pong, shuffleboard, foosball—even a karaoke room!

👶 Parental Pay: Paid leave for six months to spend time with your little one

🎂 Birthday Day Off: Celebrate your birthday with a well-earned break

⏰ Flexible Hours: Hybrid setup and hours that work with your life

Get to know us

In 2022, Instabee was founded after combining Budbee and Instabox - two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries and is on track to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. Always with the consumer at heart.

We’re fast, both in terms of parcel delivery and when it comes to growing our business. So far our journey has taken us from Sweden to the rest of Scandinavia and parts of continental Europe, but we have no plans on stopping anytime soon. As we continue to expand, the complexity of Instabee grows in parallel. With that in mind, we’re now looking for you to help us on the journey ahead.

This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. The result is public information that is handled confidentially. This is mandatory for all recruitment processes at Instabee in Sweden.

Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

Title: Commercial Data Analyst
Description:
At Qred, we’re building the world's best bank for small businesses. Since launching 11 years ago, we’ve grown from startup to profitable fintech scale-up, now generating over 1 billion SEK in annual revenue and supporting 50,000+ entrepreneurs across Northern Europe. We combine smart technology, real data, and human judgment to make financing simple, fast, and fair. With bold growth plans and strong momentum across multiple markets, we’re now looking for a Commercial Data Analyst for the next phase of growth.

About The Role

As our Commercial Data Analyst, you will bridge the gap between commercial execution and financial strategy by reporting directly to the Head of FP&A. You will have end-to-end ownership of our Growth Scorecard, analyzing full-funnel efficiency from granular marketing campaigns to partner channel profitability. This mission critical role empowers you to act as a data-driven accelerator, ensuring our customer acquisition strategy directly scales Customer Lifetime Value.

Key responsibilities


Architect and maintain the core Growth Scorecard to evaluate fully loaded acquisition costs and multi-channel ROI frameworks.
Refine attribution modeling logic across multi-channel touchpoints to ensure accurate revenue credit and resource allocation.
Design and analyze controlled experiments and A/B tests to measure the exact causal impact of commercial initiatives.
Act as the financial controller for third-party partnerships, validating commission structures and outbound sales unit economics.
Build predictive dashboards to track customer cohort payback periods and identify early indicators of non-default churn.



What we’re looking for

We are seeking a structured analyst who can drive alignment between our growth and finance teams by translating raw data into strategic commercial recommendations. You possess a pragmatic mindset focused on building scalable frameworks, paired with the communication skills needed to confidently challenge assumptions.

Qualifications


Several years of experience in data analytics, business control, or growth analytics within Fintech, banking, or fast-paced digital sectors.
Advanced technical proficiency in SQL, Excel, and business intelligence dashboards like PowerBI or AWS QuickSight.
Deep understanding of marketing unit economics, including CAC, CLV, and cohort payback tracking.
University degree in economics, engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related quantitative field.
Professional fluency in spoken and written English.



Why Qred?

This is the place to be if you’re looking for a place to grow. Qred is growing fast, and our Qredsters along with it. With a non-bureaucratic organization and delegated responsibilities, we make sure there’s a short path from idea to action. In addition to our great culture, you get to work with the latest cutting-edge techniques, full ownership, and last but not least a bunch of great competent colleagues to learn from!

One Last Thing

This is a full-time, permanent position based in our headquarters in Stockholm. We believe our culture thrives when we work together, which is why we have an office-first approach. To balance this with some flexibility, we have the option of working remotely one day per week. We review applications on a rolling basis and while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately.

Qred celebrates diversity and does not discriminate based on ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.



Qred is an international FinTech scale-up that specializes in digital financing solutions for small businesses, with operations in the Nordics, Benelux, Germany and Brazil. We are passionate about helping small businesses thrive and grow, by providing them with business loans and credit cards. Right now we’re in an exciting phase of our journey that focuses on growth through smart product development and technology fueled by international expansion.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
Att jobba som Analytics Engineer

Vi söker en Analytic Engineer som vill vara med och utveckla vår dataplattform och skapa nya möjligheter för bättre analys, rapportering och beslut. I rollen arbetar du i gränslandet mellan data engineering, BI och verksamhet, med fokus på att omvandla data till välstrukturerad information som är enkel att använda och lita på.

Du blir en del av vårt Data & Analytics-team som ansvarar för banken dataplattform, informationsstyrning och affärsstödjande analys. I rollen ansvarar du för att utveckla och förvalta konsumtionslagret (affärslager/analyslager/gold-lager) och säkerställa affärsanpassade datamodeller optimerade för analys, rapportering och självbetjäning.

I nära samarbete med flera delar av banken fungerar du som en brygga mellan behov och teknisk lösning. Rollen innebär också att du är med och påverkar arkitektur och tekniska vägval i en föränderlig miljö, tillsammans med ett tvärfunktionellt team där utveckling och kunskapsdelning står i centrum.

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig som har ett starkt intresse för data och analys, och som trivs i en roll där du får kombinera din tekniska kompetens med verksamhetsförståelse.

Vi Tror Att Du Har


Arbetat i en liknande roll inom bank, eller som t ex BI-utvecklare, dataanalytiker eller data engineer.
Erfarenhet av rapportering, analys och BI och därmed en förståelse för verksamhetens behov.
Goda erfarenheter av att designa och utveckla stjärnmodeller för analys och rapportering
Kunskap inom informationsmodellering
Goda kunskaper i SQL och erfarenhet av Data Warehouse-utveckling i Microsoft-miljöer
Relevant utbildning inom data/IT eller systemvetenskap
Goda kunskaper i svenska, i tal och skrift


Som person

Du är en kommunikativ och samarbetsorienterad person som trivs i en roll med många kontaktytor. Du bygger enkelt relationer, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar aktivt till teamets utveckling.

Du arbetar strukturerat, har ett öga för detaljer och drivs av att förstå verksamhetens behov och omsätta dem till lösningar som skapar värde.

Vad händer nu? 

Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet. För att göra rekryteringsprocessen så rättvis och objektiv som möjligt kommer processen att innefatta intervjuer, tester via Alva Labs, bakgrundskontroll samt digital referenstagning. 

Vid frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef, Maria Jägerback, på maria.jagerback@skandia alternativt Talent Acquisition Partner, Nina Fazeli, på nina.fazeli@skandia.se om du har ytterligare frågor. 

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Title: Data Analytics Engineer
Description:
Are you ready to be a key contributor within the Data & Analytics Engineering department at NOBA Bank Group? Your focus will be on advancing analytics capabilities, optimizing data workflows, driving innovation in the cloud, and unlocking the full potential of the organization’s most valuable asset – data.

About The Role

The Data & Analytics Engineering department comprises specialized teams focused on Data Infrastructure Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Data Management.

As a Data Analytics Engineer, you'll play a central role in building and optimizing the organization's supporting analytics layer, collaborating across the bank. This role offers broad opportunities to grow and make a tangible impact!

We offer a hybrid working model with two common in-office days. While we value flexibility, we also prioritize collaboration, team-building, and enjoying fikas and after-work gatherings together!

Main Tasks


Design and implement efficient data models, focusing on analytics workflows and end-user usability.
Build robust and scalable data pipelines to support business intelligence and analytics needs.
Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, such as Risk, Finance, and IT, to ensure data solutions align with business needs.
Ensure data quality, security, and compliance throughout the analytics lifecycle.
Drive technical improvements, introducing modern tools and processes to enhance analytics capabilities.
Partner with other engineers to align transformation processes for analytics purposes.


We Are Looking For Someone Who

Enjoys working with data & analytics engineering, modern data practices, and creating insights that drive decisions. We believe you are a detail-oriented and proactive person who thrives in a high pace enviroment and enjoy learning new technologies. You approach challenges with a “can-do” attitude and excel in analytical thinking and problem-solving.

For This Role You’ll Need


Work experience in a similar role within data engineering or analytics engineering
An academic degree related to analytics engineering, data engineering, or similar fields.
Proficiency in ETL processes, designing analytics-ready datasets, and ensuring clean and usable data for stakeholders.
Proficiency in Databricks, dbt (SQL), python and related reporting tools and languages.
Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools.
Fluency in English is required, along with fluency in either Swedish or Norwegian.


It’s a Plus If You Have


Experience with Microsoft’s data stack (Azure, SQL, and other cloud services).
Experience working with on-prem solutions.
A background in data roles within the financial sector.
Knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies.


Our Offer To You


Freedom with Responsibility: Flexible working arrangements to suit your work style.
Career Development: Opportunities to grow and develop in your role.
Feedback Culture: A supportive environment that encourages open communication.
Coaching Leadership: Managers who guide and support your career journey.
A Caring Company Culture: We genuinely care about each other!


In addition to this, it is important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead.

Have you heard of NOBAVERSE?

In our NOBAVERSE, we value openness, trust, and diversity. Here, you can influence your own development and have fun along the way to achieving our goals – all in a workplace that’s a little extra bubbly! ✨

Read more about our employee value proposition on our careers page.

Read more about how our recruitment process works in the FAQ.

We care for your privacy and, with reference to the GDPR, would like to ask you not to include any sensitive personal data in your application, for examples information about ethnic origin, political opinions, religious beliefs or information about your health.

Read more about how we handle your personal data here.

If you have any questions or concerns about the position, please contact the responsible recruiter.

We look forward to receiving your application! 🙏✨
