Title: Quantitative Risk Analyst, Credit Risk Data Management [Assistant/Regular/Senior]
Description:
Job ID: 5814

We are looking for Quantitative Risk Analyst [Assistant/Regular/Senior] from all background and level to join our Risk Models Data and Strategy teams that is recognized for its professionalism, competence and capabilities.

Do you enjoy working with data analysis? Do you like solving problems and finding new and innovative solutions? Do you understand the principles of banking and are you able to apply this knowledge in your daily work?

If you have previous experience with Credit Risk models, then great! If you have a flair for data and a genuine interest in analysis, you are also welcome!

About Our Team

Meet the Credit Risk Data Management, a part of the Risk Models Data & Strategy organization in Risk Models. We have an ambitious development plan for development of IRB models and together with our colleagues in Nordea we’ll be part of creating the future of banking.

The Risk Models Data & Strategy department, is a department consisting of 6 team, each specialized in their own part of ensuring high quality data is supporting the bank capital foundation. We add value to Nordea and our customers by improving Nordea data quality, helping visualizing and create the understanding of our data so modelling teams can build great internal models used for Own Funds calculation and the for risk management.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. 

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Quantitative Risk Analyst, the specific role may vary based on qualifications, but you could i.e. play a valuable role in Data analytics, optimizing data flows, product management or as a data governance specialist. Your role could also include coordinating data related activities and ensuring proper communication within the teams and across other Risk Models areas.

Main responsibilities in this role:


Root-cause analysis for data quality issues, where we meticulously investigate and identify the underlying reasons for any discrepancies in our data. This is closely followed by data reconciliation, ensuring that our data sets are consistent and accurate across different sources.
We focus on optimizing data flows and algorithms to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our data processes.
Own and manage all data used in credit risk models across the end-to-end lifecycle, applying data product mindset to capture, enhance and realize value throughout credit risk models.
Identify and govern critical data elements though strong knowledge of credit risk models, regulatory expectation and capital.
Secure our Data Governance framework and processes with focus on effective Data Quality Controls, also ensuring documentation of Data Lineage toward all data providers and consumers for credit risk data.
Preparing reports and other documentation for senior management and external reporting is also an integral part of our role, ensuring transparency and informed decision-making.


You’ll join an international team with variety of backgrounds and skills. We believe that strong drive and passion for change are fundamental for delivering on our commitments. Bring your background and skills to our team, and you will have plenty of opportunities to collaborate, grow and develop.

Who You Are

This is the right role for you if you:


Have an adaptability to thrive in fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Are structured and able to coordinate several deliveries simultaneously.
Are self-driven and able to work independently but also enjoy collaboration with others.
Have strong analytical skills and keen attention to detail with the ability to analyse complex data and processes to derive meaningful insights.
Have good communication and presentations skills, are not afraid to speak up and can effectively convey business requirements to IT teams and facilitate collaboration between stakeholders.
Are curious and proactive, focus on solutions rather than problems and share our enthusiasm for developing and learning and constantly improving your skills and competences.


Your background and skills include:


Experience with Credit Risk modeling, capital reporting, and understanding regulatory requirements as BCBS239 and TRIM.
Knowledge of SQL, SAS, Snowflake, Python or similar.
Master’s degree in finance, economics, engineering, physics, mathematics or similar.
A strong focus on results, deliveries and deadlines.
Experience with Big Data would be an asset.
An interest in finance and technology.


What We Offer

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 09/09/2026.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

Title: Total Rewards Analyst
Description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.


We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

Title: Kravanalytiker/produktägare
Company: The Swedish Federation of Unemployment Insurance Funds
Description:
Sveriges a-kassor söker en kravanalytiker/produktägare Statistik

Vi söker en kravanalytiker/produktägare för produkter vi förvaltar på Sveriges a-kassor.




Arbetsbeskrivning

Sveriges a-kassor söker nu en Kravanalytiker/produktägare

Arbetsmarknaden förändras i allt snabbare takt och arbetslöshetskassornas uppdrag har kanske aldrig varit viktigare.




Det finns 24 a-kassor i Sverige. Sveriges a-kassor är deras gemensamma service- och intresseorganisation. Det betyder att vi hjälper a-kassorna med bland annat IT-utveckling, utbildning och opinionsbildning. Syftet är att a-kassorna ska kunna administrera arbetslöshetsförsäkringen på ett så snabbt och effektivt sätt som möjligt. Sveriges a-kassor sitter i nya fräscha lokaler vid Skanstull samt är en modern arbetsgivare som månar om sina anställda. Vi tycker arbetslivet ska vara hållbart över tid och erbjuder flexibilitet och goda villkor för våra anställda.




På Sveriges a-kassor jobbar vi med att vidareutveckla och förvalta de IT-system som a-kassorna nyttjar i sitt dagliga arbete med att administrera arbetslöshetsförsäkringen för sina medlemmar.




Utbildning och erfarenhet

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi gärna att du har:

Relevant högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande förvärvad arbetserfarenhet
Dokumenterad erfarenhet av kravanalys inom datalager, beslutsstöd eller BI-lösningar
Erfarenhet av att ha jobbat i rollen som kravanalytiker eller motsvarande
Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift
Erfarenhet av att ansvara för användargrupper eller motsvarande
God förståelse för datalagerarkitektur och arbete med stora datamängder i SQL Server (ur ett krav- och analysperspektiv).
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med BI-verktyg, med fokus på informationsstruktur, begreppsmodellering och rapportbehov.
Vi arbetar agilt och du behöver känna dig bekväm med att hålla i workshops.

Personliga egenskaper:

Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga
Förmåga att kunna prioritera samt att du känner ett stort ansvar för de arbetsuppgifter du åtar dig
Drivande
Social kompetens

För att passa in i rollen ser vi att du gillar utmaningar och klarar av ett högt tempo. Du har förmåga och trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och i grupp. Du är bra på att driva ditt arbete framåt samtidigt som du känner stort ansvar för de arbetsuppgifter som du åtar dig. Som person drivs du av att bredda din kompetens och du stimuleras av en arbetsmiljö som präglas av problemlösning och service. 




Övrig information

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning som startar med 6 månaders provanställning.

Sista ansökningsdag är 2026-09-04. Intervjuer hålls löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag så skicka in din ansökan redan nu. Lön enligt överenskommelse.

Vid frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta




HR: Nils Boix-Vives, nils.boix-vives@sverigesakassor.se 




Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Title: Data Manager (FME)
HTML:
We currently have a vacancy for a Data Manager (FME) fluent in English, to offer his/her services as an expert remotely (within EU). In the context of the first assignment, the successful candidate will be integrated in the Development team of the company that will closely cooperate with a major client's IT team on site.

Tasks:

    • Design and implement automated data flows to integrate data and processes into the contracting authority's systems and databases (historical data migration and new ETL flows);
    • Performance monitoring and improvement of existing and new ETL flows;
    • Ensure data quality is properly defined, documented, analysed and monitored;
    • Support data analysis, modelling and visualisation in close collaboration with internal stakeholders, such as disease surveillance experts and fellow data managers.

Requirements

      • University degree within the field of computer science, data science, or another related field; with at least three years of experience in data management/analysis OR non-university degree with at least five years of experience in data management/analysis; 
      • Minimum 3 years of recent experience in handling large complex data sets, working with data warehouses and data marts using FME; 
      • A certification/training in FME and TransactSQL is required;
      • Experience in data management/analysis in infectious diseases, epidemiology or public health will be considered an asset;
      • Experience in TransactSQL and Python/or R will be considered an asset;
      • Excellent command of the English language.

Benefits

If you are seeking a career in an exciting and dynamic company, where you will offer your services as part of a team of a major European Institution, operating in an international, multilingual and multicultural environment where you can expect real chances to make a difference, please send us your detailed CV in English, quoting reference: (DM/08/2026).

We offer a competitive remuneration (either on contract basis or remuneration with full benefits package), based on qualifications and experience. All applications will be treated as confidential. 

You may also consider all our other open vacancies by visiting the career section of our web site (www.eurodyn.com) and follow us on Twitter (@EURODYN_Careers) and LinkedIn.

EUROPEAN DYNAMICS (www.eurodyn.com) is a leading Software, Information and Communication Technologies company, operating internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Hong-Kong, Valetta, etc). The company employs over 1000 engineers, IT experts and consultants (around 3% PhD, 36% MSc and 53% BSc or equivalent). We design and develop software applications using state-of-the-art technology. The group generates annual revenues in the range of EURO 40 million, with an EBITDA in the range of 20%. The value of our contract portfolio exceeds EURO 300 million. EUROPEAN DYNAMICS is a renowned supplier of IT services to government institutions, multinational corporations, public administrations and multinational companies, research and academic institutes.

As part of our dedication to the diversity of our workforce, we are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity without regard for race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion

Title: CRM Analytics Lead
Description:
Gjensidige är ett av Nordens ledande försäkringsbolag noterade på Oslo Börs. Vi är verksamma i Sverige, Norge och Danmark och har totalt cirka 4600 medarbetare. I Sverige etablerades Gjensidige Försäkring år 2007. Här är vi cirka 300 medarbetare placerade i Stockholm, Luleå, Malmö eller Gävle och erbjuder försäkringsprodukter till privatpersoner och företag. Vi säkrar liv, hälsa och värden med utgångspunkt i vår vision "Vi ska känna kunden bäst och bry oss mest".

CRM Analytics Lead

Nu stärker vi vår CRM- och analysförmåga och söker en CRM Analytics Lead som vill ta en central roll i att utveckla datadrivna kundstrategier och avancerade analyslösningar. Vi är övertygade om att data, analys och AI kommer att vara avgörande för framtidens kundupplevelser och affärsutveckling inom försäkring.

Din roll

Som CRM Analytics Lead blir du en nyckelperson i allt från datautforskning till färdiga modeller i produktion. I rollen har du ett övergripande ansvar för kundanalys, insikter och modellering, och du samarbetar nära både affärens stakeholders och analytiker i andra delar av organisationen. Rollen passar dig som uppskattar variation, tar naturligt ägarskap och framför allt vill använda din kompetens för att skapa verkligt värde. Du kommer att tillhöra organisationen Marknad & Utveckling och rapportera till Chef CRM & Data.

Du kommer att:


Ta ansvar för hela kedjan: från datautforskning och modellutveckling till drift och uppföljning.
Utveckla och produktionssätta modeller för churn, retention, kundvärde, segmentering och NBO.
Analysera kund-, försäljnings- och försäkringsdata för att identifiera affärsmöjligheter.
Bygga robusta analyslösningar i Databricks med Python och SQL.
Utveckla dashboards och visualiseringar för ledning och verksamhet.
Arbeta med både stora datamängder och komplexa, ofullständiga dataset.
Utforska och implementera nya AI- och analysmetoder.
Vara en drivande kraft i utvecklingen av datadrivna arbetssätt och strategi inom CRM.



Vi söker dig som


Är självgående, tar egna initiativ och trivs med att äga både strategiska och operativa uppgifter.
Har erfarenhet av avancerad analys inom försäkring eller närliggande bransch.
Har erfarenhet av att bygga, validera och produktionssätta prediktiva modeller.
Har god förståelse för statistiska metoder och maskininlärning.
Trivs med att arbeta både strategiskt och operativt.
Omsätter idéer och analyser till handling och arbetar affärsnära för att skapa resultat.
Har en akademisk utbildning inom statistik, datavetenskap, matematik, teknisk fysik, industriell ekonomi eller motsvarande kvantitativ utbildning.



Därför ska du välja Gjensidige

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med några av försäkringsbranschens mest intressanta datautmaningar. Du får stort eget ansvar, moderna verktyg och möjlighet att påverka både teknikval och arbetssätt. Samtidigt blir du en del av en organisation där samarbete, utveckling och kundfokus står i centrum.

Vi hörs!

Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm.

Låter det intressant? Varmt välkommen med din ansökan senast den 13 september genom att skicka in ditt CV och svara på några frågor i samband med ansökan. Kontakta gärna rekryterande chef Andreas Stenberg, Andreas.Stenberg@gjensidige.se om du har funderingar om tjänsten. Intervjuer görs löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Vill du vara med och förändra pensionsbranschen?

Är du en kreativ problemlösare med en passion för att strukturera och organisera information? Brinner du för att skapa affärsvärde utifrån data? Då är du den vi söker!




Om tjänsten🚀

Att effektivt använda data operationellt och för analys är centralt för att lyckas i SPPs kommande utveckling. I rollen som data engineer spelar du en avgörande roll i att effektivt skapa värde ur data genom att bygga vår nya dataplattform tillsammans med resten av teamet.

Förutsättningarna finns för att du ska kunna göra stor skillnad. Vi är i en förändringsfas där vi bygger nya tekniska lösningar samt förändrar kulturen kring hur data produceras och konsumeras. Du kommer vara med att sätta denna grund. Satsningen inom datadomänen samt förståelse för utmaningen är väl förankrad i SPPs ledningsgrupp.




Hos SPP Tech får du en dynamisk arbetsmiljö med fokus på innovation och utveckling. Du kommer att vara en del av ett engagerat team och ha stora möjligheter att påverka och utvecklas i din roll. Du kommer rapportera till Head of Data och vara en del av ett team på totalt tio personer.




Vem är du?👋

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi du är nyfiken på att utforska nya tekniska lösningar och att utveckla nya arbetssätt tillsammans med andra. Du behöver kunna balansera utforskande av nya lösningar med att samtidigt skapa ordning och reda. Du har ett coachande förhållningssätt där du bidrar till andras utveckling och gärna erfarenhet av att ta en tech/development lead roll. Vi tror du har:

Flera års erfarenhet av liknande roller, gärna att viss erfarenhet är inom bank- eller försäkringsbranschen.
Erfarenhet av dimensionsmodellering. Vår tech stack bygger på Snowflake, DBT, Dagster, DLT och programmering i Python.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med CI/CD och DevOps samt mycket goda kunskaper i SQL.
Erfarenhet av att designa och utveckla nya tekniska lösningar inom data samt ersätta gammal ETL-kod med ELT.
Förmågan och drivet att agera på eget initiativ och få saker att hända.
God samarbetsförmåga.
Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.




Varför välja SPP? 💚

SPP är en del av den nordiska finanskoncernen Storebrand. Tillsammans skapar vi en framtid att glädjas åt genom att vägleda till ekonomiska beslut som gynnar individen, samhället och planeten långsiktigt på ett enkelt sätt. Vi sitter i helt nyrenoverade lokaler precis intill Stockholms centralstation och erbjuder en hybrid arbetsvardag, med majoriteten av tiden på kontoret. Title: Analytics Engineer till UR i Stockholm
Description:
Vill du sätta din prägel på en helt ny Analytics Engineer-roll hos UR i Stockholm och skapa data som gör skillnad?

Vill du vara med från början och forma hur en modern data- och analysplattform ska fungera? Som Analytics Engineer på UR får du en nyckelroll i en omfattande satsning där hela datainfrastrukturen moderniseras. Du får möjlighet att bygga upp modelleringslagret, utveckla arbetssätt och skapa förutsättningar för datadrivna beslut i en verksamhet med ett viktigt samhällsuppdrag. Här blir du en del av ett engagerat team som arbetar nära varandra och där samarbete, nyfikenhet och kunskapsdelning står i fokus. Under din första tid får du stöd av en senior Analytics Engineer-konsult samtidigt som du successivt tar ägarskap över dbt-projektet och utvecklingen av modelleringslagret.

Vi erbjuder dig

Hos UR får du möjligheten att ta en viktig roll där du får stort inflytande över hur dataarbetet utvecklas framåt. Du blir en del av en strategisk satsning där BigQuery är det centrala datalagret och dbt Cloud transformeringsverktyget. Samtidigt blir du en del av ett kompetent och engagerat team som arbetar nära verksamheten och tillsammans driver utvecklingen framåt.


En unik möjlighet att bygga upp modelleringslagret från grunden.
En nyckelroll i moderniseringen av UR data- och analysplattform.
Ett engagerat team med nära samarbete och stort kunskapsutbyte.
Möjlighet att påverka arbetssätt, struktur och den fortsatta utvecklingen av dataplattformen.
Ett meningsfullt uppdrag där datadrivna insikter bidrar till UR verksamhet.



Det här gör du hos oss


Designar, bygger och underhåller datamodeller i dbt Cloud ovanpå BigQuery.
Implementerar KPI:er och mätetal enligt UR:s KPI-ramverk.
Säkerställer datakvalitet genom tester, dokumentation och tydliga konventioner.
Samarbetar nära dataingenjörer och analytiker kring datakällor, datakvalitet och verksamhetens behov.
Bidrar till den fortsatta utvecklingen av dataplattformen och dess arbetssätt.
Ansvarar för kvalitet, struktur och vidareutveckling av dbt-projektet.



Ditt team och arbetsplats

Du blir en del av Data & Analys-teamet på UR i Stockholm. Teamet arbetar tätt tillsammans med återkommande avstämningar och sprintplanering för att driva utvecklingen framåt. Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med dataingenjörer, analytiker och andra kollegor inom dataområdet. UR arbetar huvudsakligen från kontoret för att skapa goda förutsättningar för samarbete och snabba beslutsvägar.

Mer om dig

För att lyckas i rollen har du gedigen erfarenhet av datatransformering och modellering i dbt samt mycket goda kunskaper i SQL där du är van att skriva, optimera och underhålla komplexa frågor. Du har arbetat med molnbaserade datalager, exempelvis BigQuery, Snowflake eller Redshift, och har en relevant högskoleutbildning inom data, teknik eller statistik, alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och har goda kunskaper i engelska.

Vi tror också att du är nyfiken på ny teknik och vill utforska hur AI kan användas inom dataområdet. Eftersom rollen är ny trivs du med att vara med och bygga upp strukturer och arbetssätt, samtidigt som du uppskattar ett nära samarbete med andra. Du har ett kvalitetsmedvetet arbetssätt, en stark analytisk förmåga och motiveras av att skapa hållbara lösningar som gör data till en tillförlitlig grund för verksamhetens beslut.

Så här får vi kontakt

I den här rekryteringen har vi valt att samarbeta med Ada Digital som strävar efter en transparent, inkluderande och snabbrörlig rekryteringsupplevelse. Vi vill veta mer om dig och din potential! Du söker tjänsten enkelt och behöver inte bifoga några dokument. Det räcker med en motivering till varför du söker tjänsten och om du saknar CV kan du bifoga din LinkedIn-profil. Följ sedan din ansökan live via vår hemsida. Urvalet sker löpande och tjänsten kan bli tillsatt före sista ansökningsdatum. Är du nyfiken och vill veta mer innan du söker? Hör av dig till ansvarig rekryterare. Vi ser fram emot att få kontakt med dig!

Title: SAP Analytics Sweden
Description:
Junior SAP Analytics consultant to Accenture’s Nordic SAP Business Group

Do you have a passion for transforming businesses with the newest technologies and making them data-driven companies? Are you looking for a place where you could combine your business consulting skills with technology strategy know-how? Do you know how to bring value out of data?

If Yes, bring your talent and passion to Accenture and help us deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity. Take this opportunity to develop your skills and build an extraordinary career! You will play a key role in transforming organizations and communities around the world. Let there be change!

About Our Nordic SAP Business Group

Accenture and SAP have a longstanding relationship that extends more than 40 years. As the leading Nordic SAP transformation partner, we work with SAP end-to-end from product innovation to development and delivery. Together, we are revolutionizing the future of business through major SAP transformation programs with some of the biggest companies.

Within our Nordic SAP community, we work with the newest SAP solutions and offerings such as SAP S/4, SAP BTP, SAP Business Data Cloud, Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, HANA, BW/4, and SAP RISE.

We are now looking to expand our community at scale and are looking at candidates for several positions and seniority levels.

To read more about our SAP Practice, visit us at https://www.accenture.com/us-en/services/sap-index

What’s in it for you:



Work with some of the biggest SAP clients in large global implementation projects.

Be a valuable member of our Nordic SAP Analytics group and contribute to thought leadership, competence development and sales initiatives.

Significant development opportunities and support for progressing in your professional career; technical, functional and as a leader.

A dedicated mentor to guide you during your work with continuous feedback.

Being part of our culture and core values in a truly human work environment.

Competitive compensation and benefits.

Access to comprehensive tools and frameworks supported by our global organization, including implementation methodologies, knowledge databases, industry leading add-on software, expert networks and benchmarks.



As a junior Analytics professional in Accenture, you will:



Work closely together with clients to help them get real value out of their data by embedding Analytics into their business processes, utilizing standard SAP S/4 apps, enhancements and custom development.

Get to work on S4 Analytics extensibility, Data warehouse development in solutions like Business Data Cloud, Datasphere, and BW/4HANA, hybrid scenarios leveraging data lake/lakehouse solutions, planning scenarios and frontend development in solutions like SAP Analytics Cloud.

Be able to grow your professional skills within analytics, big data and AI.

Help clients’ sustainability agenda through cutting-edge analytics.



Required Qualifications 



Knowledge about Analytics technologies, such as ERP embedded analytics, data warehouse solutions, data lake/lakehouse and frontend reporting/visualization tools

Functional knowledge of business processes or interest to learn in order to maximize the value clients will get out of their Analytics solutions.

Strong analytical skills, result-oriented paired with highly structured working style and good sense of responsibility, flexibility, and team player

Willingness and ability to quickly learn new concepts and technologies

Passionate about innovation and delivery of the latest technologies to your clients

Excellent communication (verbal and written) and presentation skills to address technical and non-technical audiences in English and Nordic language

M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Business or Engineering, such as Computer Science or Mathematics/Statistics



Preferred Qualifications



Experience with SAP Analytics technologies such as S/4 Analytics Extensibility, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Analytics Cloud (reporting & planning), Datasphere, BW/4 or HANA

Experience working with cross-functional teams/stakeholders in an international and fast-moving environment

Experience with data lake/lakehouse solutions

Experience with AI technologies

Norwegian/Swedish/Danish speaking

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
We are Sweden's leading app and marketplace for booking beauty and wellness services. As a SaaS company with industry-leading software, we empower more than 16,000 professionals across the country. Our platform brings together nearly every salon and clinic in Sweden, making it easy for consumers to book appointments with hairdressers, massage therapists, podiatrists, beauty salons, chiropractors, and many other specialists—all in one place.

On Bokadirekt.se, consumers can discover, book, and pay for treatments and services in just a few clicks. Every month, our platform is visited by 3 million consumers, and more than 2 million bookings are made through our website and app. We’re growing rapidly and are currently a team of more than 100 employees, with offices in Stockholm and Luleå.

About The Role

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data & Analytics team and help shape the future of data and AI at Bokadirekt.

As a Data Engineer, you will be responsible for building, maintaining, and evolving the data platform that powers analytics, business intelligence, and AI across the company. You'll work at the intersection of data engineering and AI, ensuring our data infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and ready to support everything from reporting and experimentation to LLM-powered features and machine learning pipelines.

You will collaborate closely with product managers, software engineers, analysts, and other stakeholders to create high-quality data products and enable data-driven decision-making throughout the organization. This is an opportunity to have a significant impact on both our technical platform and how data and AI are used to create value for millions of users every month.

What You'll Do


Design, build, and optimise scalable ELT pipelines that power analytics, reporting, and AI initiatives across the company
Build a reliable, trusted and well-documented source of truth for company KPIs
Work on the integration of AI capabilities into our data infrastructure
Collaborate on the development and deployment of machine learning solutions and AI-powered features
Identify and carry out data platform cost optimization initiatives


Who You Are


Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Physics or related field
Proven experience (4-6 years) as a Data Engineer, Data Scientist, ML Engineer or AI Engineer, ideally in a technology-driven environment
Strong proficiency in SQL and Python
Solid data engineering fundamentals with hands-on AI experience
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience with GCP (BigQuery, GCS, Gemini Agent Platform, Looker), Airflow, dbt and Cube is a plus. Bonus points for prompt engineering, LLM APIs, NL querying and RAG
Professional fluency in English


What We Offer


The opportunity to build and scale the data platform behind one of Sweden's most widely used consumer apps
The chance to work with modern data and AI technologies, helping shape the foundations for analytics, machine learning, and LLM-powered solutions
A collaborative culture built on ownership, innovation, and knowledge sharing
A flexible hybrid work model with four days in the office each week, including Wednesdays as our "Inspiration Day," when the whole company comes together for breakfast and shared activities
A modern office in the heart of Stockholm
A competitive salary and benefits package


About The Position

Start date: As soon as possible / By agreement

Location: Our office at Kungsgatan 38 in central Stockholm (hybrid)

Employment type: Full-time, permanent position

Application deadline: August 14

Application

We review applications continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Summer is here, and we are also taking some time to recharge. During the holiday period, our response times may be slightly longer than usual, and the recruitment process will resume from week 32.

Thank you for your patience. We wish you a wonderful summer and hope to hear from you soon!

As a Digital Analytics Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring that we collect, structure and maintain reliable data across our digital platforms. You will work at the intersection of technology, data and business, enabling teams across CX, CRO, and analytics to make better decisions based on accurate and trustworthy data. This role is hands-on from day one, with the opportunity to evolve into a broader ownership of tracking and measurement over time.

You will be working closely with Digital Customer Experience (CX), CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization), UX & CX Enablement, Product and Technology, and Analytics and insights teams. Together, we build a more structured, data-driven and scalable way of improving digital customer journeys.

Why this role matters

Reliable data is the foundation for everything we do – from improving customer journeys to optimizing business performance. In this role, you will enable better decisions across the organization, improve how we measure and understand customer behavior and contribute directly to how we optimize digital experiences over time.

What You Will Do


Own and develop tracking across web and digital customer journeys (GA4, GTM, sGTM)
Ensure data quality, consistency and reliability across all tracking setups
Configure and maintain Google Analytics and reporting (GA4, Looker)
Work with BigQuery to validate data and support deeper analysis
Support CRO and experimentation by ensuring correct measurement of tests
Set up and maintain integrations with tools such as A/B testing platforms
Work closely with IT to implement, test and deploy tracking changes
Identify and resolve tracking issues proactively
Maintain and improve tracking structure, data models and standards
Act as a key resource for analytics teams in understanding tracking and data


What You Will Bring

We are looking for a technically strong and curious individual who enjoys solving complex data and tracking challenges.

You Likely Have


Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking
Experience working with BigQuery or similar data environments
Strong understanding of how tracking works across modern web environments
Experience with cookies, consent, browser limitations (e.g. ITP/ETP) and ad blockers
Ability to debug and understand how data flows across tools and scripts
Basic understanding of JavaScript and HTTP requests
A structured and detail-oriented way of working
Applicants must be fluent in Swedish or Norwegian and English.


It Is a Plus If You Have Worked With


Ad blockers and their impact on tracking

Tracking setup supporting digital advertising platforms

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
På B3 Indes förvandlar vi data till värdefulla insikter som driver förändring och innovation. Vi skapar lösningar inom AI, Business Intelligence, Data Science och Automation för att maximera värdet av data och stärka företags konkurrenskraft. Vår styrka ligger i att kombinera passion för AI och data med en stark laganda, där vi stöttar varandra och löser utmaningar tillsammans.

Rollen som Data Scientist på B3

Hos oss får du chansen att jobba med några av Sveriges mest spännande kunder och projekt. Vad innebär det? Jo, att du får:


Gräva i data och hitta insikter som inte bara hjälper våra kunder – utan kanske till och med gör världen lite bättre.
Göra företag mer datadrivna och smartare genom att guida dem i rätt riktning.
Bygga och implementera avancerade lösningar – och faktiskt se dem göra skillnad!


Här handlar det inte bara om teknik – det handlar om att skapa verklig förändring. Vi gillar att tänka stort, experimentera och lösa kluriga problem tillsammans. Och det bästa? Du får ett team av grymma kollegor att bolla idéer med, lära dig av och ha kul ihop med!

Det är din passion för AI och data som gör skillnaden. Utöver det ser vi gärna:


Har du en universitetsutbildning inom matematik eller statistik? Toppen! Har du kanske skaffat motsvarande kunskaper genom arbetslivserfarenhet? Det funkar lika bra!
Minst 4 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet – vi letar efter någon som har hunnit samla på sig en del erfarenhet inom området.
Flytande svenska och engelska – eftersom båda språken används dagligen i arbetet.
Tidigare konsultroller är ett plus! Har du jobbat som konsult tidigare? Då är det en extra merit, men inget krav.


Men framför allt...

Har du erfarenhet av Machine Learning och Python? Grymt – det är värdefullt! Men vi lägger också stor vikt vid din förmåga att se helheten, skapa användbara lösningar men framförallt att du är nyfiken. Om du dessutom har koll på A/B-testning, modellering eller visualisering, är det ett plus – men absolut inget krav.

Varför välja B3 Indes?

💡 Utveckling & karriär – Väx i en entreprenörsdriven miljö där din kompetens får ta plats.

🌿 Balans & välmående – Vi värnar om ditt välbefinnande med stöd för wellness och en flexibel vardag.

🚀 Energi & gemenskap – Här präglas kulturen av öppenhet, nyfikenhet och en passion för att skapa något större – tillsammans.

❤️ Vi bryr oss – på riktigt – Vi engagerar oss i samhällsfrågor och samarbetar med initiativ som Suicide Zero, My Dream Now och Pink Programming för att göra skillnad även utanför arbetslivet.

En arbetsplats som gör skillnad:

Vi är stolta över att ha utsetts till ett av Sveriges fem främsta karriärföretag 2025 – en utmärkelse som speglar vår energi, nyfikenhet och vårt engagemang för att skapa en inkluderande och inspirerande arbetsplats. Här värdesätts olika perspektiv och idéer, och vi tror att det är just det som gör oss starkare.

Hos oss får du friheten att styra över dina uppdrag, din arbetstid och din utveckling. Vi erbjuder konkurrenskraftiga löner, flexibilitet att forma din vardag och en sund balans mellan jobb och fritid. Och vi vet att gemenskap är minst lika viktigt som teknik – därför satsar vi på allt från konferensresor och sommarfester till sköna AW:s där vi kan släppa jobbet för en stund.

Om B3 Consulting Group

B3 Consulting Group är ett expansivt konsultbolag med cirka 1000 medarbetare. Vi brinner för innovation och hjälper Sveriges ledande företag och organisationer att skapa framtidens möjligheter genom digital transformation. B3 finns på tolv orter i Sverige samt i Polen, med huvudkontor i Stockholm. Bolaget grundades 2003, är noterat på Nasdaq Stockholm Small Cap och omsatte 1 141 MSEK 2023.

Vi är stolta över vår prisbelönta företagskultur, där olikheter, erfarenheter och gemensam energi värdesätts. Som ett etiskt och transparent bolag strävar vi efter att ha en positiv påverkan på samhället, människor och miljön. Vi är även engagerade i Women in Tech och initiativ för att stärka AI-utbildning för kvinnor. 2024 utsågs vi till Årets Employer Branding-företag, och vår HR-chef vann titeln Årets HR-chef.

Är du redo att bli en del av ett företag där din passion för AI och data kan göra skillnad? Läs mer om oss och våra möjligheter här!

Title: Commercial Operations Analyst - Vitamin Well Group
Description:
Vitamin Well Group develops premium functional drinks, snacks and protein products designed for modern, everyday life and on-the-go consumption. Our portfolio includes Barebells, NOCCO and Vitamin Well. With over 750 employees and revenue of more than SEK 10 billion, we are present in over 50 markets, with our headquarters in Stockholm and local teams and partners around the world. Our growth is driven by a focus on building strong brands, creating products with uncompromising taste and clear functionality, and consistently raising the bar across our categories.

As we continue expanding globally, we are strengthening our Commercial Operations team with a Commercial Operations Analyst who enjoys turning data into insights and driving better business decisions.

About The Role

Data and insights play an increasingly important role in how we make commercial decisions. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues across Commercial, Supply Chain and Finance to provide reporting and insights that help us understand performance, identify opportunities and make better commercial decisions.

From distribution cost analysis and financial reporting to business cases and process improvements, you will transform data into actionable insights that improve the way we work and enable better commercial decisions across our global organisation.

What you'll do

Commercial Performance & Analytics


Own and continuously develop distribution cost reporting across our global markets.
Analyse logistics and distribution costs to identify trends, risks and improvement opportunities.
Build business cases to support commercial negotiations and strategic initiatives.
Develop dashboards and performance reporting for stakeholders across the business.


Financial Control & Governance


Coordinate month-end logistics cost closing activities.
Validate invoices and support approval processes.
Monitor logistics spend against budgets and contracts.
Support accruals, forecasting and financial reporting.


Business Support


Provide analytical support for commercial negotiations, supplier reviews and tenders.
Support projects related to warehouse implementations and transportation optimisation through data analysis.
Deliver ad hoc analyses to support strategic and operational decision-making.


Continuous Improvement


Drive automation and standardisation of reporting processes.
Improve data quality and reporting accuracy, primarily in Power BI.
Identify opportunities to simplify processes and reduce manual work.


Who are you

You enjoy working with numbers but are equally motivated by understanding the business behind them. You are curious, structured and proactive, with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights that support decision-making. You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy improving processes rather than simply maintaining them.

You probably have:


2–4 years of experience in an analytical role within Supply Chain, Logistics, Commercial Operations, Finance or a similar function.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Advanced Excel skills.
Experience with Power BI or another BI platform.
A good understanding of financial processes, including cost analysis, budgeting and month-end reporting.
Experience supporting commercial decisions through analysis and business cases.
Excellent communication skills in Swedish and English.


How to apply

Application deadline: August 21st 2026

We review applications on an ongoing basis and may fill the position before the application deadline. We appreciate LinkedIn, but to get a full picture of your experience, we ask you to also include a CV.

Life at Vitamin Well Group

At Vitamin Well Group, we believe that a great workplace fuels great products. With over 750 employees worldwide, our people play an important role in how we build brands, develop products and grow the business. Our values – innovation, courage, drive and responsibility – shape how we work together and how we do business.

Across functions and markets, our teams are hands-on in building our brands, developing our products and making them available to consumers around the world. We embrace an office-first principle because we believe our best ideas emerge when people come together, share ideas, build relationships and take ownership.

Promoting active lifestyles is part of our culture. Employees can take part in run clubs, group workouts, races and sporting events that suit different interests and fitness levels. As we continue to grow, we aim to make a positive impact by reducing our environmental footprint, promoting active and healthy lifestyles, and acting responsibly across our value chain.

As part of the recruitment process, we may ask you to conduct a personality test as well as a test that measures logical ability. The purpose of the tests is to evaluate candidates as objective as possible and identify the best possible match for the role. The tests are based on solid research and are taken through our partner Alva Labs.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Do you enjoy turning data into something people can actually use to make better decisions?




At Jobylon, you'll join at a point where data is becoming increasingly important to both our customers and our product. The foundation is there, but there's still plenty left to build.




You'll be the person responsible for turning raw data into reporting that helps companies understand and improve their hiring. Some of the challenges are technical: building scalable pipelines, reliable models, and performant queries. Others are about understanding what customers actually need to measure and making sure the right data is available when they need it.




You'll have significant ownership from day one and a chance to shape how data is collected, modeled, and used across our products.




About the job




You'll own the data domain at Jobylon.




Rather than joining a large data team with narrowly defined responsibilities, you'll have the opportunity to shape how data flows through our products and ultimately reaches our customers.




A big part of your work will be building the next generation of reporting. You'll help create the metrics customers rely on to understand their hiring performance, workforce planning, and recruitment processes.




You'll work with data from across our products and make sure it moves reliably from source systems into scalable models that support analytics and reporting. As new products, customers, and use cases are added, you'll help ensure the data platform is ready to support them.




You'll collaborate closely with backend developers, product teams, and engineering leadership to understand business needs and turn them into something measurable and actionable.




You'll primarily work with Python and SQL, alongside modern data tools and warehouse technologies. The focus, however, isn't the technology itself. It's making sure customers can trust the data they're looking at and use it to make better decisions.




Most days are spent in deep focus work rather than meetings, giving you plenty of space to solve problems, improve systems, and build things properly.






Skills & Requirements



About you




You have several years of experience as a Data Engineer, building data products, analytics platforms, or data warehouse solutions.




You're comfortable working with Python, SQL, relational databases, and scalable data models.




You understand that good data engineering is about more than moving data from one place to another. You enjoy understanding the problem behind the request and making sure the end result creates value for the people using it.




You're comfortable taking ownership and driving your area forward independently. At the same time, you enjoy collaborating with developers and product teams to find the best solutions together.




You speak and write English fluently, as it's our working language.




To be considered for the role, you also need to be based in the Stockholm area and able to visit our office regularly. Unfortunately, we're unable to provide relocation or visa sponsorship for this position.

Title: Data Steward
Description:
Job Description

At Electrolux, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.

Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute and grow together.

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home!

Data Steward

We are currently looking for a Data Steward whose main goal will be to establish clear ownership and accountability for workforce data quality across HR, ensuring each data domain is actively managed, governed, and trusted. The Data Steward operationalises the domain ownership model, working across HR to embed consistent standards, resolve data quality issues, and build confidence in the workforce data that underpins reporting, analytics, and strategic decision-making.

Why this role matters?

Ownership of workforce data has shifted to a domain ownership model, where each domain is accountable for the quality, accuracy, and integrity of its own data. Responsibility for enabling and governing this ownership now sits within the Analytics team, as part of the broader HR Operating Model changes.

Historically, workforce data quality has lacked clear ownership and accountability — resulting in inconsistent standards, poor data quality, and limited confidence in reporting and insights. Without dedicated stewardship, domain ownership risks remaining unclear and inconsistently applied across HR.

You will join a team of 4 and report directly to HR Analytics Manager.

Main responsibilities:

Data Quality Governance


Define and maintain workforce data quality standards across HR domains
Establish data quality KPIs and thresholds in collaboration with domain owners
Conduct regular data quality assessments and produce governance reporting
Own the data quality issue log — tracking, prioritising, and driving resolution


Domain Ownership Enablement


Support HR domain owners in understanding and fulfilling their data accountability
Develop onboarding materials, guidance, and toolkits for domain owners
Run enablement sessions and provide ongoing coaching to embed data ownership practices
Serve as the primary point of contact for domain owners on data quality matters


Standards & Definitions


Maintain the HR data dictionary — ensuring consistent definitions across all domains
Govern data entry standards and validation rules in HR systems (incl. Workday)
Identify and resolve definitional inconsistencies across reporting and analytics outputs
Partner with HR Technology and IT to implement system-level data quality controls


Monitoring & Issue Resolution


Design and operate data quality monitoring routines across HR data domains
Escalate systemic or unresolved issues to the Head of HR Strategy, Data & Technology
Coordinate with domain owners and technical teams to investigate root causes
Track issue resolution and report on progress against quality targets


Cross-Functional Coordination


Act as the bridge between HR, IT, and Finance on workforce data quality topics
Coordinate with the Analytics team to ensure reporting is built on trusted data
Represent HR data governance in relevant forums and working groups
Support audit and compliance activities relating to workforce data integrity


Continuous Improvement


Identify and implement improvements to data collection, validation, and maintenance processes
Monitor industry developments in HR data governance and propose relevant adoption
Build a continuous improvement cycle for workforce data quality, supported by metrics


Requirements:


Experience in data governance, data quality management, or a related HR analytics role
Understanding of HR data domains (e.g. headcount, compensation, performance, learning)
Ability to translate data governance concepts into practical, operational processes
Strong stakeholder management — able to engage and influence without direct authority
Experience working with HR information systems (Workday preferred)
Structured approach to problem-solving and issue resolution
Clear written and verbal communication skills in English
Exposure to HR analytics, reporting, or BI tooling or experience in data engineering, experience in a global or matrixed organisation and knowledge of global and local data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, local privacy laws) regarding the handling of sensitive employee information are an additional asset


Where you'll be:

This is a full-time position, based at Kungsholmen in Stockholm, Sweden.

We work with 20% work-place flexibility, fostering collaboration and a strong team spirit at our Global Headquarters.

We are 60+ nationalities under the same roof and we enjoy the look and feel of the office! You will be part of a dynamic international team where English is the natural language.

As an Electrolux Group employee, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

Please send your CV in English.

Title: Data Engineer (m/f/d)| Legal AI Tech Scale-Up | Full Remote
Description:
Your team

As a Data Engineer (f/d/m), you will play a key role in our Data Expansion Squad, which is responsible for integrating and operationalizing legal data from multiple jurisdictions. The team transforms heterogeneous source data into a unified, high-quality foundation that powers search, retrieval, and AI-supported workflows across our products.

Felix, our VP AI & Data Engineering, will guide you through your journey at Noxtua. With deep expertise in AI systems, Felix leads with a passion for innovation and a collaborative approach, ensuring every team member thrives.

You will work closely with AI, engineering, and legal domain experts to adapt and extend existing data workflows for new customer datasets and source formats. Your work will focus on understanding source structures, defining robust mappings, standardizing and enriching content, and ensuring that data is integrated in a way that is reliable, scalable, and easy to use in downstream systems. Our Tech Team of around 32 people, including UI Engineers, UI Designers, AI Engineers, Data Engineers, as well as Fullstack, Backend, and DevOps Engineers. Within that team, the Data Expansion Team provides the data foundation, structure, and metadata needed for our agent-based systems to retrieve relevant legal information efficiently and reliably across jurisdictions.

About You


Experience: at least 2 years of professional experience in data engineering, and being involved in successfully deployed projects
Programming: Strong Python skills with experience in designing robust data pipelines
Technical Expertise: Experience in building and maintaining reliable ET and RAG pipelines and a solid understanding of data modeling, quality, filtering, validation, and consistency
Infrastructure: Familiarity with containerization (Docker), CI/CD pipelines, and version control (Git)
Fundamentals: Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, system design principles, and software engineering best practices
Expertise in working with graph databases and familiarity with developing and deploying NLP models is a bonus
Language: English proficiency at the C2 level


Your Responsibilities


Design, build, and optimize end-to-end ETL pipelines for legal data from multiple jurisdictions, including cleaning, transformation, chunking, validation, embedding, and ingestion into vector databases
Work extensively with XML-based legal data feeds: parse, validate, normalize, and transform XML structures into scalable internal schemas and unified document formats
Develop and maintain data models and storage schemas that support continuously updated datasets while ensuring consistency, scalability, and accuracy across diverse datasets and large amounts of data
Coordinate data handover and integration from multiple internal and external data providers, including official sources, APIs, and web scraping pipelines, ensuring reliable and timely updates
Implement and continuously refine metadata enrichment strategies to maximize searchability, ranking quality, and relevance of legal information in vector databases.
Build and maintain a high-performance search and retrieval infrastructure enabling agent-based systems to call search functions and retrieve the most relevant legal information efficiently
Collaborate with product, AI, and legal domain experts to deliver high-quality, reliable data solutions
Own the data integration of one jurisdiction end-to-end


Our offer to you

Building Europe's sovereign Legal AI is ambitious, meaningful work — and we want the people doing it to be properly looked after. Our benefits are built around flexibility, real-time off to recharge, and the setup to do your best work from wherever you are.


Remote: 100% remote work possible (given a German residence), other countries upon request
Working hours: Flexible working hours
Vacation: 26 days + December 24th & 31st off, + 1 additional vacation day per year of employment (up to 30 days)
Discounts: e.g., Urban Sports Club Membership, depending on location
Equipment: Laptop (Lenovo or Mac), plus €1,000 net home office setup budget (paid with your first salary)


Mid-Level Salary Ranges gross per year:


Germany: €58k – €72k EUR
France: €48k – €59k EUR
Switzerland: 77k – 96k CHF (≈ €75k – €93k EUR)
Sweden: 667k – 828k SEK (≈ €58k – €72k EUR)
Austria: €57k – €71k EUR
Italy: €46k – €58k EUR
Poland: 168k – 209k PLN (≈ €39k – €48k EUR)
Croatia: €35k – €43k EUR
Slovakia: €34k – €42k EUR


The actual offer within the range depends on your relevant experience, demonstrated impact, and interview outcome — not on negotiation skill or gender. In line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, we are happy to discuss the criteria for placement within the range during the interview process.

For other countries you will get the information within your invitation to a potential interview.

About Us

Noxtua is Europe’s sovereign Legal AI. This legally competent AI covers the entire spectrum of legal text work – from information gathering (research) and analysis of complex issues (understanding) to document creation (drafting). The legally compliant AI meets the professional, criminal, and data protection requirements for lawyers (e.g. Section 203 German Criminal Code, Section 43e German Federal Code for Lawyers), is certified according to BSI C5, TISAX, ISO 27001, 9001, 27018, 27017, and 42001. The tech company Noxtua has formed exclusive partnerships with leading European publishing houses from Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Poland, the Czech Republic, and Slovakia for the Legal AI Workspaces Beck-Noxtua, MANZ-Noxtua, Swiss-Noxtua, Beck-Noxtua Poland, Beck-Noxtua Czech Republic and Beck-Noxtua Slovakia.

Founded in 2017 in the German capital as a result of a research project by Dr. Leif-Nissen Lundbæk and Professor Dr. Michael Huth at Oxford University and Imperial College London, the European legal tech company has many years of experience in developing GDPR-compliant AI solutions and now has offices in Paris, Berlin, Zagreb, and Munich. Strategic partners including Germany’s leading legal publisher C.H.BECK as well as the leading law firms CMS and Dentons have invested around 81 million EURO in the European scaleup as part of its Series B.

We explicitly encourage women to apply, as they are currently underrepresented. Our goal is to build a diverse and inclusive work environment that values different perspectives. Of course, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals – regardless of gender, ethnic origin, religion, disability, age, or sexual identity.

Within that team, the Data Expansion Team provides the data foundation, structure, and metadata needed for our agent-based systems to retrieve relevant legal information efficiently and reliably across jurisdictions.

About You

  • Experience: at least 2 years of professional experience in data engineering, and being involved in successfully deployed projects
  • Programming: Strong Python skills with experience in designing robust data pipelines
  • Technical Expertise: Experience in building and maintaining reliable ET and RAG pipelines and a solid understanding of data modeling, quality, filtering, validation, and consistency
  • Infrastructure: Familiarity with containerization (Docker), CI/CD pipelines, and version control (Git)
  • Fundamentals: Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, system design principles, and software engineering best practices
  • Expertise in working with graph databases and familiarity with developing and deploying NLP models is a bonus
  • Language: English proficiency at the C2 level

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and optimize end-to-end ETL pipelines for legal data from multiple jurisdictions, including cleaning, transformation, chunking, validation, embedding, and ingestion into vector databases
  • Work extensively with XML-based legal data feeds: parse, validate, normalize, and transform XML structures into scalable internal schemas and unified document formats
  • Develop and maintain data models and storage schemas that support continuously updated datasets while ensuring consistency, scalability, and accuracy across diverse datasets and large amounts of data
  • Coordinate data handover and integration from multiple internal and external data providers, including official sources, APIs, and web scraping pipelines, ensuring reliable and timely updates
  • Implement and continuously refine metadata enrichment strategies to maximize searchability, ranking quality, and relevance of legal information in vector databases.
  • Build and maintain a high-performance search and retrieval infrastructure enabling agent-based systems to call search functions and retrieve the most relevant legal information efficiently
  • Collaborate with product, AI, and legal domain experts to deliver high-quality, reliable data solutions
  • Own the data integration of one jurisdiction end-to-end

Our offer to you

Building Europe's sovereign Legal AI is ambitious, meaningful work — and we want the people doing it to be properly looked after. Our benefits are built around flexibility, real-time off to recharge, and the setup to do your best work from wherever you are.

  • Remote: 100% remote work possible (given a German residence), other countries upon request
  • Working hours: Flexible working hours
  • Vacation: 26 days + December 24th & 31st off, + 1 additional vacation day per year of employment (up to 30 days)
  • Discounts: e.g., Urban Sports Club Membership, depending on location
  • Equipment: Laptop (Lenovo or Mac), plus €1,000 net home office setup budget (paid with your first salary)

Mid-Level Salary Ranges gross per year:

  • Germany: €58k – €72k EUR
  • France: €48k – €59k EUR
  • Switzerland: 77k – 96k CHF (≈ €75k – €93k EUR)
  • Sweden: 667k – 828k SEK (≈ €58k – €72k EUR)
  • Austria: €57k – €71k EUR
  • Italy: €46k – €58k EUR
  • Poland: 168k – 209k PLN (≈ €39k – €48k EUR)
  • Croatia: €35k – €43k EUR
  • Slovakia: €34k – €42k EUR

The actual offer within the range depends on your relevant experience, demonstrated impact, and interview outcome — not on negotiation skill or gender. In line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, we are happy to discuss the criteria for placement within the range during the interview process.

For other countries you will get the information within your invitation to a potential interview.

About Us

Noxtua is Europe’s sovereign Legal AI. This legally competent AI covers the entire spectrum of legal text work – from information gathering (research) and analysis of complex issues (understanding) to document creation (drafting). The legally compliant AI meets the professional, criminal, and data protection requirements for lawyers (e.g. Section 203 German Criminal Code, Section 43e German Federal Code for Lawyers), is certified according to BSI C5, TISAX, ISO 27001, 9001, 27018, 27017, and 42001. The tech company Noxtua has formed exclusive partnerships with leading European publishing houses from Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Poland, the Czech Republic, and Slovakia for the Legal AI Workspaces Beck-Noxtua, MANZ-Noxtua, Swiss-Noxtua, Beck-Noxtua Poland, Beck-Noxtua Czech Republic and Beck-Noxtua Slovakia.

Founded in 2017 in the German capital as a result of a research project by Dr. Leif-Nissen Lundbæk and Professor Dr. Michael Huth at Oxford University and Imperial College London, the European legal tech company has many years of experience in developing GDPR-compliant AI solutions and now has offices in Paris, Berlin, Zagreb, and Munich. Strategic partners including Germany’s leading legal publisher C.H.BECK as well as the leading law firms CMS and Dentons have invested around 81 million EURO in the European scaleup as part of its Series B.

We explicitly encourage women to apply, as they are currently underrepresented. Our goal is to build a diverse and inclusive work environment that values different perspectives. Of course, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals – regardless of gender, ethnic origin, religion, disability, age, or sexual identity.

Flerårig erfarenhet av att arbeta med moderna dataplattformar och molnbaserade datalösningar i Azure och/eller AWS.

Flytande svenska i tal och skrift samt god professionell kunskap i engelska.
Meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att jobba med Azure AI Search och Microsoft Foundry.

En kultur som präglas av närhet, samarbete och ett genuint kunskapsutbyte mellan kollegor

Title: Senior Data Analyst in Content Data
Description:
emagine is looking for a Senior data analyst for our client in the Media industry

Start: ASAP (Cover a parental leave for 6-12 month)

Location: Stockholm, hybrid

This is a Replacement for a Senior Data Analyst in Content Data. The client need someone who can hit the ground running and work independently from the start. The ideal candidate can support traditional data analysis and experimentation, while also contributing to data engineering tasks when needed.

Responsibilities


Primarily support the Text Experience team, while also supporting other teams within Content Data (e.g. Video and Audio)
Support and guide a more junior Data Analyst in Text Experience
Design, run, and evaluate experiments at scale.
Identify opportunities to improve user experience, engagement, and business performance

Experience with Python or a similar programming language
Experience with agentic development is a big plus
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
Ability to connect data insights to editorial, product, and business goals
Experience from the media industry is an advantage

Title: Total Rewards Analyst
Description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.


We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The role

As Total Rewards Analyst, you'll be the analytical backbone of Legora's reward function — turning data into insight across compensation, equity, benefits, and mobility. You'll work directly within the Total Rewards team, reporting to the VP of Total Rewards, and collaborate closely with the Total Rewards Manager.

This is a role for someone who is energised by making sense of complex data, building robust processes, and making sure every part of our reward engine runs smoothly and accurately.

What You Will Do


Build and maintain reward reporting and dashboards covering compensation, equity, benefits, and mobility — enabling the team and leadership to make data-informed decisions.
Support compensation benchmarking cycles: gather and clean market data, model scenarios, and present findings clearly.
Analyse equity data to track grant activity, vesting milestones, and programme performance across regions.
Build and improve People operations processes across the reward function — creating workflows and documentation that reduce manual effort and increase accuracy.
Support the administration of benefits programmes across markets, coordinating with external vendors and ensuring data accuracy.
Support the mobility programme operationally — coordinating documentation, timelines, and third-party providers.
Help prepare materials for employee and manager communications on compensation, benefits, and equity topics, and contribute to reward-related compliance activities as needed.


Who You Are

You love digging into data to find patterns and build clarity out of complexity. You're a natural problem-solver with a keen eye for process, accuracy, and making things run better.

We Think You'll Thrive Here If You Have


3–5 years of experience in a People, Reward, Finance, or Operations analyst role — ideally in a high-growth or international environment.
Strong analytical skills with experience handling complex datasets; proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets is essential, and experience with HRIS or reward tools is a plus.
Familiarity with compensation frameworks, equity programmes, or benefits administration — even if not a specialist in all areas.
High attention to detail and comfort working with sensitive, confidential data.
A process-builder mindset: you don't just do the work, you look for ways to make the work better.
Clear and confident communicator, able to present data and findings simply to a range of stakeholders.


Why Legora

This is an exceptional opportunity to grow within a reward function that's building from the ground up. You'll gain broad exposure across every dimension of total rewards — compensation, equity, benefits, and mobility — while working alongside experienced people leaders in a company with real momentum.

We value clarity, humility, and impact. Your work will directly support the team that shapes how every Legora employee is rewarded. We're just getting started.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Title: Quantitative Analyst to the IFRS 9 team | SEB, Stockholm
Description:
Are you a data-driven credit risk professional with a passion for model development?

We are looking for a Quantitative Analyst to join the Expected Credit Loss (ECL) team within Credit Risk, with a primary focus on IFRS 9 model development.

Since SEB was founded in 1856, our focus on customers and long-term relationships has been at the heart of our success. We aim to drive positive change by providing capital to help everyone reach their goals and accelerate progress towards a sustainable tomorrow. As a leading financial services group in northern Europe, we'll help you grow and empower you to take on more responsibility to create a real difference. Welcome to SEB.

About The Role

In this role, you will contribute directly to the development and refinement of the Bank’s expected credit loss models. You will combine quantitative analysis with hands-on model development and tooling.

Main responsibilities include:


Develop, enhance, and maintain IFRS 9 ECL models and methodologies
Analyse model performance and support calibration, including overlays
Build analytical tools and data solutions
Support integration of models into reporting processes


To thrive in this role, we believe you have


Experience in credit risk modelling / IFRS 9 / ECL
Strong quantitative and analytical skillset with a focus on model development
Structured, proactive, and delivery-oriented - Able to communicate complex modelling topics clearly
Experience working with data and tools such as SQL, SAS, or Python


What we offer:


A central role in the Bank’s IFRS 9 model development
Broad exposure across risk, finance, and business
A collaborative and supportive team environment
Attractive compensation and benefits


Do you want to be part of SEB?

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.

Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today via the link in this ad, but no later than 2026-08-31. If you have questions about the position, please contact Daniel Odelfalk, Head of ECL & Stress-testing, daniel.odelfalk@seb.se, but we will not process applications via email.

 

Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and criminal records checks. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks.

Learn more about working at SEB on our Career website or through our Career podcasts.

Om tjänsten

Fortnox behöver förstå hur våra produkter skapar värde, och det börjar med data som går att lita på. Produktanalysteamet bygger den grunden, och vi söker en Analytics Engineer som äger den. Det du modellerar i dbt idag blir kontextlagret som AI-agenter konsumerar imorgon.

Vi söker en person som trivs i en teknisk roll och vill bygga datafundamentet för att:


Bygga datamodeller i dbt och BigQuery. Basmodeller som hela organisationen konsumerar. Tydliga namn, dokumentation och tester.

Äga produktdomänen i dataplattformen. Du ansvarar för struktur, standards och kvalitet för allt som rör produkt, så att andra team kan lita på modellerna.

Du kommunicerar flytande i svenska och engelska i såväl tal som skrift.

Vi ser det även som positivt om du har: erfarenhet av BigQuery/GCP. Nyfikenhet på att bygga BI-as-code, istället för att klicka i ett BI-verktyg. Vi tittar på verktyg i den riktningen, som Lightdash eller Evidence, och på rapportering direkt via Claude. Med smarta tekniska lösningar för företag och redovisningsbyråer, smidig finansiering och ett ekosystem av starka partnerskap är Fortnox ett nav för företagande i Sverige. Vi drivs av visionen om ett välmående samhälle format av framgångsrika företag.

Fortnox grundades 2001 med huvudkontor i Växjö. Läs mer på www.fortnoxgroup.com.

Urvalsprocessen beräknar vi påbörja i mitten av augusti, därför kan återkoppling på din ansökan dröja.

Behandling av personuppgifter

Vi på Fortnox värnar om din personliga integritet. När du skickar in din ansökan till oss kommer vi att behandla dina personuppgifter för att administrera rekryteringsprocessen. Personuppgiftsansvarig är det bolag som du söker arbete hos och är något bolag inom Fortnoxkoncernen. Du kan läsa integritetsmeddelandet i sin helhet på följande länk:

https://apps.fortnox.se/api/eula/document-v1/privacy-policy-recruiting
