Title: Quantitative Risk Analyst, Credit Risk Data Management [Assistant/Regular/Senior]
Description:
Job ID: 5814

We are looking for Quantitative Risk Analyst [Assistant/Regular/Senior] from all background and level to join our Risk Models Data and Strategy teams that is recognized for its professionalism, competence and capabilities.

Do you enjoy working with data analysis? Do you like solving problems and finding new and innovative solutions? Do you understand the principles of banking and are you able to apply this knowledge in your daily work?

If you have previous experience with Credit Risk models, then great! If you have a flair for data and a genuine interest in analysis, you are also welcome!

About Our Team

Meet the Credit Risk Data Management, a part of the Risk Models Data & Strategy organization in Risk Models. We have an ambitious development plan for development of IRB models and together with our colleagues in Nordea we’ll be part of creating the future of banking.

The Risk Models Data & Strategy department, is a department consisting of 6 team, each specialized in their own part of ensuring high quality data is supporting the bank capital foundation. We add value to Nordea and our customers by improving Nordea data quality, helping visualizing and create the understanding of our data so modelling teams can build great internal models used for Own Funds calculation and the for risk management.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. 

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Quantitative Risk Analyst, the specific role may vary based on qualifications, but you could i.e. play a valuable role in Data analytics, optimizing data flows, product management or as a data governance specialist. Your role could also include coordinating data related activities and ensuring proper communication within the teams and across other Risk Models areas.

Main responsibilities in this role:


Root-cause analysis for data quality issues, where we meticulously investigate and identify the underlying reasons for any discrepancies in our data. This is closely followed by data reconciliation, ensuring that our data sets are consistent and accurate across different sources.
We focus on optimizing data flows and algorithms to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our data processes.
Own and manage all data used in credit risk models across the end-to-end lifecycle, applying data product mindset to capture, enhance and realize value throughout credit risk models.
Identify and govern critical data elements though strong knowledge of credit risk models, regulatory expectation and capital.
Secure our Data Governance framework and processes with focus on effective Data Quality Controls, also ensuring documentation of Data Lineage toward all data providers and consumers for credit risk data.
Preparing reports and other documentation for senior management and external reporting is also an integral part of our role, ensuring transparency and informed decision-making.


You’ll join an international team with variety of backgrounds and skills. We believe that strong drive and passion for change are fundamental for delivering on our commitments. Bring your background and skills to our team, and you will have plenty of opportunities to collaborate, grow and develop.

Who You Are

This is the right role for you if you:


Have an adaptability to thrive in fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Are structured and able to coordinate several deliveries simultaneously.
Are self-driven and able to work independently but also enjoy collaboration with others.
Have strong analytical skills and keen attention to detail with the ability to analyse complex data and processes to derive meaningful insights.
Have good communication and presentations skills, are not afraid to speak up and can effectively convey business requirements to IT teams and facilitate collaboration between stakeholders.
Are curious and proactive, focus on solutions rather than problems and share our enthusiasm for developing and learning and constantly improving your skills and competences.


Your background and skills include:


Experience with Credit Risk modeling, capital reporting, and understanding regulatory requirements as BCBS239 and TRIM.
Knowledge of SQL, SAS, Snowflake, Python or similar.
Master’s degree in finance, economics, engineering, physics, mathematics or similar.
A strong focus on results, deliveries and deadlines.
Experience with Big Data would be an asset.
An interest in finance and technology.


What We Offer

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 09/09/2026.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

Only for candidates in Sweden: For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

Only for candidates in Poland: Please include permit for processing personal data in CV as following:

The administrator of your personal data is: Nordea Bank Abp operating in Poland through its Branch, address: Aleja Edwarda Rydza Śmiglego 20, 93-281 Łodź. Your personal data will be processed for the recruitment processes in Nordea Bank Abp. You have a right to access your personal data, right to rectify and right to delete. Disclosing the personal data in the scope specified by the provisions of Polish Labour Code from 26 June 1974 and executive acts are mandatory. Providing personal data is necessary to conduct the recruitment processes. Title: Commercial Operations Analyst - Vitamin Well Group
Description:
Vitamin Well Group develops premium functional drinks, snacks and protein products designed for modern, everyday life and on-the-go consumption. Our portfolio includes Barebells, NOCCO and Vitamin Well. With over 750 employees and revenue of more than SEK 10 billion, we are present in over 50 markets, with our headquarters in Stockholm and local teams and partners around the world. Our growth is driven by a focus on building strong brands, creating products with uncompromising taste and clear functionality, and consistently raising the bar across our categories.

As we continue expanding globally, we are strengthening our Commercial Operations team with a Commercial Operations Analyst who enjoys turning data into insights and driving better business decisions.

About The Role

Data and insights play an increasingly important role in how we make commercial decisions. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues across Commercial, Supply Chain and Finance to provide reporting and insights that help us understand performance, identify opportunities and make better commercial decisions.

From distribution cost analysis and financial reporting to business cases and process improvements, you will transform data into actionable insights that improve the way we work and enable better commercial decisions across our global organisation.

What you'll do

Commercial Performance & Analytics


Own and continuously develop distribution cost reporting across our global markets.
Analyse logistics and distribution costs to identify trends, risks and improvement opportunities.
Build business cases to support commercial negotiations and strategic initiatives.
Develop dashboards and performance reporting for stakeholders across the business.


Financial Control & Governance


Coordinate month-end logistics cost closing activities.
Validate invoices and support approval processes.
Monitor logistics spend against budgets and contracts.
Support accruals, forecasting and financial reporting.


Business Support


Provide analytical support for commercial negotiations, supplier reviews and tenders.
Support projects related to warehouse implementations and transportation optimisation through data analysis.
Deliver ad hoc analyses to support strategic and operational decision-making.


Continuous Improvement


Drive automation and standardisation of reporting processes.
Improve data quality and reporting accuracy, primarily in Power BI.
Identify opportunities to simplify processes and reduce manual work.


Who are you

You enjoy working with numbers but are equally motivated by understanding the business behind them. You are curious, structured and proactive, with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights that support decision-making. You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy improving processes rather than simply maintaining them.

You probably have:


2–4 years of experience in an analytical role within Supply Chain, Logistics, Commercial Operations, Finance or a similar function.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Advanced Excel skills.
Experience with Power BI or another BI platform.
A good understanding of financial processes, including cost analysis, budgeting and month-end reporting.
Experience supporting commercial decisions through analysis and business cases.
Excellent communication skills in Swedish and English.


How to apply

Application deadline: August 21st 2026

We review applications on an ongoing basis and may fill the position before the application deadline. We appreciate LinkedIn, but to get a full picture of your experience, we ask you to also include a CV.

Life at Vitamin Well Group

At Vitamin Well Group, we believe that a great workplace fuels great products. With over 750 employees worldwide, our people play an important role in how we build brands, develop products and grow the business. Our values – innovation, courage, drive and responsibility – shape how we work together and how we do business.

Across functions and markets, our teams are hands-on in building our brands, developing our products and making them available to consumers around the world. We embrace an office-first principle because we believe our best ideas emerge when people come together, share ideas, build relationships and take ownership.

Promoting active lifestyles is part of our culture. Employees can take part in run clubs, group workouts, races and sporting events that suit different interests and fitness levels. As we continue to grow, we aim to make a positive impact by reducing our environmental footprint, promoting active and healthy lifestyles, and acting responsibly across our value chain.

As part of the recruitment process, we may ask you to conduct a personality test as well as a test that measures logical ability. The purpose of the tests is to evaluate candidates as objective as possible and identify the best possible match for the role. The tests are based on solid research and are taken through our partner Alva Labs.

Title: Credit Risk Analyst - NPL
Description:
NOBA Bank Group is looking for a curious and driven Credit Risk Analyst with a strong interest in analyzing and managing Non-Performing Loans (NPLs). You will join the Group Portfolio Analytics team, responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the analytics and reporting infrastructure that supports NOBA's continued growth and sound risk management.

NOBA holds a market-leading position in the Nordics, and the NPL team manages a substantial share of the region's non-performing loan portfolios, amounting to a net value of c. 11bn SEK. This role offers hands-on exposure to large, complex portfolios, high-quality data, and analytical work that directly influences both commercial and risk-related decisions – a strong platform to deepen a career in credit risk.

You will be part of a talented group of experienced and highly skilled colleagues across the organization, who will support your development as you help shape decision-making and drive continuous improvements in how NPL portfolios are analyzed, managed, and finally divested.

About The Role

As a Credit Risk Analyst at NOBA, you will play an active role in developing and strengthening how NPL portfolios are managed across the bank. Working closely with a cross-functional NPL team, you will combine hands-on data analysis with growing business understanding to deliver insights that support portfolio performance, strategy, and sales activities related to NPLs. You will work alongside experienced colleagues across the organization and have the support to make an impact quickly.

Main Tasks


Delivering data-driven insights to help maximize value creation from NOBA's NPL portfolio
Building and developing a strong understanding of collection data across countries and brands
Supporting the design, maintenance, and continuous improvement of group-wide NPL reporting, covering:
Debt collection performance
Group NPE strategy
Performance of securitized NPL portfolios
Helping ensure availability, accuracy, and consistency of data and reports across the Group
Supporting NPL sales and divestments, including analytical and reporting deliverables
Collaborating closely with internal stakeholders such as Risk Control, Finance, Collections, Underwriting, and Data Engineering
Working with external debt collection agencies and partners on data extraction, quality, and reporting

We Are Looking For You Who


Have a track record in analytical roles, whether gained early in your career or over several years
Hold a degree in Industrial Engineering and Management ("Industriell ekonomi") or another quantitative discipline (engineering, economics, statistics, or similar)
Have good technical skills in one or more of: SQL, Python, R (SAS is a plus but not required)
Are self-driven, solution-oriented, and able to prioritize independently
Have a genuine interest in banking, credit risk, and data-driven decision-making
Communicate well and enjoy collaborating with different stakeholders
Are professionally proficient in English and at least one Scandinavian language


We welcome applicants at different levels — remuneration is set according to seniority and experience.

It's Positive If You Also Bring


Interest in or exposure to regulatory/financial reporting (e.g. SFSA)
Experience with statistical methods such as A/B testing or regression analysis, from coursework or projects
Interest in or experience working across Nordic markets


To thrive and perform well in the role, we believe that:

You are curious, eager to learn, and enjoy taking ownership of your work from day one. You build trust through clear communication and collaboration, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and can balance a hands-on, detail-oriented approach with an interest in the bigger strategic picture. If you want real responsibility and impact in credit risk at one of Europe's largest specialist banks, this role is for you.

In addition to this, it is important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead.

Have you heard of NOBAVERSE?

In our NOBAVERSE, we value openness, trust, and diversity. Here, you can influence your own development and have fun along the way to achieving our goals – all in a workplace that’s a little extra bubbly! ✨

Read more about our employee value proposition on our careers page.

Read more about how our recruitment process works in the FAQ.

We care for your privacy and, with reference to the GDPR, would like to ask you not to include any sensitive personal data in your application, for examples information about ethnic origin, political opinions, religious beliefs or information about your health.

Read more about how we handle your personal data here.

If you have any questions or concerns about the position, please contact the responsible recruiter.

We look forward to receiving your application! 🙏✨

Title: Junior Commercial Analyst
Description:
Are you a recent graduate and eager to embark on your first full-time journey into the world of analytics? Or perhaps you're a junior specialist seeking new challenges and a fresh environment? Look no further than the opportunity to join our Commercial Excellence Team as a Junior Commercial Analyst at DANX Carousel Group.

This pivotal role within our Commercial Excellence department is tailor-made for individuals like you, hungry for learning opportunities and growth potential within our group. Whether you're just out of university or taking your initial steps along your career path, we're seeking candidates with a passion for analysis, sharp commercial acumen, and a drive to succeed.

As a Junior Commercial Analyst, you'll be at the forefront of revolutionizing the logistics industry through innovative solutions and data-driven strategies. We're searching for individuals with an analytical mindset, strong critical thinking skills, and a knack for meeting deadlines while efficiently managing their time.

Join us and kickstart your career with unparalleled opportunities for professional development and advancement within our dynamic organization.

Who We Are

DANX Carousel Group is a leading logistics specialist focused on time-critical solutions that aims to redefine industry standards. Our continuous focus on innovation, customer satisfaction, and market expansion has been instrumental in our growth. Our commercial entities operate across 35 countries, with offices strategically located throughout mainland Europe, the UK and Ireland. Through our constant commitment to ownership, learning, and care, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner within the European logistics space. Our vision is to become the leading pan-European specialist logistics provider, with the most comprehensive end-to-end solutions.

Key Responsibilities


RFQ data preparation: You drive crucial analyses and extract valuable insights based on customer data and requirements, used to make tangible commercial decisions, impacting the growth and profitability of the entire group, at the same time, ensuring that our customer-centric approach remains at the forefront of our business strategy.
Profitability simulations: You act as the conduit between operations, sales and senior management by facilitating business discussions and decisions on revenue/cost through flexible simulation models you will be building.
Market intelligence: You are at the forefront of logistics innovations, customer wishes and competitive dynamics through collecting micro- and macro-economical insights on the market internally and externally.


Your Skills And Qualifications


Minimum: a bachelor’s degree in economics, statistics, mathematics, industrial engineering, or any other quantitative relevant field.
Affinity for data analysis.
Advanced MS Excel proficiency and modelling:
Mastery of complex formulas, pivot tables, and data visualization.
Ability to create and maintain data models for in-depth analysis.
Macro- & micro-economic trends analysis and market research data collection:
Understanding of macroeconomic trends affecting the logistics industry.
Ability to analyse and interpret economic indicators, conduct interviews and other data collection methods to extract insights from the wider business (e.g. Sales, IT, Strategy, etc.).
Strong communication skills in English (spoken and written).
Problem-solving skills.
The ability to plan and work independently towards set goals.

Qualifications That Are Desirable


Previous experience in data analysis of large datasets and in pricing
Proven experience in RFQ (Request for Quotation) data analysis
Ability to conduct pricing, cost and profitability flexible simulations based on various factors.
Familiarity with advanced analytics tools and techniques (e.g., AI-driven pricing, machine learning, predictive modelling) for enhancing pricing strategies.
Master’s degree in relevant area.
Strong communication skills in one of the Nordic languages (spoken and written).

What We Offer

We offer you a familiar workplace where you become an essential part of our company. In our opinion, success is created through flexibility, good cooperation and commitment, where participation, responsiveness and the chance to influence drive us forward. We work in an open, positive, and inspiring environment with passionate colleagues who enjoy having fun at work. Something we are convinced benefits both profitability and ensures satisfied employees. We therefore organize kick-offs, Christmas dinners, and after-work events. Additionally, every month, we recognize outstanding achievements by crowning the Employee of the Month, as nominated by colleagues.

We have breakfast at all our locations in Sweden so that we can have a good start to the day together. We believe that an active life creates productivity and therefore encourage the use of the wellness allowance. We conduct exchanges between our locations and roles to create understanding, camaraderie, and educational opportunities. With us, there are great opportunities to grow and develop in the long run, where you set the limit for how far your ambitions can take you!

Practical Information


Start: The start date for the role is as soon as possible
Employment contract: Permanent with initial probationary period
Extent: Full-time.
Location: Månskärsvägen 5, 141 75 Kungens Kurva.
Recruiting process: We use competency-based interviews where your skills, knowledge and qualities relevant to DANX and the role will be assessed. After that, we carry out logical and personal tests that we go through together to build an even clearer picture of you as a candidate. We also do a background check on final candidate, as part of the process.
Application: If the position sounds interesting, send in your application today. Selection is being made on a running basis.
Contact: If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact our manager Leonel at leonel.andersson@danx.se or our HR department at HR@danx.se Please note that in line with GDPR, we do not accept applications via email.
Diploma: Please attach your university degree certificate (diploma) as proof of your qualification.


Please note that t he recruitment process may take longer than usual due to summer vacations.

We are processing this recruitment ourselves and do not wish for recruitment firms to contact us regarding this recruitment - nor interim consultancy firms. Thank you.

Title: CRM Analytics Lead
Description:
Gjensidige är ett av Nordens ledande försäkringsbolag noterade på Oslo Börs. Vi är verksamma i Sverige, Norge och Danmark och har totalt cirka 4600 medarbetare. I Sverige etablerades Gjensidige Försäkring år 2007. Här är vi cirka 300 medarbetare placerade i Stockholm, Luleå, Malmö eller Gävle och erbjuder försäkringsprodukter till privatpersoner och företag. Vi säkrar liv, hälsa och värden med utgångspunkt i vår vision "Vi ska känna kunden bäst och bry oss mest".

CRM Analytics Lead

Nu stärker vi vår CRM- och analysförmåga och söker en CRM Analytics Lead som vill ta en central roll i att utveckla datadrivna kundstrategier och avancerade analyslösningar. Vi är övertygade om att data, analys och AI kommer att vara avgörande för framtidens kundupplevelser och affärsutveckling inom försäkring.

Din roll

Som CRM Analytics Lead blir du en nyckelperson i allt från datautforskning till färdiga modeller i produktion. I rollen har du ett övergripande ansvar för kundanalys, insikter och modellering, och du samarbetar nära både affärens stakeholders och analytiker i andra delar av organisationen. Rollen passar dig som uppskattar variation, tar naturligt ägarskap och framför allt vill använda din kompetens för att skapa verkligt värde. Du kommer att tillhöra organisationen Marknad & Utveckling och rapportera till Chef CRM & Data.

Du kommer att:


Ta ansvar för hela kedjan: från datautforskning och modellutveckling till drift och uppföljning.
Utveckla och produktionssätta modeller för churn, retention, kundvärde, segmentering och NBO.
Analysera kund-, försäljnings- och försäkringsdata för att identifiera affärsmöjligheter.
Bygga robusta analyslösningar i Databricks med Python och SQL.
Utveckla dashboards och visualiseringar för ledning och verksamhet.
Arbeta med både stora datamängder och komplexa, ofullständiga dataset.
Utforska och implementera nya AI- och analysmetoder.
Vara en drivande kraft i utvecklingen av datadrivna arbetssätt och strategi inom CRM.



Vi söker dig som


Är självgående, tar egna initiativ och trivs med att äga både strategiska och operativa uppgifter.
Har erfarenhet av avancerad analys inom försäkring eller närliggande bransch.
Har erfarenhet av att bygga, validera och produktionssätta prediktiva modeller.
Har god förståelse för statistiska metoder och maskininlärning.
Trivs med att arbeta både strategiskt och operativt.
Omsätter idéer och analyser till handling och arbetar affärsnära för att skapa resultat.
Har en akademisk utbildning inom statistik, datavetenskap, matematik, teknisk fysik, industriell ekonomi eller motsvarande kvantitativ utbildning.



Därför ska du välja Gjensidige

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med några av försäkringsbranschens mest intressanta datautmaningar. Du får stort eget ansvar, moderna verktyg och möjlighet att påverka både teknikval och arbetssätt. Samtidigt blir du en del av en organisation där samarbete, utveckling och kundfokus står i centrum.

Vi hörs!

Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm.

Låter det intressant? Varmt välkommen med din ansökan senast den 13 september genom att skicka in ditt CV och svara på några frågor i samband med ansökan. Kontakta gärna rekryterande chef Andreas Stenberg, Andreas.Stenberg@gjensidige.se om du har funderingar om tjänsten. Intervjuer görs löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan.

Title: Data Engineer / BI Consultant
Description:
Vill du kombinera data, AI och affärsutveckling?

Är du en erfaren Data Engineer eller BI-konsult som drivs av att skapa affärsvärde – inte bara bygga tekniska lösningar? Vill du arbeta nära företagsledningar och hjälpa några av Sveriges största företag att fatta bättre beslut med hjälp av data? Då kan detta vara nästa steg i din karriär.

Vår kund är ett väletablerat managementkonsultbolag med specialistkompetens inom verksamhetsstyrning, lönsamhetsutveckling och beslutsstöd. Nu söker de en Data Engineer som vill vara med och utveckla deras satsning inom Data & AI samt bidra till den fortsatta tillväxten av Stockholmskontoret.




Om rollen

Du kommer att arbeta i gränslandet mellan teknik och affär, där ditt uppdrag är att hjälpa kunder att omvandla komplex data till beslutsunderlag som skapar verkligt affärsvärde.

Rollen handlar inte enbart om att bygga dataplattformar och pipelines. Du kommer även att analysera verksamheters behov, ta fram relevanta KPI och utveckla datamodeller som ger ledningsgrupper bättre beslutsunderlag.




Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat att innebära att:

Utforma datamodeller och moderna datalager i Azure.
Bygga lösningar för analys, rapportering och visualisering i Power BI.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Har du erfarenhet av att designa, utveckla och testa lösningar inom avancerad analys? Är du redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär med möjligheter och utveckling som ledord? Vill du, precis som vi, skapa affärsdrivna end-to-end lösningar som gör verklig skillnad? Då ser vi fram emot att höra ifrån dig!

Vem är du?

Du har ett genuint teknikintresse och drivs av att utvecklas tillsammans med ditt team. Du delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och är nyfiken på att lära dig av andra. Du är trygg i att ta ansvar för uppgifter där du får strukturera och identifiera affärsmässiga samt tekniska mål, och driva arbetet framåt. Du har lätt för att kommunicera resultat till olika målgrupper, oavsett teknisk nivå och du tar gärna ansvar för leveranser från start till mål.

Du är lösningsorienterad och ser alltid till att kunden får den bästa möjliga lösningen. Eftersom tjänsten även innehåller en och annan fika, tror vi att du gillar att nätverka med kollegor och tillsammans utforska nya idéer, erbjudanden och tjänster. Du är en lagspelare som gärna stöttar dina kollegor när behov uppstår.

Du brinner för att designa, implementera och agera rådgivare inom datalösningar för avancerad analys. Med en operativ inställning omfamnar du DevOps/MLOps och har ett starkt fokus på automation och end-to-end ägarskap.

Vi vill jobba med dig som


har 3+ års erfarenhet av design, utveckling och testning av avancerade BI-lösningar.
har erfarenhet av att implementera lösningar i exempelvis Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake & Snowflake.
har hands-on erfarenhet av programmering inom SQL och Python.
har erfarenhet av att hantera stora datamängder med hjälp av distribuerade ramverk, såsom Apache Spark, för att möjliggöra skalbar och effektiv databehandling.
behärskar svenska och engelska.
har erfarenhet av att utveckla Power BI-rapporter.


Ett plus om du har erfarenhet av


Data Vault
DBT (Data Build Tool)
Machine Learning och AI lösningar


Vårt team

I teamet Data-Driven Transformation samarbetar vi nära med våra kunder för att omvandla data till konkret värde vilket leder till tryggare beslut, effektivare arbetssätt och framgångsrika organisationer.

Vår ambition är att kombinera professionalism och entreprenörsanda och därigenom bidra med både kompetens och kreativitet. Vi strävar efter att vara en partner som inte bara levererar lösningar, utan också inspirerar till utveckling.

Vi är både rådgivare och teknisk partner inom data-drivna system, från design till implementation av lösningar för såväl avancerad analys som machine learning. Det kan handla om att samla in, strukturera och kvalitetssäkra data, skapa visuella rapporter eller möjliggöra mer proaktivt beslutsfattande.

Vårt team innehåller en dynamisk mix av erfarna experter och nya talanger, vilket skapar både energi och arbetsglädje i våra leveranser och interna initiativ. Vi tror på att växa tillsammans genom kompetensutveckling, kunskapsdelning och sociala aktiviteter som stärker både teamkänsla och konsultrollen.

Kompensation och förmåner

Vår förmånspolicy är utvecklad för att möta både dina professionella och personliga behov. I vårt omfattande förmånspaket ingår friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och frivillig sjukvårdsförsäkring. Vår ersättningsmodell består av en konkurrenskraftig fast del och en rörlig del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka din lön baserat på din prestation och ambition. Vi erbjuder både professionell och personlig utveckling.

Nyfiken? Vi svarar gärna på frågor, eller berättar mer om oss över en kaffe - du kan enkelt komma i kontakt med oss: tyra.drakenberg@accigo.se

Läs gärna mer om oss och träffa våra medarbetare på vår karriärsida: https://karriar.accigo.se/

Accigo är ett konsultbolag som hjälper företag och organisationer med digital affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling med tekniken som möjliggörare. För oss handlar digitalisering till 90% om människor och 10% om teknik. Det är när samspelet mellan människa och teknik fungerar som digitaliseringens fulla styrka visar sig.

För många handlar digitalisering mest om teknik. För oss är det så otroligt mycket större. Digitalisering kan få både människor och organisationer att våga sikta högre, följa sina drömmar och öppna dörrar som de inte ens visste fanns. Och när man ser igenom tekniken och börjar skönja vilka möjligheter som gömmer sig där bakom. Då ser man att framtiden kan vara en fantastisk plats – fylld av mänsklig energi och värme – och digitalisering är inget annat än vår superkraft för att komma dit.

Title: Analytics Engineer till UR i Stockholm
Description:
Vill du sätta din prägel på en helt ny Analytics Engineer-roll hos UR i Stockholm och skapa data som gör skillnad?

Vill du vara med från början och forma hur en modern data- och analysplattform ska fungera? Som Analytics Engineer på UR får du en nyckelroll i en omfattande satsning där hela datainfrastrukturen moderniseras. Du får möjlighet att bygga upp modelleringslagret, utveckla arbetssätt och skapa förutsättningar för datadrivna beslut i en verksamhet med ett viktigt samhällsuppdrag. Här blir du en del av ett engagerat team som arbetar nära varandra och där samarbete, nyfikenhet och kunskapsdelning står i fokus. Under din första tid får du stöd av en senior Analytics Engineer-konsult samtidigt som du successivt tar ägarskap över dbt-projektet och utvecklingen av modelleringslagret.

Vi erbjuder dig

Hos UR får du möjligheten att ta en viktig roll där du får stort inflytande över hur dataarbetet utvecklas framåt. Du blir en del av en strategisk satsning där BigQuery är det centrala datalagret och dbt Cloud transformeringsverktyget. Samtidigt blir du en del av ett kompetent och engagerat team som arbetar nära verksamheten och tillsammans driver utvecklingen framåt.


En unik möjlighet att bygga upp modelleringslagret från grunden.
En nyckelroll i moderniseringen av UR data- och analysplattform.
Ett engagerat team med nära samarbete och stort kunskapsutbyte.
Möjlighet att påverka arbetssätt, struktur och den fortsatta utvecklingen av dataplattformen.
Ett meningsfullt uppdrag där datadrivna insikter bidrar till UR verksamhet.



Det här gör du hos oss


Designar, bygger och underhåller datamodeller i dbt Cloud ovanpå BigQuery.
Implementerar KPI:er och mätetal enligt UR:s KPI-ramverk.
Säkerställer datakvalitet genom tester, dokumentation och tydliga konventioner.
Samarbetar nära dataingenjörer och analytiker kring datakällor, datakvalitet och verksamhetens behov.
Bidrar till den fortsatta utvecklingen av dataplattformen och dess arbetssätt.
Ansvarar för kvalitet, struktur och vidareutveckling av dbt-projektet.



Ditt team och arbetsplats

Du blir en del av Data & Analys-teamet på UR i Stockholm. Teamet arbetar tätt tillsammans med återkommande avstämningar och sprintplanering för att driva utvecklingen framåt. Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med dataingenjörer, analytiker och andra kollegor inom dataområdet. UR arbetar huvudsakligen från kontoret för att skapa goda förutsättningar för samarbete och snabba beslutsvägar.

Mer om dig

För att lyckas i rollen har du gedigen erfarenhet av datatransformering och modellering i dbt samt mycket goda kunskaper i SQL där du är van att skriva, optimera och underhålla komplexa frågor. Du har arbetat med molnbaserade datalager, exempelvis BigQuery, Snowflake eller Redshift, och har en relevant högskoleutbildning inom data, teknik eller statistik, alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och har goda kunskaper i engelska.

Vi tror också att du är nyfiken på ny teknik och vill utforska hur AI kan användas inom dataområdet. Eftersom rollen är ny trivs du med att vara med och bygga upp strukturer och arbetssätt, samtidigt som du uppskattar ett nära samarbete med andra. Du har ett kvalitetsmedvetet arbetssätt, en stark analytisk förmåga och motiveras av att skapa hållbara lösningar som gör data till en tillförlitlig grund för verksamhetens beslut.

Så här får vi kontakt

I den här rekryteringen har vi valt att samarbeta med Ada Digital som strävar efter en transparent, inkluderande och snabbrörlig rekryteringsupplevelse. Vi vill veta mer om dig och din potential! Du söker tjänsten enkelt och behöver inte bifoga några dokument. Det räcker med en motivering till varför du söker tjänsten och om du saknar CV kan du bifoga din LinkedIn-profil. Följ sedan din ansökan live via vår hemsida. Urvalet sker löpande och tjänsten kan bli tillsatt före sista ansökningsdatum. Är du nyfiken och vill veta mer innan du söker? Hör av dig till ansvarig rekryterare. Vi ser fram emot att få kontakt med dig!

  • Implementerar KPI:er och mätetal enligt UR:s KPI-ramverk.
  • Säkerställer datakvalitet genom tester, dokumentation och tydliga konventioner.
  • Samarbetar nära dataingenjörer och analytiker kring datakällor, datakvalitet och verksamhetens behov.
  • Bidrar till den fortsatta utvecklingen av dataplattformen och dess arbetssätt.
  • Ansvarar för kvalitet, struktur och vidareutveckling av dbt-projektet.


Ditt team och arbetsplats

Du blir en del av Data & Analys-teamet på UR i Stockholm. Teamet arbetar tätt tillsammans med återkommande avstämningar och sprintplanering för att driva utvecklingen framåt. Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med dataingenjörer, analytiker och andra kollegor inom dataområdet. UR arbetar huvudsakligen från kontoret för att skapa goda förutsättningar för samarbete och snabba beslutsvägar.

Mer om dig

För att lyckas i rollen har du gedigen erfarenhet av datatransformering och modellering i dbt samt mycket goda kunskaper i SQL där du är van att skriva, optimera och underhålla komplexa frågor. Du har arbetat med molnbaserade datalager, exempelvis BigQuery, Snowflake eller Redshift, och har en relevant högskoleutbildning inom data, teknik eller statistik, alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och har goda kunskaper i engelska.

Vi tror också att du är nyfiken på ny teknik och vill utforska hur AI kan användas inom dataområdet. Eftersom rollen är ny trivs du med att vara med och bygga upp strukturer och arbetssätt, samtidigt som du uppskattar ett nära samarbete med andra. Du har ett kvalitetsmedvetet arbetssätt, en stark analytisk förmåga och motiveras av att skapa hållbara lösningar som gör data till en tillförlitlig grund för verksamhetens beslut.

Så här får vi kontakt

I den här rekryteringen har vi valt att samarbeta med Ada Digital som strävar efter en transparent, inkluderande och snabbrörlig rekryteringsupplevelse. Vi vill veta mer om dig och din potential! Du söker tjänsten enkelt och behöver inte bifoga några dokument. Det räcker med en motivering till varför du söker tjänsten och om du saknar CV kan du bifoga din LinkedIn-profil. Följ sedan din ansökan live via vår hemsida. Urvalet sker löpande och tjänsten kan bli tillsatt före sista ansökningsdatum. Är du nyfiken och vill veta mer innan du söker? Hör av dig till ansvarig rekryterare. Vi ser fram emot att få kontakt med dig!

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
Are you passionate about tracking and finding the best ways to build, develop, and maintain event tracking for one of Sweden’s largest sites and apps? Then here are some great news for you!

Hemnet is looking for an Implementation Specialist to ensure our tracking is seamless and that the data we collect is utilized to its full potential.

About The Role 🍏

In the role as an Implementation Specialist, you will be a key player in our journey to make Hemnet even more data-informed. As a part of the Analytics team closely collaborating with our product analysts you will act as a vital bridge between development, product teams, legal and other business units. Your mission is to ensure that user data is accurate, AI-ready, and that we understand the legal aspects of the things we track. It is also the roles’ responsibility to ensure that we track the right things, not everything.

With laser focus on the "back end" of analytics - ensuring data is clean, reliable, and well-modeled - you will play a crucial part in helping Hemnet continuously improve our experiences for our users.

What You’ll Do 💥


Establish tracking plans and frameworks to ensure multiple development teams at Hemnet track data consistently and accurately.
Develop and refine our technical foundation for tracking as well as how we work with tracking.
Build the foundation of Hemnet’s data structure, ensuring behavioral data is accessible and easy to use for all teams.
Ensure compliance: Work closely with the legal team to maintain a solid legal perspective on data collection, ensuring that we follow Swedish law and privacy regulations over time.


Who We Think You Are 🤩

To be successful in this role, we believe you have a technical and data-focused background with multiple years of experience working with tracking implementations, migrations and/or validations. As the bridge between tech and the analytics team, you excel at tailoring your communication for all stakeholders - ensuring that analytics requirements and needs are translated into tracking specifications for developers to understand and implement, leading to the data we collect being used in both business and product development.

Required Skills


Hands-on tracking expertise: You have proven experience setting up and managing tracking and data collection across both web and app.
Data privacy savvy: You understand the legal frameworks (GDPR, consent management, privacy laws) linked to collecting user data in digital environments.
Proficient in analytics tools: You feel right at home working in analytics and tracking platforms like Google Analytics or Amplitude.


Bonus


Product analytics experience: You go beyond standard traffic analysis, bringing a deep understanding of digital product analytics and the ability to act as a knowledgeable sparring partner for our Product Analysts.
Amplitude proficiency: You have hands-on experience working directly with Amplitude.
Technical collaboration skills: You’ve worked closely with tech teams on how data collection is implemented, keeping a strong focus on both data quality and site/app performance.


I am your new manager 👋

My name is Thomas Hanusek. I joined Hemnet about four years ago. Prior to that, I drove analytics for more than 20 years across different companies. My passion at work is really about seeing how Data & analytics can drive product and business development in the best way possible.

As a leader, I am a huge fan of seeing how a team can come together and, through their different skills, create magic. My aim is to be supportive and humble, and to create an environment where you feel trusted, challenged, and empowered to grow.

A Note on Inclusion 💚

At Hemnet, we believe that diversity in gender, sexual orientation, ability, neurodiversity, cultural background and life experience makes us stronger. We welcome applicants of all identities and backgrounds.

If you meet many but not all of the requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value curiosity, a strong sense of purpose and the motivation to learn and grow, alongside your skills and experiences.

An Office-First Culture 🙏

Our office in central Stockholm is the true hub of our company culture. We are proudly an office-first team because we deeply value face-to-face collaboration and believe our best work happens when we are together. While we understand the need for occasional flexibility, we strongly prioritize in-person teamwork over remote work. Because our office is the center of our daily operations, it is essential that you are based in or near Stockholm.

Please note that we're unable to provide relocation assistance for this opportunity.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
We are Sweden's leading app and marketplace for booking beauty and wellness services. As a SaaS company with industry-leading software, we empower more than 16,000 professionals across the country. Our platform brings together nearly every salon and clinic in Sweden, making it easy for consumers to book appointments with hairdressers, massage therapists, podiatrists, beauty salons, chiropractors, and many other specialists—all in one place.

On Bokadirekt.se, consumers can discover, book, and pay for treatments and services in just a few clicks. Every month, our platform is visited by 3 million consumers, and more than 2 million bookings are made through our website and app. We’re growing rapidly and are currently a team of more than 100 employees, with offices in Stockholm and Luleå.

About The Role

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data & Analytics team and help shape the future of data and AI at Bokadirekt.

As a Data Engineer, you will be responsible for building, maintaining, and evolving the data platform that powers analytics, business intelligence, and AI across the company. You'll work at the intersection of data engineering and AI, ensuring our data infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and ready to support everything from reporting and experimentation to LLM-powered features and machine learning pipelines.

You will collaborate closely with product managers, software engineers, analysts, and other stakeholders to create high-quality data products and enable data-driven decision-making throughout the organization. This is an opportunity to have a significant impact on both our technical platform and how data and AI are used to create value for millions of users every month.

What You'll Do


Design, build, and optimise scalable ELT pipelines that power analytics, reporting, and AI initiatives across the company
Build a reliable, trusted and well-documented source of truth for company KPIs
Work on the integration of AI capabilities into our data infrastructure
Collaborate on the development and deployment of machine learning solutions and AI-powered features
Identify and carry out data platform cost optimization initiatives


Who You Are


Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Physics or related field
Proven experience (4-6 years) as a Data Engineer, Data Scientist, ML Engineer or AI Engineer, ideally in a technology-driven environment
Strong proficiency in SQL and Python
Solid data engineering fundamentals with hands-on AI experience
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience with GCP (BigQuery, GCS, Gemini Agent Platform, Looker), Airflow, dbt and Cube is a plus. Bonus points for prompt engineering, LLM APIs, NL querying and RAG
Professional fluency in English


What We Offer


The opportunity to build and scale the data platform behind one of Sweden's most widely used consumer apps
The chance to work with modern data and AI technologies, helping shape the foundations for analytics, machine learning, and LLM-powered solutions
A collaborative culture built on ownership, innovation, and knowledge sharing
A flexible hybrid work model with four days in the office each week, including Wednesdays as our "Inspiration Day," when the whole company comes together for breakfast and shared activities
A modern office in the heart of Stockholm
A competitive salary and benefits package


About The Position

Start date: As soon as possible / By agreement

Location: Our office at Kungsgatan 38 in central Stockholm (hybrid)

Employment type: Full-time, permanent position

Application deadline: August 14

Application

We review applications continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Summer is here, and we are also taking some time to recharge. During the holiday period, our response times may be slightly longer than usual, and the recruitment process will resume from week 32.

Thank you for your patience. We wish you a wonderful summer and hope to hear from you soon!

Title: Data Steward
Description:
Job Description

At Electrolux, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.

Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute and grow together.

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home!

Data Steward

We are currently looking for a Data Steward whose main goal will be to establish clear ownership and accountability for workforce data quality across HR, ensuring each data domain is actively managed, governed, and trusted. The Data Steward operationalises the domain ownership model, working across HR to embed consistent standards, resolve data quality issues, and build confidence in the workforce data that underpins reporting, analytics, and strategic decision-making.

Why this role matters?

Ownership of workforce data has shifted to a domain ownership model, where each domain is accountable for the quality, accuracy, and integrity of its own data. Responsibility for enabling and governing this ownership now sits within the Analytics team, as part of the broader HR Operating Model changes.

Historically, workforce data quality has lacked clear ownership and accountability — resulting in inconsistent standards, poor data quality, and limited confidence in reporting and insights. Without dedicated stewardship, domain ownership risks remaining unclear and inconsistently applied across HR.

You will join a team of 4 and report directly to HR Analytics Manager.

Main responsibilities:

Data Quality Governance


Define and maintain workforce data quality standards across HR domains
Establish data quality KPIs and thresholds in collaboration with domain owners
Conduct regular data quality assessments and produce governance reporting
Own the data quality issue log — tracking, prioritising, and driving resolution


Domain Ownership Enablement


Support HR domain owners in understanding and fulfilling their data accountability
Develop onboarding materials, guidance, and toolkits for domain owners
Run enablement sessions and provide ongoing coaching to embed data ownership practices
Serve as the primary point of contact for domain owners on data quality matters


Standards & Definitions


Maintain the HR data dictionary — ensuring consistent definitions across all domains
Govern data entry standards and validation rules in HR systems (incl. Workday)
Identify and resolve definitional inconsistencies across reporting and analytics outputs
Partner with HR Technology and IT to implement system-level data quality controls


Monitoring & Issue Resolution


Design and operate data quality monitoring routines across HR data domains
Escalate systemic or unresolved issues to the Head of HR Strategy, Data & Technology
Coordinate with domain owners and technical teams to investigate root causes
Track issue resolution and report on progress against quality targets


Cross-Functional Coordination


Act as the bridge between HR, IT, and Finance on workforce data quality topics
Coordinate with the Analytics team to ensure reporting is built on trusted data
Represent HR data governance in relevant forums and working groups
Support audit and compliance activities relating to workforce data integrity


Continuous Improvement


Identify and implement improvements to data collection, validation, and maintenance processes
Monitor industry developments in HR data governance and propose relevant adoption
Build a continuous improvement cycle for workforce data quality, supported by metrics


Requirements:


Experience in data governance, data quality management, or a related HR analytics role
Understanding of HR data domains (e.g. headcount, compensation, performance, learning)
Ability to translate data governance concepts into practical, operational processes
Strong stakeholder management — able to engage and influence without direct authority
Experience working with HR information systems (Workday preferred)
Structured approach to problem-solving and issue resolution
Clear written and verbal communication skills in English
Exposure to HR analytics, reporting, or BI tooling or experience in data engineering, experience in a global or matrixed organisation and knowledge of global and local data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, local privacy laws) regarding the handling of sensitive employee information are an additional asset


Where you'll be:

This is a full-time position, based at Kungsholmen in Stockholm, Sweden.

We work with 20% work-place flexibility, fostering collaboration and a strong team spirit at our Global Headquarters.

We are 60+ nationalities under the same roof and we enjoy the look and feel of the office! You will be part of a dynamic international team where English is the natural language.

As an Electrolux Group employee, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

Please send your CV in English.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Nepa is a strategic marketing intelligence and optimization platform with AI built into everything we do — helping iconic global brands like Fjällräven, Kellogg's and Wolt make smarter marketing decisions, faster.

About the Role

As a Data Scientist at Nepa, you'll turn marketing and brand data into decisions our clients act on. You'll work independently on your own workstreams — designing and building the models, pipelines and analyses that power client projects and our AI-driven products — with senior colleagues close by for the hardest calls. This role suits people who'd rather own a problem end to end than wait to be told how to solve it: one week you might be automating a machine learning pipeline, the next presenting your findings straight to a C-level client stakeholder.

Your Responsibilities

As our Data Scientist, your key responsibilities will include:

Designing and building statistical, machine learning and AI models, pipelines and analyses for client projects and our products.
Translating client business questions into sharp, testable analytical problems.
Using AI to work smarter — automating recurring delivery steps like data preparation, quality checks and reporting, and building faster with AI assistants.
Helping embed AI and machine learning into our products — from a smarter model component in our Continuous MMM to a new signal in Creative AI, our tool for analyzing what makes ad creative perform.
Owning your workstreams end to end, from quality to timelines.
Presenting your findings clearly to your team and, increasingly, directly to clients.

Your Profile

To excel in this role, you should have:

A degree in a quantitative engineering or mathematics field.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
Around 1–3 years of hands-on data science and/or data engineering experience.
Strong statistics and applied machine learning, solid Python, and good engineering habits.
A builder's instinct — you spot where a method or process can be improved, and you make it happen.
Comfort with ambiguity: you can choose a sound approach when there's no textbook answer.
Clear communication — you can explain complex analysis to technical and non-technical people alike.
You must have the legal right to work in Sweden. Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or relocation support for this role.
Nice to have: hands-on experience using AI tools or assistants to speed up your own delivery.

We know great candidates don't always check every box. If this sounds like you, we'd still love to hear from you.

A Few More Details

You believe in the power of data and AI to drive smarter decisions and lasting growth.
You share our values: curiosity that sees what others don't, passion that shows, clarity over complexity, and the drive to care and act.
You want the freedom to grow in your own way, backed by the guidance and support of a close-knit team.
You take pride in delivering the clarity, speed, and impact our clients rely on.




Who We Are

At Nepa, we help great brands grow by turning insight into action. We're building a strategic marketing intelligence and optimisation platform for the AI era — connecting continuous data with sharp analytics, machine learning and deep marketing expertise, so businesses can act faster, spend smarter, and focus on what really drives results.




Our platform brings together Brand Tracking, Marketing Mix Modelling and Campaign Evaluation into one clear, AI-powered view for marketers and the C-suite alike. It's a transformation with real momentum: we're profitable, our subscription business is accelerating, and our AI-driven products are already proving out in the market. Our Continuous MMM tracks what's driving performance on an ongoing basis rather than waiting for a quarterly report, and our new Creative AI has already helped a client uncover a 40%+ potential reduction in cost-per-acquisition by identifying which creative elements in their ads actually move the needle. We're just getting started — for the right person, that's a real opportunity to help shape what comes next.




We're trusted by more than 300 blue-chip clients across 50+ markets — including brands like Fjällräven, Kellogg's and Wolt — and we track over 7,500 brands and campaigns every day. Founded in Stockholm in 2006 and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, Nepa has grown into a team of around 220 people across 10 offices on six continents. We're proud to bring clarity to complexity, and to make insight an engine for growth.

Next Steps

We review applications on a rolling basis, so don't delay — submit your application today to be considered for this exciting opportunity to join our team as a Data Scientist.

You'll work independently on your own workstreams — designing and building the models, pipelines and analyses that power client projects and our AI-driven products — with senior colleagues close by for the hardest calls. This role suits people who'd rather own a problem end to end than wait to be told how to solve it: one week you might be automating a machine learning pipeline, the next presenting your findings straight to a C-level client stakeholder.

Your Responsibilities

As our Data Scientist, your key responsibilities will include:

  • Designing and building statistical, machine learning and AI models, pipelines and analyses for client projects and our products.
  • Translating client business questions into sharp, testable analytical problems.
  • Using AI to work smarter — automating recurring delivery steps like data preparation, quality checks and reporting, and building faster with AI assistants.
  • Helping embed AI and machine learning into our products — from a smarter model component in our Continuous MMM to a new signal in Creative AI, our tool for analyzing what makes ad creative perform.
  • Owning your workstreams end to end, from quality to timelines.
  • Presenting your findings clearly to your team and, increasingly, directly to clients.

Your Profile

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • A degree in a quantitative engineering or mathematics field.
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
  • Around 1–3 years of hands-on data science and/or data engineering experience.
  • Strong statistics and applied machine learning, solid Python, and good engineering habits.
  • A builder's instinct — you spot where a method or process can be improved, and you make it happen.
  • Comfort with ambiguity: you can choose a sound approach when there's no textbook answer.
  • Clear communication — you can explain complex analysis to technical and non-technical people alike.
  • You must have the legal right to work in Sweden. Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or relocation support for this role.
  • Nice to have: hands-on experience using AI tools or assistants to speed up your own delivery.

We know great candidates don't always check every box. If this sounds like you, we'd still love to hear from you.

A Few More Details

  • You believe in the power of data and AI to drive smarter decisions and lasting growth.
  • You share our values: curiosity that sees what others don't, passion that shows, clarity over complexity, and the drive to care and act.
  • You want the freedom to grow in your own way, backed by the guidance and support of a close-knit team.
  • You take pride in delivering the clarity, speed, and impact our clients rely on.


Who We Are

Title: Advanced Pricing Analyst
Place: Vejle, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Join AutoProff – Help Build Trust in the Price Models Powering Our European Growth! 🚗

We’re looking for an Advanced Pricing Analyst to join our team, based out of our Vejle headquarters.

At AutoProff, pricing is at the heart of how we serve customers and drive commercial performance. As our pricing capabilities continue to evolve, we need stronger ownership of how our price models perform in production. This role will be central to creating transparency around pricing quality, spotting issues before they become escalations, and ensuring we understand why our models behave the way they do.

As Advanced Pricing Analyst, you will own the reporting, monitoring, and investigation of price model performance across our production setup. You will help define the right benchmarks and reporting views to evaluate performance over time, identify weakspots or unusual behaviour, and support both existing and new model evaluations. You will also take the lead on investigating specific pricing cases raised by Pricing teams, using data and system-level understanding to determine whether issues stem from data quality, model behaviour, system integration, or whether the model output is in fact well supported by market observations.

This role sits at the intersection of pricing, analytics, and technical investigation. You will work closely with Pricing, Data Science, and other stakeholders to ensure that pricing behaviour is monitored, understood, and communicated clearly across the organisation. You will also contribute to building and strengthening the pricing setup that supports AutoProff’s continued growth across Europe.

Let’s dive into your key responsibilities, you will


Own the reporting and monitoring framework for price model performance in production, including defining the KPIs, benchmarks, and views needed to create a clear overview of model quality and behaviour.
Analyse model performance across segments, markets, and versions to identify weakspots, anomalies, drift, and other signals of deteriorating quality before they become business issues.
Lead investigations into unusual price outcomes and determine whether the underlying cause relates to data quality, model behaviour, system integration, or stakeholder interpretation.
Build a strong understanding of how price models are productionised and consumed through APIs, and validate that models are being supplied with the correct data, format, and values.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to Pricing, Data Science, and management, while supporting the quality assurance and benchmarking of existing and new price models.


The need-to-have skills


Strong SQL skills and experience working independently with large datasets to build reporting, monitor performance, and investigate pricing behaviour.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and visualisation skills, with the ability to structure investigations and turn complex findings into clear and actionable insights.
Hands-on Python experience for data investigation, exploratory analysis, and technical debugging.
A good understanding of how machine learning models work in practice, including how input quality, feature behaviour, formatting issues, or drift can affect outputs.
Comfort working with APIs, payloads, and technical system flows, combined with strong communication skills and confidence in challenging assumptions with data and evidence.


The nice-to-have skills


Experience working with pricing models, recommendation models, or other predictive models in production.
Experience investigating model-serving issues, feature quality issues, or data pipeline issues affecting live model outputs.
Familiarity with model monitoring concepts such as drift detection, segmentation analysis, and performance benchmarking over time.
Ability to reproduce or inspect price requests locally through technical tools, services, or APIs.
Experience working closely with Data Science teams and translating between analytical, technical, and business perspectives.


We’re eager to hear from you! If this sounds like a great match and sparks your interest, don’t wait, apply today!

About AutoProff

AutoProff was founded in 2013 with the aim to digitalize B2B used car trading, helping car dealers increase sales and improve profits.

in August 2022, AutoScout24, the leading specialized pan-European online car marketplace, acquired a majority stake in AutoProff. The partnership has supported the rapid expansion of AutoProff's solutions across Europe and enables the creation of Europe's first fully integrated C2B-B2B-B2C dealing solution for used cars.

At AutoProff, we specialize in providing online B2B used-car dealing solutions designed to improve the buying and selling experience for professional car dealers and their customers.

We are the emerging European leader with more than 150,000 B2B used cars on our online trading platforms annually.

With a focus on effective solutions, digitization and customer service, we are committed to being the home of B2B car dealing for European car dealers.

Use SQL and Python to transform and analyse large data sets relating to visit-to-booking performance

You are analytical, organised, and curious. You enjoy designing and analysing experiments that directly impact business growth, and you are comfortable turning messy or complex data into clear insights and recommendations.

1-3 years experience in a revenue growth, operations, analytics or other data focused role
Experience using SQL to query large datasets, perform analysis, and generate actionable business insights
Structured, hypothesis-driven approach to experimentation and problem solving
Comfortable working cross-functionally with stakeholders and sales teams across different markets.
Strong attention to detail and an interest in improving data quality and business processes


Nice-to-haves


Experience working with webforms, lead generation, or similar conversion funnels
Familiarity with Snowflake, Databricks or a similar cloud data warehouse

Title: Data Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About Us

Complir is the AI platform for the product compliance lifecycle, built for retailers, brands, and manufacturers selling physical consumer products across multiple markets.

We believe getting a physical product to market shouldn't mean fighting spreadsheets, PDFs, and supplier emails just to prove it's safe and legal to sell. Product compliance should be continuous, automatic, and understandable, not a bottleneck that slows launches down. We're building the AI infrastructure that makes that possible.

We work with many of the world's largest retailers and brands across fashion, furniture, cosmetics, toys, electronics and many other product categories. We're backed by Y Combinator, and a roster of investors who see what we see: Product compliance is the next major infrastructure category, and we're leading it.

About The Role

Every product you've ever bought, from a kid's toy dinosaur to your electric toothbrush, had to clear a wall of regulation before it reached you. That wall is written down somewhere: scattered across hundreds of government portals, PDFs, and legal databases, in dozens of languages, updated on no schedule anyone agreed to.

Your job is to turn that chaos into structured, queryable data our product can act on. You'll be the person who makes the world's product regulations machine-readable.

The data layer everything stands on

This is not a role where you write Python scripts in isolation. You'll understand, crawl, and monitor regulatory sources across hundreds of jurisdictions, parse raw legal text into a normalized requirement schema, and catch changes the day they land, so every label, Declaration of Conformity, and risk assessment we generate is provably current.

The interesting problems are everywhere: government portals that were last redesigned when fax machines were current, legal text that means different things in different translations, amendments that quietly rewrite three other acts, and the question of how you prove to an enterprise customer that your data was correct on the day they shipped. LLMs make structured extraction over legal text possible for the first time; making it reliable enough to stake a product launch on is the engineering problem you'll own.

You'll do this sitting next to the founders, our AI engineers, and our in-house compliance experts at our Copenhagen HQ. No layers, no ticket queues. When a source breaks or a regulation changes, the fix ships in hours, not sprints.

What You'll Actually Do


Build and operate the crawling and monitoring layer across hundreds of regulatory sources: government portals, legislative databases, and official gazettes in dozens of languages
Parse raw legal text (HTML, PDFs, scans) into a normalized requirement schema, using LLM-assisted extraction pipelines you design, evaluate, and harden
Build change detection that catches new acts, amendments, and repeals the day they land, and triggers the downstream updates our customers depend on
Own data quality end to end: provenance, versioning, and coverage metrics, so every requirement in the platform traces back to its primary source
Work with our regulatory experts to evolve the schema and taxonomy as coverage grows from the EU to new jurisdictions
Shape the architecture, tooling, and data culture as the team grows


You will love this job, if you are:


An engineer with several years building data pipelines, crawling infrastructure, or large-scale extraction systems
Experienced with (or seriously hungry to go deep on) LLM-assisted extraction: structured outputs, evals, and the failure modes of models reading dense text
Someone who treats data correctness as sacred: provenance, versioning, and "how do we know this is still true?" are your favorite questions
Unafraid of messy sources: broken HTML, scanned PDFs, and legal prose in languages you don't speak are puzzles, not blockers
Product-minded: You understand that a quality manager will stake a product launch on your pipeline's output
Bonus points if you have worked with regulatory data before
Comfortable with ambiguity and speed: Small team, fast decisions, no spec handed down from above
Excited to work on-site in Copenhagen with the whole team
A builder at heart


What You Get


Ownership of the regulatory data layer, the foundation the entire product stands on
Zero layers: You sit next to the founders, the AI team, and the compliance experts whose domain you're turning into data
Ground floor of a category-defining company, backed by Y Combinator and investors betting on product compliance becoming the next big thing
Competitive salary and equity
An office where the pastries are mandatory


If you've read this far and thought "that's the data problem I want to own," we'd like to meet you.

  • Competitive salary and equity
  • An office where the pastries are mandatory

If you've read this far and thought "that's the data problem I want to own," we'd like to meet you.

Title: Business Analyst - FP&A
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About The Role

We're seeking a driven Business Analyst to join our FP&A team - someone who’s eager to work directly with senior leadership and contribute to data-driven decisions from day one in a high-impact role that offers real visibility and room to grow.

Now a delisted, growth-equity backed business, OrderYOYO is entering an exciting new chapter – a clear testament to our bold growth ambitions and the fast paced, high-impact environment we are building.

In this role, you’ll gain broad exposure across the business by collaborating with Management, Commercial teams, Tech, and Product Owners. You'll play a key role in turning data into actionable insights with an analytical approach, including testing hypotheses, doing in-depth analysis and presenting findings for key stakeholders. As you grow, you’ll have the freedom to shape your path based on your strengths and interests.

Here’s a taste of what you’ll be doing:


Assist with scenario analysis to help inform strategic decisions made at the leadership level.
Assist with invoicing processes and mature existing logic towards a more automated process.
Structure and analyse raw data, translate business needs into data requirements, and collaborate with Tech on onboarding and integration.
Design and analyse commercial experiments (A/B tests, hypothesis-driven investigations) to test what works before scaling.
Apply modelling techniques in Python (classification, regression, clustering, segmentation) where they sharpen the answer to a commercial question.
Build and enhance Power BI reports using our Microsoft Fabric data platform, supporting both management and internal stakeholders.


What We Are Looking For In You


Experience in a commercial analytics, FP&A, consulting, or business analyst role - ideally in a SaaS, marketplace, or subscription business.
Strong Excel and Power BI skills. Comfortable building reports and analytical views on a modern data platform (Microsoft Fabric or equivalent).
Experience with experimentation and hypothesis testing (A/B tests, causal inference and OLS).
Working Python skills (pandas, scikit-learn). Able to build and interpret classification, regression, and clustering models for commercial questions - not building production pipelines.
Strong commercial instinct. Comfortable presenting findings to senior stakeholders and translating numbers into recommendations.
Structured problem-solving. Can take an open commercial question and decompose it into a testable hypothesis.
Interest in applied AI/ML - e.g. using LLMs to accelerate analytical workflows.


Why Join Us?


Direct exposure to decision-making at the highest level and learn how business challenges are tackled at the top level.
Work in a supportive, team-first culture where we help each other succeed.
Expect personal development plans and ongoing training tailored to your growth.
A dynamic, supportive environment where critical thinking is encouraged and your voice matters.
Be part of a high-growth journey in a growth equity-backed company, where ambition meets opportunity - and your impact truly matters.


Great To Have (But Not Required)


Exposure to Power BI, SQL, DAX, Python, and/or Power Query.
ML & AI intuition, such as K-fold cross-validation, exploiting gradients and similar.
Familiarity with FP&A concepts: budgeting, variance analysis, forecasting cycles.
Experience or interest in working on cross-functional projects involving Tech/Product, Operations, Sales and Marketing


What we do at OrderYOYO

OrderYOYO is a provider of white-label online ordering, payment, marketing, and POS software solutions to independent local takeaway restaurants. We are ensuring that small to medium-sized restaurants and chains are not subjected to lofty commissions and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success.

Who We Are At OrderYOYO

Company culture is at the forefront of our minds creating an enjoyable, safe working environment where employee personal expression is supported. We are one team here at OrderYOYO and strive to help others succeed. Personal development and training plans are a key part of your journey within OrderYOYO, helping you be the best you can be by providing consistent and ongoing training for all aspects of the business. Our values (Passion, Action, Compassion, One team) are what makes us who we are and will be embedded in your day-to-day no matter what area of the business you work in.

Please note interviews for this role will be conducted in September
