Title: Finance Digital Analyst
Place: Dragør, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Om stillingen 

Vi søger en Finance Digital Analyst til Sunclass Airlines, som kombinerer stærke analytiske kompetencer med interesse for digitalisering og datadrevet økonomistyring.

Som Finance Digital Analyst bliver du en del af et dygtigt og engageret Finance team og får en central rolle med betydelig indflydelse på tværs af den bredere Finance funktion. I tæt samarbejde med forretningen, og det lokale Finance team, bidrager du til den fortsatte udvikling af økonomistyring og performance rapportering på tværs af vores forretningsområder.

Derudover, får du en central rolle i vores digitale transformationsrejse med fokus på udvikling og vedligeholdelse af automatiseringsløsninger. Dertil kommer forbedring af rapportering samt videreudvikling af Power BI og AI agenter i Finance funktionen. Formålet er at styrke datadrevet beslutningstagen og forbedre kvaliteten af finansiel indsigt.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

Som vores nye Finance Digital Analyst vil dine primære ansvarsområder være at:


Drive udviklingen af Power BI, datamodellering i DAX, semantiske modeller og rapportudvikling
Udvikle Power Automate-løsninger og automatisering af processer
Videreudvikle rapporterings- og budgetmodeller ved brug af Power Query, pivottabeller, komplekse formler og generel opbygning af finansielle modeller
Drive udviklingen af AI-værktøjer, f.eks. Copilot Studio, Claude Code eller prompt engineering, og AI-understøttelse af forskellige arbejdsprocesser
Samarbejde med stakeholders på tværs af Sunclass Airlines og koncernen for at øge transparens, performance management og finansielt overblik
Deltage i måneds- og årsrapportering
Arbejde med både historiske data, budgettering og forecasts
Løbende sikre, at processer fungerer effektivt og lever op til vores krav og procedurer
Være aktiv i automatiseringen og digitaliseringen i vores Finance Excellence-program


Hvem søger vi

Vi Ønsker, At Du Opfylder Følgende


Minimum bachelorgrad inden for finans, økonomi, IT, dataanalyse, ingeniørvidenskab eller et tilsvarende relevant område
Erfaring med datamodellering, DAX, semantiske modeller og rapportudvikling
Erfaring med udvikling og vedligeholdelse af Power Automate-flows samt automatisering af finansielle processer
Erfaring med Power Query, pivottabeller, komplekse formler og generel opbygning af finansielle modeller
Flydende i dansk, svensk eller norsk i både skrift og tale
Flydende engelsk i både skrift og tale


Som person er du en stærk teamplayer, der værdsætter åben kommunikation og bidrager til et positivt samarbejde på tværs af organisationen. Du arbejder analytisk og løsningsorienteret og har evnen til effektivt at håndtere og omsætte store datamængder til værdifulde indsigter. Samtidig har du en metodisk tilgang til dine opgaver og et skarpt øje for detaljen, hvilket sikrer høj kvalitet i dit arbejde. Du er resultatorienteret og fokuseret på at skabe værdi gennem dine opgaver, samtidig med at du arbejder struktureret, proaktivt og selvstændigt i et dynamisk miljø. Derudover motiveres du af at arbejde med økonomiske problemstillinger og at identificere og implementere forbedringer af digitale processer.

Vi tilbyder 

Vi tilbyder et spændende og udviklende arbejdsmiljø, hvor du har mulighed for at gøre karriere internt i koncernen. Du får en varieret hverdag med fart over feltet, hvor vidensdeling og samarbejde er i højsædet – dette på et nordisk plan, da vi arbejder på tværs af de nordiske lande for at sikre de bedste uger på året for vores kunder i alle lande. Vi elsker vores arbejde og glæder os til at byde dig velkommen på vores rejse i Sunclass Airlines og Nordic Leisure Travel Group.

Vi tilbyder desuden en række personalegoder som sundhedsforsikring, kantineordning og personalerabat på rejser.

Vores kontor i Københavns Lufthavn Syd i Dragør er med gratis parkering og bus lige udenfor døren.

Øvrigt

Stillingen er fast fuldtidsansættelse. Løn og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til funktionæroverenskomsten.

Ansøgningsfrist: 23. august 2026.

Start: Snarest muligt eller efter aftale.

Kontaktperson: Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Finance Manager Jesper Jensen på tlf: +45 20 21 21 74.

Da du skal arbejde i koncernens luftfartsselskab og skal have adgang til lufthavnens område, er det en forudsætning, at du gennemgår et udvidet baggrundscheck og kan opretholde denne godkendelse hos Politiet i Danmark.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning!

For at hjælpe os med at placere de rigtige personer i de rigtige roller tror vi på videnskabeligt baserede og retfærdige vurderingsmetoder. Derfor anvender vi, som en del af vores rekrutteringsproces, Alva Labs' testværktøjer. De hjælper os med at forbedre kvaliteten af vores ansættelser ved at identificere de kandidater, der med størst sandsynlighed vil trives og få succes i rollen.

Vil du vide mere om Alva Labs? Du kan finde yderligere information her: Alva Labs

Sunclass Airlines is part of the Nordic Leisure Travel Group (NLTG), which consists of the tour operators Spies in Denmark, Ving and Globetrotter in Sweden, Ving in Norway, Tjäreborg in Finland and the hotel company Resorts & Hotels. Sunclass Airlines flies the majority of the travel group's guests to our charter destinations and has over 1.000.000 travelers per year.

Read more about us at sunclassairlines.dk.

Title: Portfolio Analyst
Place: Billund, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

Just imagine shaping the portfolio behind future LEGO® play experiences. Then make it real.

This Portfolio Analyst role sits in Engineering & Quality Strategic Projects & Portfolio Management in Billund, with no relocation support offered. You'll turn portfolio data into clear choices for senior leaders.

Play your part in our team succeeding

Our team guides a varied portfolio of strategic initiatives across Engineering & Quality, from sustainability projects to new technologies and play experiences. You'll help the LEGO® team see where resources, budgets, risks and benefits connect, so the right work moves forward with clarity. Together, we'll explore, experiment and learn.


Core Responsibilities



Portfolio Data Management & Analysis Collect, structure, maintain and evaluate comprehensive data on the project portfolio, including resources, budgets, risks, benefits, delivery performance and others. Support scenario analysis and prioritization models, e.g. project intake process
Performance Tracking Develop, maintain and continuously improve project portfolio performance dashboards and reporting tools to track key portfolio metrics and enable data-driven decisions.
Decision Support Create clear, concise decision-making materials with compelling narratives tailored to senior management, enabling well-informed decisions. Communicate complex topics in a simple, easily understandable manner.
Operational & Strategic Support Take ownership of ad-hoc portfolio analysis, reporting, and other operational tasks where needed. Identify and proactively drive opportunities to streamline processes, enhance workflows, and improve operational efficiency.
Governance & Decision Framework Support and enforce governance structures, decision-making processes, and portfolio management standards that ensure accountability, consistency, and transparency.


Do you have what it takes?

We imagine you have a curiosity and eagerness to learn, aspiring to accelerate your career through practical experience and mentorship. You're driven to help make strategic decisions through impactful work. Additionally, you bring



Strong analytical skills, proficiency developing and data analysis tools and methods.
Experience from portfolio analysis, project coordination, strategy support or a similar data-focused role.
Comfortable using analysis tools and methods to turn information into useful recommendations.
Clear communicator who can explain complex findings in simple.
Collaborative approach, curiosity and readiness to learn new skills as the work evolves.
Proficient in English, both written and spoken.


Please note that relocation support is not offered for this role.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What’s in it for you?

Here is what you can expect

Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

Colleague Discount – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.

Bonus - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

Workplace - When you join the team you'll be assigned a primary workplace location i.e. one of our Offices, stores or factories. Our hybrid work policy means an average of 3 days per week in the office. The hiring team will discuss the policy and role eligibility with you during the recruitment process.

Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong.

The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.

The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer.

Thank you for sharing our global commitment to Children’s Rights.

Just imagine building your dream career.

Then make it real.

Join the LEGO® team today.

Title: Asset Performance Analyst
Description:
Asset Performance Analyst – Customer and Commercial Excellence




Would you like to help strengthen the long-term performance and reliability of Copenhagen Metro?

Metroselskabet operates the Copenhagen Metro, a fully automated, driverless metro system. With a high degree of automation and extensive operational and maintenance data, we have a strong foundation for working systematically with asset performance, reliability and continuous improvement.

You will join Customer and Commercial Excellence, where we work to ensure that the metro and light rail systems perform according to customer needs and operational targets. We do this through close collaboration with our operator, a solid data foundation and a continuous focus on improving performance.




About the role

Translate analysis and monitoring findings into asset condition assessments and recommendations for reinvestment prioritisation.
Develop and contribute to improvement initiatives across technical disciplines and in collaboration with our operator.
Help strengthen Metroselskabet’s data-driven approach to asset management and continuous improvement.

Hold a relevant degree in engineering, data science or a similar technical field.
Have experience from the rail industry, preferably within signalling, operations, maintenance or asset management.
Have experience working with asset management, maintenance or operational performance data.
Are analytical, structured and curious about complex technical systems.
Have an eye for small deviations and are motivated to investigate their causes and potential implications.
Can work independently with open-ended analytical tasks while collaborating closely with technical and operational stakeholders.
Communicate clearly in English, both verbally and in writing.




It is an advantage if you have experience with:

Analytical coding and working directly with data, for example in Python, SQL or similar.
Asset performance management platforms, dashboards, monitoring logic or alert structures.
Reliability engineering methods, such as FMEA, root-cause analysis, failure trend analysis or Weibull analysis.
Collaboration in a contract-managed operating environment.

You will join a small, highly skilled team with an informal culture, significant professional autonomy and close collaboration across maintenance, engineering, operations and data disciplines.

You are naturally curious and enjoy understanding how businesses operate. You are comfortable engaging with stakeholders and asking the right questions before jumping to solutions.

A problem solver who is persistent in turning needs into practical solutions

Description:
Are you passionate about renewable energy and eager to work at the forefront of the global energy transition? PEAK Wind is seeking a Wind Fleet Performance Analyst to support our Data & Intelligence team in building data pipelines for an ever-larger data flow from various wind farms and solar projects.




Introducing the Data & Intelligence Team

You will become part of our D&I team, where we work within PEAK Wind's operations management service offering and manage full value chain data management for our clients. We support renewable energy assets worldwide through data management, reporting solutions, and analytics capabilities, helping deliver data-driven solutions that support our clients and renewable energy projects. Our team consists of highly motivated professionals who bring diverse backgrounds and a strong commitment to excellence. We support one another, share knowledge, and celebrate both individual and collective achievements.

You will report to the Head of Data & Intelligence and work closely with Data Engineers, Asset Managers, and other stakeholders across the business, bringing your analytical expertise and visualisation skills to a collaborative and purpose-driven team environment.




How You Will Make an Impact

As a Wind Fleet Performance Analyst, you will contribute to the success of our clients and renewable energy projects by transforming operational wind asset data into meaningful insights that support performance optimisation, operational decision-making, and asset value creation.

You will sit at the intersection of performance analytics and data visualisation, combining a strong understanding of wind asset performance with the ability to communicate complex findings through intuitive dashboards and reporting solutions.

Your key responsibilities will include:

Analyse operational data from onshore and offshore wind assets to identify performance trends, anomalies, and drivers of underperformance
Lead and manage analyses supporting performance optimisation, diagnostics, and performance reporting for Asset Management teams and clients
Collect, manage, and verify operational data to ensure accuracy, quality, and availability for performance evaluation
Design, develop, and maintain frontend dashboards and visualisations, primarily in Power BI, that present performance and underperformance insights in a clear and user-friendly manner
Collaborate closely with Data Engineers and backend developers to ensure reliable data flows support analytical and reporting solutions
Translate complex operational datasets into intuitive visuals and dashboards that clearly communicate insights to internal and external stakeholders
Ensure usability, performance, and visual consistency across dashboards and reporting solutions
Provide input on frontend architecture, tooling, and technology choices related to visualisation and reporting platforms
Implement enhancements to dashboards and analyses based on user feedback and evolving business requirements
Maintain clear documentation of analyses, dashboards, and methodologies to support transparency and knowledge sharing
Stay informed on wind industry performance benchmarks, underperformance drivers, and analytical best practices, contributing to the continuous improvement of PEAK Wind's data landscape




What Will Make You Successful in This Role

At PEAK Wind, we know success comes in many forms. What matters most is your mindset, curiosity, and drive to make an impact. The following qualities and experiences will help you succeed in this role:
A bachelor's or master's degree in Data Science, Engineering, Physics, or a related quantitative field
Experience analysing operational performance data within the wind industry or broader renewable energy sector
Understanding of key wind asset performance metrics such as availability, capacity factor, curtailment, and performance optimisation drivers
Strong experience with Power BI; experience with Tableau, Alteryx, or similar tools is an advantage
Experience with SQL and/or Python is considered an advantage
The ability to transform complex datasets into clear and impactful visualisations and reporting solutions
An interest in user experience and dashboard design that supports effective communication and decision-making
Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken
An agile mindset with the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities
A proactive, structured, and solution-oriented approach to problem-solving
A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in an international, cross-functional team environment
Enjoy combining analytical thinking with visual storytelling
Comfortable investigating operational data to understand why an asset is underperforming
Able to present complex findings in a way that is clear, meaningful, and actionable for stakeholders
Structured and curious in your approach to problem-solving
Equally comfortable working with data analysis and data visualisation solutions




Why Join PEAK Wind

An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued
The opportunity to work on leading renewable energy projects alongside experienced industry professionals
Work with market-leading utilities, investment funds, and IPPs on renewable energy projects across the globe
A highly entrepreneurial environment focused on innovation, collaboration, and challenging the status quo
Flexible working arrangements that support both your career and personal life

Title: Data Scientist - FP&A
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About The Role

We’re seeking a driven Data Scientist to join our FP&A team - someone who’s eager to work directly with senior leadership and bring predictive modelling, experimentation, and applied AI into a team that already understands the business deeply. This is a high-impact role that offers real visibility and room to grow.

Now a delisted, growth-equity backed business, OrderYOYO is entering an exciting new chapter – a clear testament to our bold growth ambitions and the fast paced, high-impact environment we are building.

In this role, you’ll gain broad exposure across the business by collaborating with Management, Commercial teams, Tech, and the Data Platform team. You’ll help move the organisation from “what happened” to “what will happen” - translating business questions into statistical or ML problems, building and validating models, and delivering outputs that plug into the day-to-day work. As you grow, you’ll have the freedom to shape your path based on your strengths and interests.

Here’s a taste of what you’ll be doing:


Build, validate, and explain predictive models (classification, regression, time-series forecasting, cohort and churn analysis) that connect directly to a business process.
Apply NLP and LLMs to accelerate analytical workflows and unlock new capabilities - prompting, fine-tuning, and deploying language models where they sharpen the answer to a commercial question.
Deliver model outputs in a consumable format, building and enhancing Power BI reports on our Microsoft Fabric data platform for management and internal stakeholders.
Design and analyse commercial experiments (A/B tests, hypothesis-driven investigations, causal inference) to test what works before scaling.
Assist with scenario analysis to help inform strategic decisions made at the leadership level.


What We Are Looking For In You


1+ years of experience with data science, advanced analytics, or an analytics engineering role - ideally in a SaaS, marketplace, or subscription business.
Strong Python skills (pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost). Able to build, validate, and interpret classification and regression models.
Applied NLP and LLM experience. Comfortable prompting, training, and deploying language models to solve real problems.
Experience building predictive models that were actually used in production or by business stakeholders - not just academic exercises.
Structured problem-solving. Can take an open question and decompose it into a testable hypothesis or a well-scoped modelling problem.


Why Join Us?


Direct exposure to decision-making at the highest level and learn how business challenges are tackled at the top level.
Work in a supportive, team-first culture where we help each other succeed.
Expect personal development plans and ongoing training tailored to your growth.
A dynamic, supportive environment where critical thinking is encouraged and your voice matters.
Be part of a high-growth journey in a growth equity-backed company, where ambition meets opportunity - and your impact truly matters.


Great To Have (But Not Required)


Deeper ML & AI intuition - e.g. cross-validation strategy, the bias-variance tradeoff, regularization, gradient-based optimization, model calibration, SHAP-based explainability, and RAG vs. fine-tuning for LLM work.
Exposure to Power BI, DAX, and/or Power Query.
Experience or interest in working on cross-functional projects involving Tech/Product, Operations, Sales and Marketing.
Working knowledge of SQL and comfort pulling data directly from a data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar).


What We Do At OrderYOYO

OrderYOYO is a provider of white-label online ordering, payment, marketing, and POS software solutions to independent local takeaway restaurants. We are ensuring that small to medium-sized restaurants and chains are not subjected to lofty commissions and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success.

Who We Are At OrderYOYO

Company culture is at the forefront of our minds creating an enjoyable, safe working environment where employee personal expression is supported. We are one team here at OrderYOYO and strive to help others succeed. Personal development and training plans are a key part of your journey within OrderYOYO, helping you be the best you can be by providing consistent and ongoing training for all aspects of the business. Our values (Passion, Action, Compassion, One team) are what makes us who we are and will be embedded in your day-to-day no matter what area of the business you work in.

Please note interviews for this role will be conducted in September

Title: Business Intelligence Manager
Place: Billund Municipality, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
We're looking for a commercially minded Business Intelligence Manager who can understand business challenges, identify opportunities, and turn data into clear recommendations that support better decisions.

In this role, you will work closely with leaders and stakeholders across LEGO House to support commercial performance, guest growth, revenue optimization, and operational planning. You will use data, forecasting, reporting, and analysis to create practical insight that helps the business prioritize, act, and grow.

The position is based in Billund, and we do not offer relocation assistance or visa support for this role.




Core Responsibilities

In the Business Intelligence Manager role, you will help turn commercial questions into clear insights, recommendations, and actions that support both strategic and day-to-day decision-making.

Understand the business and identify commercial opportunities by analyzing guest behavior, target groups, market opportunities, tourism trends, sales performance, and guest feedback, while partnering closely with stakeholders across Sales & Insights, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and senior leadership,
Translate data into practical recommendations that support guest growth, revenue optimization, ticket product development, pricing, campaigns, and operational planning.
Lead forecasting and planning across guest volume, revenue, opening calendar planning, time-slot allotment, and capacity planning.
Own and develop trusted BI reporting through dashboards, reporting tools, and self-service analytics that make insights accessible and useful across the organization.
Combine internal and external data sources to create a stronger understanding of performance, opportunities, and business impact.
Communicate insights clearly and engagingly so complex information becomes easy to understand, discuss, and act on.

Do you have what it takes

You bring strong analytical skills together with commercial curiosity and a solid understanding of how data can create business value. Ideally, you have:

5+ years of experience within business intelligence, commercial analysis, forecasting, performance management, or business partnering.
Business understanding and the ability to connect data, guest behavior, revenue, operations, and commercial priorities.
Experience translating business questions into clear analysis, recommendations, and decision support.
Power BI skills, including dashboard development, data modelling, visualization, best practices, and preferably DAX.
Excel capabilities and experience working with multiple data sources.
Communication skills and the ability to explain complex insights in a simple and engaging way.
Experience partnering with stakeholders across functions to guide decision-making.
Fluency in English, written and verbal.




Experience from tourism, attractions, entertainment, hospitality, or destination businesses is considered an advantage, but not a requirement.


Join the Sales & Insights team in LEGO House

LEGO House is unlike any other workplace.

Here, you'll join a collaborative community where different perspectives are valued, ideas are welcomed, and learning is part of everyday work. We believe effective solutions are built collaboratively, and you will have plenty of opportunities to test assumptions and help guide how data supports the business.

From improving forecasting and business planning to creating useful reporting tools and guiding strategic decisions, your contributions will be seen throughout the organization.


Ready to Build Memorable Moments Together with Us?

We'd be interested to hear how your experience and curiosity can help shape the future of LEGO House.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We anticipate that the selected candidate will begin around November 2026, though the exact start date can be arranged with the right person.

Apply now and become part of a team where insights lead to action, collaboration creates impact, and every role contributes to building memorable moments together.

Tech-first. Ego-free. User-obsessed. Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden to understand and optimise their taxes. We automate tax tracking, surface deductions people didn't know they had, and give users the insights they need to make better financial decisions — all directly connected to the Danish tax authority. We're an independent company of around 50 people based in Copenhagen, with a 4.7-star rating and a simple mission: make financial insight accessible to everyone, not just those who can afford an accountant.







The role




We need someone who owns product analytics — not just executes it. You'll set the direction for how Skatteguiden uses data to understand its users and make product decisions, and you'll be the person who raises the bar for what good analytics looks like here.




You'll work closely with product managers across our product teams and have real influence on what gets built and why. This isn't a support function. It's a lead role with ownership.







What you'll be working on




Own the product analytics function — define the strategy, set the standards, and drive adoption across product teams
Define and maintain core product metrics and KPIs across the organisation
Design and run experiments — from hypothesis to conclusion
Analyse user behaviour and funnels to identify growth opportunities and friction points
Build scalable dashboards and reporting in close collaboration with the data team
Translate findings into concrete recommendations for product leadership and senior stakeholders







What you bring




Strong SQL skills and experience with complex data modelling
Experience with Snowflake, dbt, Lightdash, Evidence or comparable tooling.
Solid product analytics experience — you've worked closely with product teams and understand what drives a digital product
Strong experimentation design and statistical analysis skills
A track record of owning a product analytics function, not just contributing to one
Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Self-directed and structured — you can take an ambiguous question and turn it into a sharp analysis







Nice to have




Experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse
Experience with Lightdash, Tableau, or comparable BI tools
Python for data processing and analysis







What we offer







Ownership of the product analytics function at one of Denmark's fastest-growing fintech companies
Direct influence on product direction and a seat at the table where decisions are made
A strong data team with high professional standards and a modern tech stack
The opportunity to build something — not inherit a finished function
Office first in Copenhagen — five minutes from Rådhuspladsen, lunch at Claus Meyer, dinner covered if the day runs long







Practical

Screening call with Christian Payne, 30 min (online)

We are looking for a skilled and business-oriented BI developer to drive front-end BI delivery, serving stakeholders across the full value chain. In this hands-on position your output directly shapes how leaders and teams across Terma understand and act on business performance.




We are facing an exciting future with considerable growth and demanding changes, as we deliver advanced technologies and mission critical solutions for the defense and aerospace industry. Our systems provide security for people on land, at sea and in the air. Therefore, we are looking for a System Developer within Business Intelligence to become part of this journey and contribute to our overall purpose – securing people through advanced technology.




Your role in our team




As our new Systems Developer, you will design, build, and maintain Power BI solutions that translate complex business, operational, and financial data into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders across our functions and business areas.




You will be the bridge between the business and the data, collaborating closely with stakeholders across the value chain – including sales, business development, project delivery, R&D, executive leadership and finance to evolve KPI frameworks, performance metrics, and business narratives into visual formats. Understanding what decisions need to be made and ensuring the right information is available at the right time. Your solutions will include everything from project performance reviews and pipeline reporting to financial performance management and executive dashboards.




You will join Financial Systems & BI, part of our Performance & Financial Insights function — a team dedicated to bringing structure, insight, and analytical depth to performance management across Terma. You and the BI team will collaborate closely with our IT data infrastructure team on the underlying data models and structures, ensuring the data feeding your reports is fit for purpose.




How you will make a meaningful contribution




Your key responsibilities include:




Designing and developing Power BI dashboards and reports that meet the analytical and reporting needs of stakeholders across sales, supply chain, R&D, and finance
Translating business requirements into robust, well-structured BI solutions — working with stakeholders across the value chain from initial scoping and design through to deployment and user adoption
Developing DAX measures and calculation logic in close collaboration with IT, turning underlying data into clear, business-ready insight in Power BI
Maintaining and continuously improving our front-end BI reporting — covering report quality, consistency, visual standards, and performance optimization
Acting as the go-to BI expert within Financial Systems & BI — advising stakeholders on what is possible, guiding self-service capabilities, and enabling broader data literacy across the organisation
Contributing to BI standards and best practices within Financial Systems & BI, ensuring consistency and scalability across all reporting output




Bring your world class expertise into play

A degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Business Intelligence, or a similar field of study
Preferably between 3–6 years of hands-on experience developing Power BI solutions in a professional, business-facing context
Strong proficiency in DAX and SQL, with a structured approach to building robust measures and calculation logic in collaboration with the teams who maintain the underlying data models
Experience working as an internal BI resource serving multiple functions or business areas, with the ability to balance competing priorities and manage stakeholder expectations

A structured, quality-conscious approach to development — you document your work, build for maintainability, and care about the end-user experience

We are an international company representing world-class expertise, delivering complex and high-tech products. Title: Data Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Spirii develops world-class charging products and digital solutions for electric vehicles. Our Digital Development department fosters a listen, learn, and lead culture — allowing us to continuously improve how we work. We're looking for a hands-on Data Engineer to build and evolve Spirii's data platform and pipeline infrastructure. Working closely with our Data Lead and domain teams, you'll design and maintain reliable ELT pipelines, ensure data arrives in Amazon Redshift correctly and on time, and support the analytics layer that powers insights across EV charging events, subscriptions, and financial transactions. This is a unique opportunity to shape Spirii's data infrastructure from an early stage — establishing standards for ingestion, orchestration, and data reliability as we scale.

Your Responsibilities

Pipeline & Ingestion


Design, build, and maintain scalable ELT pipelines that bring data from product backends, third-party services, and operational systems into Amazon Redshift.
Own ingestion reliability: monitoring, alerting, and incident response for pipeline failures.
Evaluate and improve orchestration tooling and scheduling.


Data Platform & Infrastructure


Evolve Spirii's data platform architecture: storage, compute, access control, and cost optimisation in Redshift.
Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code practices for data workflows (Terraform/CDK or similar).
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data infrastructure and transformations.


Data Quality & Governance


Implement data quality checks, freshness monitoring, and anomaly detection across ingestion and transformation layers.
Work with Analytics Engineers and domain teams to define and enforce data contracts and schema standards.
Ensure GDPR-compliant data handling: PII identification, access control, and data retention policies.


Collaboration & Stakeholders


Partner with Engineering and Product teams to instrument events correctly at the source — schemas, identifiers, and change management.
Collaborate with Data team to ensure the analytics layer is built on reliable, well-modelled foundations.
Contribute to a strong data culture by creating and enhancing documentation, runbooks, data lineage, discoverability and incident response capabilities.


About You


You care deeply about data reliability and building pipelines that teams can depend on.
You're hands-on: you build, test, and ship pipelines and infrastructure improvements yourself.
You think of data pipelines as products — you care about uptime, observability, and the downstream consumers who depend on them.
You're pragmatic: you know when to engineer robustly and when to keep things lean.
You collaborate well across teams and communicate clearly about trade-offs and status.


Qualifications


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related role with a strong data focus.
Strong SQL skills and solid experience building production data pipelines.
Hands-on experience with a modern data warehouse (Redshift preferred; BigQuery/Snowflake/Databricks also relevant).
Experience with orchestration tools (Apache Airflow or similar).
Proficiency in Python for data work (pipeline scripts, transformations, tooling).
Solid understanding of ELT/ETL concepts, including incremental loading, CDC, and idempotency.
Familiar with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or similar).
Familiar with data governance concepts: access control, PII handling, GDPR-minded practices.


Nice to Have


Experience with data observability tooling.
Experience with event/data contract patterns in product analytics (schemas, versioning, instrumentation).
Experience with finance data and/or subscription/transaction domains.
Experience with dbt (understanding of transformation layer and how it interfaces with pipelines).
Machine learning infrastructure experience is a plus, but not required for this role.


Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work-life balance.


Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.
Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days (5 weeks + 5 extra) and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.
Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.
Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.
Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.


The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but fluent English language skills are required.

About Spirii – Who We Are

Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii has recently celebrated its six-year anniversary as a founded company; however the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as the development of future transport and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

Title: Dygtig dataanalytiker med fokus på processer og formidling
Description:
Har du skarpe metodiske og dataanalytiske kompetencer, og kan du formidle komplekse dataanalyser tydeligt? Motiveres du af at blive fagligt udfordret, og vil du være med til at præge udviklingen i en statslig styrelse? Så er du måske den, vi søger i Kvalitet og Styring i Motorstyrelsen.

I Kvalitet og Styring arbejder vi målrettet med at optimere Motorstyrelsens anvendelse af data. Det gør vi blandt andet ved at udvikle nye metoder og tilgange, der understøtter Motorstyrelsens opgave med at sikre, at borgere og virksomheder betaler den rette køretøjsafgift. Vi udarbejder og vedligeholder derudover ledelsesrapporter, som understøtter styrelsens produktionsplanlægning, og vi leverer dataudtræk til blandt andet departement og direktion.

Spændende opgaver med mulighed for at sætte retningen

Vi er lige nu 17 medarbejdere i Kvalitet og Styring. Vi søger en ny kollega med et højt ambitionsniveau og en god metodisk og dataanalytisk faglighed. Vores nye kollega bliver en del af vores BI-team. Som vores nye kollega vil der blive rig mulighed for at præge vores arbejde med blandt andet udvikling af nye rapporter, processer og analytiske metoder. Lige nu arbejder vi primært i Power BI, BusinessObjects og Microsoft Excel.

Dine opgaver og din profil

For at blive vores nye kollega har du en relevant videregående uddannelse og flere års erfaring med databehandling og -analyse. Det er vigtigt, at du er løsningsorienteret og proaktiv. Du skal derudover være nysgerrig og have mod på at tilegne dig viden til opbygning af forretningsforståelse, ligesom det er vigtigt, at du evner at samarbejde bredt på tværs af styrelsen og Skatteforvaltningen.

Det er også en forudsætning, at du har gode skriftlige kompetencer, da data og analyser ofte skal indarbejdes i notater og skriftlige forelæggelser for direktionen.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:


er stærk i din mundtlige og skriftlige kommunikation
evner at formidle komplekse datasæt til ledere og kollegaer, som ikke har erfaring med data
har en procesorienteret tankegang med fokus på hele processen med dataindhentning, databehandling, dokumentation og levering af data
tager ansvar og får noget fra hånden uden at gå på kompromis med kvaliteten i arbejdet
er nysgerrig og proaktiv i din tilgang til arbejdet.


Derudover er det en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du har kendskab til BusinessObjects og PowerBI, herunder PowerQuery.

Analytisk tilgang, gode samarbejdsevner og handlekraftig

For at få succes i stillingen er det vigtigt, at du har en stærk analytisk sans, som gør dig i stand til at fordybe dig i komplekse problemstillinger indenfor databehandling og -analyse. Dertil har du politisk forståelse, så du kan se den kontekst, dit arbejde indgår i.

Til dagligt arbejder vi i teams og sparrer løbende på tværs. Det er vigtigt, at du gennem gode relationer med kollegaer i både Kvalitet og Styring og på tværs af Motorstyrelsen bidrager som foregangsperson for en kultur, der er båret af faglighed, ordentlighed og ansvarlighed.

Vi leverer beslutningsgrundlag til direktionen og departementet, hvor tempoet til tider er højt, og opgaver kan opstå med kort varsel. Derfor søger vi en kollega, der trives med til tider korte deadlines, som kan holde overblik og prioritere og omstille sig hurtigt. Samtidigt er det vigtigt, at du har et skarpt blik for kvalitet og detaljer, så beslutningsgrundlaget altid er præcist og pålideligt.

Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår

Send os din ansøgning, CV og dokumentation for uddannelse og kompetencer via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest den 6. september 2026 kl. 23.59.

Du kan få yderligere oplysninger om stillingen, opgaver og organisationen hos kontorchef Flemming Hansen. Send en sms på tlf. 72 37 88 49, hvorefter Flemming ringer dig op.

Flemming afholder ferie i ugerne 35 og 36. Her kan HR-Partner Mette Holm Nielsen kontaktes på telefon 72 37 25 07.

Vi forventer at afholde første samtale uge 37 og anden samtale uge 38. Der kan indgå en logisk test og en personanalyse i ansættelsesforløbet.

Forud for ansættelse indhenter vi referencer og straffeattest.

Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC), overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og It-medarbejdere (HK) eller overenskomst for fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet.

Du bliver ansat i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner. Dit arbejdssted bliver Lauritzens Plads 1, 9000 Aalborg. Tiltrædelse pr. 1. november 2026 eller efter aftale.

Gør en forskel på motorområdet

Faglighed og fællesskab er vejen frem

Motorstyrelsen arbejder for hele Danmark med afsæt i Aalborg. Vi omsætter lovgivning til virkelighed og sørger hver dag for, at alle de køretøjer, der holder gang i Danmark og danskernes hverdag, kan komme ud på vejene. Vi sikrer et effektivt og velfungerende bilmarked i Danmark til gavn for alle.

Hos os er der ikke kun fart over feltet, men også højt til loftet. Vi tror på, at mangfoldighed spiller os bedre, og vi har en åben kultur, hvor dine idéer og perspektiver værdsættes. Vi arbejder aktivitetsbaseret, så opgaverne definerer rammerne. Hos os finder du både dem, der vil lære nyt, dem der kan lære fra sig, dem der trives i faste rammer, dem der sætter pris på fleksibilitet, dem der nørder biler og dem, der cykler på arbejde.

Læs mere om Motorstyrelsen på motorst.dk .

Motorstyrelsen opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere uanset alder, køn, seksuel orientering, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

Du skal derudover være nysgerrig og have mod på at tilegne dig viden til opbygning af forretningsforståelse, ligesom det er vigtigt, at du evner at samarbejde bredt på tværs af styrelsen og Skatteforvaltningen.

Det er også en forudsætning, at du har gode skriftlige kompetencer, da data og analyser ofte skal indarbejdes i notater og skriftlige forelæggelser for direktionen.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:

  • er stærk i din mundtlige og skriftlige kommunikation
  • evner at formidle komplekse datasæt til ledere og kollegaer, som ikke har erfaring med data
  • har en procesorienteret tankegang med fokus på hele processen med dataindhentning, databehandling, dokumentation og levering af data
  • tager ansvar og får noget fra hånden uden at gå på kompromis med kvaliteten i arbejdet
  • er nysgerrig og proaktiv i din tilgang til arbejdet.

Derudover er det en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du har kendskab til BusinessObjects og PowerBI, herunder PowerQuery.

Analytisk tilgang, gode samarbejdsevner og handlekraftig

For at få succes i stillingen er det vigtigt, at du har en stærk analytisk sans, som gør dig i stand til at fordybe dig i komplekse problemstillinger indenfor databehandling og -analyse. Dertil har du politisk forståelse, så du kan se den kontekst, dit arbejde indgår i.

Til dagligt arbejder vi i teams og sparrer løbende på tværs. Det er vigtigt, at du gennem gode relationer med kollegaer i både Kvalitet og Styring og på tværs af Motorstyrelsen bidrager som foregangsperson for en kultur, der er båret af faglighed, ordentlighed og ansvarlighed.

Vi leverer beslutningsgrundlag til direktionen og departementet, hvor tempoet til tider er højt, og opgaver kan opstå med kort varsel. Derfor søger vi en kollega, der trives med til tider korte deadlines, som kan holde overblik og prioritere og omstille sig hurtigt. Samtidigt er det vigtigt, at du har et skarpt blik for kvalitet og detaljer, så beslutningsgrundlaget altid er præcist og pålideligt.

Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår

Send os din ansøgning, CV og dokumentation for uddannelse og kompetencer via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest den 6. september 2026 kl. 23.59.

Du kan få yderligere oplysninger om stillingen, opgaver og organisationen hos kontorchef Flemming Hansen. Send en sms på tlf. 72 37 88 49, hvorefter Flemming ringer dig op.

Flemming afholder ferie i ugerne 35 og 36. Her kan HR-Partner Mette Holm Nielsen kontaktes på telefon 72 37 25 07.

Vi forventer at afholde første samtale uge 37 og anden samtale uge 38. Der kan indgå en logisk test og en personanalyse i ansættelsesforløbet.

Forud for ansættelse indhenter vi referencer og straffeattest.

Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC), overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og It-medarbejdere (HK) eller overenskomst for fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet.

Du bliver ansat i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner. Dit arbejdssted bliver Lauritzens Plads 1, 9000 Aalborg. Tiltrædelse pr. 1. november 2026 eller efter aftale.

Gør en forskel på motorområdet

Faglighed og fællesskab er vejen frem

Motorstyrelsen arbejder for hele Danmark med afsæt i Aalborg. Vi omsætter lovgivning til virkelighed og sørger hver dag for, at alle de køretøjer, der holder gang i Danmark og danskernes hverdag, kan komme ud på vejene. Vi sikrer et effektivt og velfungerende bilmarked i Danmark til gavn for alle.

Hos os er der ikke kun fart over feltet, men også højt til loftet. Vi tror på, at mangfoldighed spiller os bedre, og vi har en åben kultur, hvor dine idéer og perspektiver værdsættes. Vi arbejder aktivitetsbaseret, så opgaverne definerer rammerne. Hos os finder du både dem, der vil lære nyt, dem der kan lære fra sig, dem der trives i faste rammer, dem der sætter pris på fleksibilitet, dem der nørder biler og dem, der cykler på arbejde.

Læs mere om Motorstyrelsen på motorst.dk .

Motorstyrelsen opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere uanset alder, køn, seksuel orientering, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

Title: Analytiker til Business Intelligence
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Har du interesse for data og analyse, som understøtter tusindvis af kunders behov og vigtige beslutninger i Jyske Bank-koncernen? Og motiveres du af at arbejde tæt på både forretningen og de tekniske løsninger? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Jobbet – gør data til værdi

I Business Intelligence arbejder vi hver dag på at omsætte data til indsigt, handling og forretningsmæssig værdi. Vi udvikler dashboards, analyser og intelligente dataløsninger, som bruges bredt i koncernen – fra bank og realkredit til stabsfunktioner og kundevendte områder i såvel Privat som Erhverv.

Som analytiker får du mulighed for at præge hele processen. Du er med fra de første idéer og dialoger med forretningen til udvikling, implementering og forankring af løsninger, der skaber konkrete resultater. Du kommer tæt på beslutningstagerne og får mulighed for at se dine analyser blive omsat til handling.

Bliv en del af et stærkt fagligt fællesskab

Hos Jyske Bank får du mulighed for at arbejde med nogle af Danmarks mest spændende data- og analyseopgaver i en organisation, hvor data spiller en central rolle i den strategiske udvikling.

Du bliver en del af et fagligt miljø, hvor der er en åben og uformel tone, gode udviklingsmuligheder og stor frihed til at påvirke både løsninger og egen faglige udvikling. Hos os får du kolleger, der elsker at nørde med data, kode og avanceret modellering – og som samtidig værdsætter humor, sammenhold samt en uformel omgangstone.

Du bliver en del af et engageret team bestående af 9 specialister og 2 studentermedhjælpere, som deler en passion for data, problemløsning og høj faglighed.

Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes i fællesskab. Derfor prioriterer vi samarbejde, videndeling og sparring højt. Samtidig giver vi plads til fordybelse, nysgerrighed og eksperimenter med nye teknologier og metoder.

Dine primære opgaver



Udvikle og formidle dashboards og datadrevne løsninger, der understøtter forretningens beslutninger
Sparre med interessenter om mulighederne i data og analyser
Omsætte komplekse forretningsbehov til brugbare og værdiskabende løsninger
Bidrage til indberetninger til offentlige myndigheder blandt andet Nationalbanken og Finanstilsynet
Samarbejde tæt med kolleger og interessenter på tværs af hele koncernen



Din profil

Du motiveres af at skabe værdi gennem data og får energi af at løse komplekse problemstillinger. Du er analytisk dygtig, nysgerrig og trives med at dykke ned i data for at finde svar og nye muligheder.

Det kan være en fordel hvis du har erfaring fra en lignende rolle og motiveres af at omsætte data til indsigt, der skaber værdi. Du arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt, men ved også, at de bedste resultater ofte skabes gennem samarbejde.

Derudover forestiller vi os, at:



Du har gode kompetencer inden for dataanalyse, datamodellering og programmering
Du har solid erfaring med SAS eller lignende værktøjer
Du har erfaring med at bruge AI-værktøjer som fx Copilot eller lignende.
Du er tryg ved at bruge AI til at løse opgaver, f.eks. til at strukturere, skrive eller analysere og kan forholde dig kritisk til outputtet.
Du har evnen til at formidle komplekse analyser på en enkel og forståelig måde
Du har en relevant kandidatuddannelse, eksempelvis cand.polit., cand.scient.oecon., cand.merc.IT, cand.scient. i matematik eller tilsvarende



Ansøgning

Ansøgningsfristen er 31. august 2026, men vi gennemgår ansøgninger løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Vi oplever mangfoldighed som en fordel i vores opgaveløsning og i vores fællesskab. Derfor opfordrer vi alle til at søge.

HR Rekrutteringspartner Amalie Stensgaard vil håndtere din ansøgning.

Title: Quantitative Developer - Python
Description:
Qube Research & Technologies (QRT) is a global quantitative and systematic investment manager, operating in all liquid asset classes across the world. We are a technology and data driven group implementing a scientific approach to investing. Combining data, research, technology, and trading expertise has shaped our collaborative mindset, which enables us to solve the most complex challenges. QRT’s culture of innovation continuously drives our ambition to deliver high quality returns for our investors.




You will join a quantitative development function that works closely with Researchers, Traders and Cloud Engineering teams to build applications, data pipelines and analytics that support research and trading workflows. The role combines software engineering, quantitative development and data engineering, with responsibility for developing production applications, supporting research infrastructure and integrating large scale datasets.




Your future role within QRT

Design, develop, deploy and maintain cloud native Python applications supporting research and trading workflows, including market data dashboards, risk analytics, profit and loss reporting, weather analytics and performance analysis
Develop quantitative tools including backtesting frameworks, optimisation tools, pricing libraries and ETL pipelines for integrating and validating alternative datasets
Build and maintain scalable data pipelines that support model development and production workflows
Monitor, support, debug and enhance existing research and trading infrastructure
Work closely with Researchers, Traders and Engineering teams to deliver production quality solutions that meet evolving business requirements




Your present skillset

At least three years of professional Python development experience
Strong knowledge of Python, including numerical libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Polars and Xarray
Strong quantitative mindset with an interest in working closely with trading and research functions
Experience developing user interfaces or an interest in building data visualisation applications such as Plotly, Dash or Streamlit is beneficial
Experience with AWS or another cloud platform together with infrastructure as code technologies (e.g. Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, RDS or AWS CDK is advantageous)
Good knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL together with object storage technologies
Experience developing ETL pipelines and working with large scale datasets
Strong understanding of software engineering practices including version control, automated testing, packaging and deployment
Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver production solutions
Experience with parallel or distributed computing is advantageous




QRT is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity as essential to our success. QRT empowers employees to work openly and respectfully to achieve collective success. In addition to professional achievement, we are offering initiatives and programs to enable employees achieve a healthy work-life balance.

Title: BI Udvikler til Business Intelligence afdelingen
Place: Kolding Municipality, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Bliv en vigtig del af vores datadrevne udvikling

Er du stærk inden for datawarehousing, datamodellering og Power BI – og motiveres du af at bygge løsninger, som bliver brugt i hele organisationen?




I Davidsen arbejder vi målrettet med at udvikle vores dataplatform og styrke vores datadrevne beslutningsgrundlag. Vores BI-platform er en integreret del af dagligdagen i Davidsen og bidrager allerede i dag til værdifulde indsigter for forretningen.




Da en af vores BI Udviklere har fået nye spændende udfordringer internt, søger vi en BI Udvikler, der vil være med til at videreudvikle vores dataplatform og styrke vores evne til i højere grad også at understøtte automatiserede og handlingsskabende løsninger på tværs af forretningen.




Om rollen

Som BI Udvikler bliver du en del af BI-afdelingen, som i dag består af 3 medarbejdere. Afdelingen har ansvaret for hele Davidsens BI-platform – fra dataeksport til de endelige rapporter. Du får, sammen med en af dine nye kollegaer, ansvaret for vedligeholdelse og videreudviklingen af vores datawarehouse og datamodellering.




På nogle projekter vil du også selv stå for udviklingen af Power BI rapporterne, men i andre tilfælde vil teamets business controller stå for dette. Du vil ligeledes have mulighed for arbejde med automatisering indenfor Power Platform, Python og AI, afhængigt af dine interesser og kompetencer. 




Dine primære opgaver

·  Design, udvikling og vedligehold af datapipelines

·  Udvikling og vedligeholdelse af Davidsens datawarehouse og tabulare modeller

·  Bistå som teknisk kompetence i udarbejdelsen af nye BI rapporter, fra identificering og modellering af data til udviklingen af rapporten

·  Optimering af datakørsler

·  Automatisering af processer, herunder både udvikling og drift af eksisterende stand-alone løsninger i Excel/VBA, Python og Power Platform.

·  Sparring med stakeholders og internt i teamet om tekniske løsninger




Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant akademisk baggrund indenfor data, økonomi eller lign. Det vigtigste er dog, at du har praktisk erfaring og kompetencer indenfor:




· Erfaring med ETL-processer og datamodellering

· Stærke færdigheder i SQL, Python og DAX

· Erfaring med Azure Data Factory, Azure DevOps og IaC

· Har bygget Power BI rapporter til slutbrugere

· Kompetencer indenfor Power Platform og VBA er et plus




Du arbejder struktureret og detaljeorienteret, men har samtidig blik for forretningens behov og evner at omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til brugbare løsninger. Som person er du nysgerrig, ansvarlig og samarbejdsorienteret, og du motiveres af at være med til at udvikle en BI-platform, der skaber reel værdi på tværs af organisationen.




Vi tilbyder

Vi tilbyder en spændende stilling med base i Kolding, hvor du får mulighed for at arbejde med et cloudbaseret BI-setup indenfor Microsoft-stacken. Samtidig bliver du en central del af udviklingen mod både et fremtidig BI-setup i Fabric, samt en dataplatform hvor både AI og automatisering får en gradvist større rolle i måden vi arbejder med data og værdiskabelsen på.




Du bliver en del af et team, der brænder for at gøre hverdagen nemmere for vores kollegaer på tværs af organisationen. Det faglige niveau er i top, og entusiasmen er lige så stor, når snakken over bordene går på et forbedret DAX-statement, som når der er kage på kontoret. 




Når du bliver en del af Davidsen, bliver du samtidig del af et stærkt fællesskab på tværs af organisationen, hvor ”Vi løser det” er mere end et motto. Det er vores mindset. Og du kommer til at høre dine kollegaer sige det igen og igen. I Davidsen løfter vi i flok og tager fælles ansvar. Vi løser det – sammen!




Ansøgning

Kan du se dig selv som vores nye BI Udvikler, så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, inden du sender din ansøgning, er du velkommen til at kontakte vores Head of IT & Data, Christian Skovgaard - +45 60 29 26 51




Vi behandler ansøgningerne løbende og ansætter så snart, vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Så send din ansøgning allerede i dag.

Title: Data Engineer
Place: Ballerup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Do you want to help shape the future of data and analytics in a global MedTech company?

Bespoke data solutions supporting various business functions

Title: Data Engineer / Backend Developer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
We're looking for our 4th team member!

Do you thrive creating structure in chaos?

Would you like to be a part of shaping the data infrastructure in a growing startup?

Does your Python code run like a well oiled machine, handling massive datasets with ease?

Then proprty.ai might be just the place for you!

The Product

We're building an exciting product to help property owners maintain buildings in a timely, cost-effective, and sustainable manner. We integrate public and private data sources, statistical models, and AI to deliver a modern consumer grade user experience in our app.

The software we’re building includes tools for condition assessment of individual building parts on a property, gathering public data for a building portfolio overview and creating ML & AI models for predicting remaining lifespan and forecasting maintenance cost.

The product went live in 2024, and is solving real problems for real people, and there's SO many things we can do to make it even better!

About You

We won't pretend there's a perfect checklist, but here's who we imagine joining us:


You have a couple of years of professional experience building data pipelines, backend services, or similar setups.
You take personal pride in your work. You want your work to matter.
You're a startup type more than a corporate type: you prefer short decision paths over steering committees, you'd rather ask "why not?" than wait for a mandate, and you're comfortable when the answer to "who owns this?" is sometimes "you do, as of now".
You create structure rather than wait for it. Ambiguity doesn't paralyze you.


About Us

The team consists of three people, two Data Scientists and one Data Engineer, working closely with our app team of five. We’re looking for a Backend Developer/Data Engineer to join us in developing and optimizing our data pipelines, backend services, and integrations. Most of our setup is in Databricks on Azure, using Python and SQL for the tasks.

We're expanding into Norway, the Netherlands, Germany and Switzerland, and we need more hands on creating a globalized and scalable setup for the years to come!

The job

Our team is creating an analytics heavy backend both serving the development and implementation of AI & ML models, and providing foundational data for our app team.

You’ll be the second in proprty.ai in this specific area of expertise and should have at least a couple of years of experience from developing similar setups.

Your Main Responsibilities Will Be


To evaluate and improve our tech-stack, database structure, and data flow.
Creating structured data using a collection of data from multiple sources.
Integrating new data sources in the current data flow.
Ensuring that data pipelines run flawlessly.
Connect our database and data science setup to both our frontend and external systems.
Develop API integrations
Help drive tech and AI adoption across the teams in proprty.ai


Most of the tasks above should be familiar to you.

Location

We're located in a beautiful historic open office space right next to Rådhuspladsen. We usually work from home on Wednesdays.

This position requires you to be in the office four days every week.

TL;DR

If you have opinions on creating the best data infrastructure and want to be a part of a growing team of young people on a mission to change the industry, apply now.

Title: Consultant til Supply Chain Operations
Description:
Introduktion

Brænder du for at arbejde med data og analyser? Vil du bruge din analytiske sans til at optimere processer inden for Supply Chain? Så er du måske dig, vi søger til Supply Chain Operations!

Stillingen er for dig, som vil optimere, sætte dit præg og være med til at gøre hverdagen lettere for dine kolleger i vores butikker.

Du bliver en del af Supply Chain Operations, som hører under den centrale afdeling, Supply Chain, som består af 2 underafdelinger. Her er din fornemste opgave at analysere data og tendenser, som er afgørende for at de rigtige beslutninger bliver truffet.

Supply Chain Operations er bindeleddet mellem vores butikker og hovedkontoret. Afdelingens overordnede mål er at støtte vores kolleger i butikkerne og regioner ved at sikre enkle og effektive arbejdsgange.

Supply Chain Operations består af 5 medarbejdere, som arbejder med optimering af vores processer i forbindelse med planlægning, opfølgning og analysering af varetilgængelighed. Hertil skal vi bruge din analytiske tilgang og talforståelse.

Om jobbet


Bearbejdning af data, statistikker og tendenser med henblik på optimering
Optimere interne processer og systemer for automatisk varebestilling
Drive ugentlige rapporteringer af diverse KPI’er
Forecast-analyse af sortimentsvarer med henblik på at sikre fuld varetilgængelighed i vores butikker
Pleje diverse data i vores interne systemer, som bruges til videreanalyse af varer


Om dig


Du har en relevant uddannelse eller baggrund og gerne erfaring fra detail
Du er udadvendt og har gode kommunikative evner – du kan omsætte store mængder data til letforståelige budskaber
Du er struktureret og sætter en ære i at overholde deadlines uden at gå på kompromis med kvaliteten
Du trives med at eksperimentere og teste systemindstillinger
Du er ekspert i Excel/Sheets og har erfaring med VBA, JavaScript eller andre programmeringssprog


Vi tilbyder


Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med faglig sparring og motiverede kolleger
Målrettet oplæring i alle processer samt mentorordning, så du har de bedste forudsætninger for at lykkes i jobbet
Grænseløse karrieremuligheder og faglige udfordringer
Attraktiv pensionsordning og mulighed for sundhedspakke
Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm.


Hovedkontor i hjertet af Aarhus

Vi har et stort og innovativt hovedkontor på Godsbanen i Aarhus.

Her får du som medarbejder adgang til:


Gratis fitnesscenter
In-house massageordning
Sund kantineordning med mulighed for morgenmad, frokost og nem aftensmad (take-away) – alt sammen med minimum 30 % økologi.


Derudover får du mulighed for at deltage i sociale aktiviteter som f.eks. morgenyoga på tagterrassen, løbeklub, familiedag og fredagsbarer.

Da vi løbende gennemgår de indkomne ansøgninger, forbeholder vi os retten til at tage stillingsopslaget ned, så snart vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Derfor anbefaler vi at du søger hurtigst muligt.

I rekrutteringsprocessen kan du forvente: screening, telefoninterview, kognitiv test og jobsamtaler.

Tiltrædelse er hurtigst muligt.

Har du spørgsmål?

Ved spørgsmål til jobbet eller rekrutteringsprocessen kan du kontakte vores recruiter, Johanne Rasmussen, på tlf. 60 34 02 38 på hverdage mellem kl. 09.00 og 15.00 eller ved at sende en mail til jobilidlhq@lidl.dk

Ansøg i dag - Det betaler sig!

Title: Financial Systems Specialist
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, not just juice, sandwiches, coffee, and much more. When joining us, you step into a high-energy community where the music is loud, the bar is your stage, and your personality matters as much as your skills.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:


Positive Attitude
Inclusion
Social Ties
Growth


For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the bar by creating great guest experiences, and use every shift as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you’ll be part of an international network of Juicers who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You will learn by doing, move through our Moneyball career path, our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion, and be part of a company where most leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!).

If you love fast-paced service, music, people, and the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that can take you across cities, countries, and roles.

The Role

The Financial Systems Specialist is responsible for owning and optimizing FP&A systems and data infrastructure, ensuring scalable, reliable, and insight-driven financial planning processes. The role enables high-quality decision-making by delivering automated workflows, robust data integrity, and actionable reporting across the business.

Working closely with FP&A and cross-functional stakeholders, this role drives system excellence, continuous improvement, and standardization of processes. As part of the Business Intelligence team, the position plays a key role in strengthening the foundation for budgeting, forecasting, and performance insights, supporting the company’s operational efficiency and growth ambitions.

Key Responsabilities


Own and manage FP&A systems, ensuring they are optimized, scalable, and aligned with evolving business requirements.
Develop and deliver Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions that provide clear, actionable insights to support decision-making.
Drive workflow automation and process standardization, improving efficiency, accuracy, and scalability across FP&A processes.
Partner with FP&A and business stakeholders to identify, design, and implement system and process improvements.
Ensure data integrity, consistency, and reliability across budgeting and forecasting processes.
Troubleshoot system issues and provide expert guidance to stakeholders on best practices and effective system usage.
Build and strengthen the overall FP&A infrastructure, enabling seamless planning, reporting, and performance tracking.
Leverage emerging technologies to enhance automation, improve workflows, and future-proof financial systems.


What You Bring


Experience with FP&A software, and having experience with Workday Adaptive Planning is a plus
Strong hands-on experience with Power BI and having experience with other Power Platform Products is a plus.
Background in FP&A with demonstrated ability to deliver insightful and impactful financial analysis.
Solid understanding of master data management and its importance in financial systems and reporting.
High attention to detail and a structured, thorough approach to work.
Master’s degree in a relevant field


About Joe & The Juice

JOE & THE JUICE is a healthy fast-casual concept founded in Copenhagen in 2002. Since then, we've grown to more than 500 locations across 20+ countries, employing more than 4,500 people worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028. From day one, our ambition has been to prove there's no trade-off between taste and health.

We serve high-quality, freshly prepared juices, shakes, coffee, and sandwiches in relaxed, contemporary cafés that combine convenience with distinct urban atmospheres. JOE & THE JUICE goes beyond products towards the full experience around the bar, creating one consistent universe for guests and Juicers across every location.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future.

Leadership & Educational Programs: Access continuous learning and growth opportunities through our comprehensive internal programs, workshops, training sessions, and mentorship designed to build your professional and leadership skills.

Travel & Development Opportunities: Experience diverse cultures and locations while developing your career. Take advantage of exchange programs, international assignments, and advancement opportunities that let you grow within the company and explore new horizons.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

Title: Senior Analyst, In-Field Repair Quality
Description:
As the largest global shared micromobility business, Lime is on a mission to build a future where transportation is shared, affordable and carbon-free. A Time Magazine 100 Most Influential Company, Lime has powered more than one billion rides in close to 30 countries across five continents, spurring a new generation of clean alternatives to car ownership. Learn more at li.me.

Lime is hiring a Senior Analyst to join our Global Operations team. In this role, you'll be at the forefront of improving in-field repair quality performance— developing key metrics, building tools that drive real-time visibility, and delivering targeted analysis that informs operational decisions and strategic opportunities.

You'll serve as the functional bridge between Local Operations and our Product organization, translating operational needs into structured data requirements and tooling improvements. You'll collaborate closely with Local Operations, Product, Data Science, and Hardware teams to help shape the future of Lime's in-field repair quality across all of our operations as we continue to scale.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, technically strong, and passionate about using data to solve complex problems. You're equally comfortable partnering with local operations teams and product or engineering stakeholders — and you know how to both structure a process and build a dashboard. If you have 3+ years of experience in business analytics or operations, strong data analysis and visualization skills, and a drive to influence outcomes through insight, we'd love to hear from you.

This is a hybrid role open to candidates based anywhere in Europe (London, Berlin, Paris, Munich, or Copenhagen preferred), within 120 minutes of a Lime warehouse. The role requires occasional travel (~10%) to Lime warehouses or other locations for team meetings.

What You’ll Do


Improve visibility into in-field repair quality: Define and maintain metrics to track repair performance, effectiveness, compliance, efficiency, and ROI — and build tooling to surface these insights in real time across operations
Build models and dashboards: Use SQL, Tableau, and spreadsheets to develop repair volume forecasting models, quality compliance dashboards, and performance reports for local operations teams — with robust logic, clearly defined assumptions, and intuitive interfaces

Jobbet: gør data til værdi

I Business Intelligence arbejder vi hver dag på at omsætte data til indsigt, handling og forretningsmæssig værdi. Vi udvikler dashboards, analyser og intelligente dataløsninger, som bruges bredt i koncernen, fra bank og realkredit til stabsfunktioner og kundevendte områder i såvel Privat som Erhverv.

Som analytiker får du mulighed for at præge hele processen. Du er med fra de første idéer og dialoger med forretningen til udvikling, implementering og forankring af løsninger, der skaber konkrete resultater. Du kommer tæt på beslutningstagerne og får mulighed for at se dine analyser blive omsat til handling.

Du bliver en del af et engageret team bestående af 9 specialister og 2 studentermedhjælpere, som deler en passion for data, problemløsning og høj faglighed.

Dine primære opgaver


Udvikle og formidle dashboards og datadrevne løsninger, der understøtter forretningens beslutninger
Sparre med interessenter om mulighederne i data og analyser
Omsætte komplekse forretningsbehov til brugbare og værdiskabende løsninger
Bidrage til indberetninger til offentlige myndigheder, blandt andet Nationalbanken og Finanstilsynet
Samarbejde tæt med kolleger og interessenter på tværs af hele koncernen


Din profil

Du motiveres af at skabe værdi gennem data og får energi af at løse komplekse problemstillinger. Du er analytisk dygtig, nysgerrig og trives med at dykke ned i data for at finde svar og nye muligheder. Det kan være en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra en lignende rolle.

Derudover Forestiller Vi Os, At


Du har gode kompetencer inden for dataanalyse, datamodellering og programmering
Du har solid erfaring med SAS eller lignende værktøjer
Du har erfaring med at bruge AI-værktøjer som fx Copilot eller lignende, og kan forholde dig kritisk til outputtet
Du har evnen til at formidle komplekse analyser på en enkel og forståelig måde
Du har en relevant kandidatuddannelse, eksempelvis cand.polit., cand.scient.oecon., cand.merc.IT, cand.scient. i matematik eller tilsvarende


Ansættelsestype: fastansættelse, fuldtid. Arbejdsstedet er København V.
