Title: Insight Analyst
Description:
Company Description/ Business Unit

Location: London (hybrid working 3 office days per week)

Employment Type: Permanent, full time

Additional Benefits: Annual Bonus

Think the AA is just about roadside assistance? Think again.

For over a century, we've been evolving and adapting. Today, as the nation's leading motoring organisation, we offer a wide range of products and services to millions of customers. From roadside assistance to home and motor insurance, and the latest driving technologies, we have it all. As we continue to expand, diversify, and modernise, joining us as an Insight Analyst means you'll play a crucial role in our success and be part of this exciting motoring journey.

Our Chief Operating Office (COO) are the backbone of The AA, providing both stability and structure to support growth and innovation. We are the drivers of change.

This is the job

More than data. Be the insight behind the decision.

As an Insight Analyst at the AA, you will use data, analysis and technology to help our teams make better decisions for our customers and our business. This is a hands-on, mid-level role where you will take ownership of analytical challenges, uncover meaningful insight and turn it into clear recommendations that people can act on.

But this role is about more than what happens behind the screen. You will build trusted relationships with stakeholders, get close to the challenges facing the business, ask the right questions and confidently bring your insight into conversations with people at all levels. You will work across teams to influence thinking, solve problems and make a tangible difference, while continuing to grow your technical and commercial capability.

If you are an analyst who enjoys both the technical challenge of finding the answer and the human challenge of bringing people with you, this is an opportunity to make your analysis count.

What will I be doing?


Own analytical questions from initial problem definition through to insight and recommendation, using data to identify trends, patterns, opportunities and areas for action.
Deliver high quality analysis using tools including Python and SQL, applying appropriate statistical and modelling techniques to solve business problems.
Build clear and engaging Power BI reporting and visualisations that enable stakeholders to understand performance and make informed decisions.
Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand their challenges, translate them into analytical requirements and confidently communicate findings and recommendations.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, BI Developers and Data Engineering colleagues to develop insight led data products and ensure the quality and availability of the data underpinning your analysis.
Contribute to continuous improvement across the team by sharing knowledge, improving analytical approaches and looking for better ways to turn data into business value.


What do I need?


Demonstrable experience in an Insight Analyst, Data Analyst or comparable analytical role, with the capability to independently take ownership of problems and drive them towards a solution.
Strong hands-on Power BI experience, including creating reporting and visualisations that turn complex information into accessible and meaningful insight.
Strong communication and stakeholder partnering skills, with the confidence to explain complex analysis clearly, influence conversations and present insight to stakeholders at different levels of an organisation.
Practical coding and analytical experience using Python, alongside SQL skills and the confidence to work with large and complex datasets.
A sound understanding of analytical and statistical techniques, with exposure to modelling approaches such as regression, clustering or classification.
A collaborative, curious and proactive approach, with the judgement to ask the right questions, challenge constructively and work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.


Additional information

Benefits

We’re always looking to recognise and reward our employees for the work they do. As a valued member of The AA team, you’ll have access to a range of benefits including:


25 days annual leave plus bank holidays + holiday buying scheme
Worksave pension scheme with up to 7% employer contribution
Free AA breakdown membership from Day 1 plus 50% discount for family and friends
Discounts on AA products including car and home insurance
Employee discount scheme that gives you access to a car salary sacrifice scheme plus great discounts on healthcare, shopping, holidays and more
Company funded life assurance
Diverse learning and development opportunities to support you to progress in your career
Dedicated Employee Assistance Programme and a 24/7 remote GP service for you and your family


Plus, so much more!

We’re an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from everyone. The AA values diversity and the difference this brings to our culture and our customers. We actively seek people from diverse backgrounds to join us and become part of an inclusive company where you can be yourself, be empowered to be your best and feel like you truly belong. We have five communities to bring together people with shared characteristics and backgrounds and drive positive change.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: London

About The Team

The Cloudflare Data Intelligence & Analytics (DIA) team has built a unified data & ML platform to provide our internal Business Partners with actionable analytics, insights, and recommendations.

Our goals are to:


Democratize data & intelligence for humans and agents
Build a context layer and an AI systems layer upon our unified data & content platform
Support Cloudflare’s critical business needs



DIA is a : 75-member strong geographically distributed but organizationally centralized team. This role is within the growth & adoption analytics pod based in London that works across several business functions, offering broad exposure to Cloudflare's entire business.

Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Analyst in London to scale our growth & adoption analytics initiatives. You will be a trusted data advisor to our business partners, a technical coach to your peers, and the lead in terms of shaping AI-first data models, workflows, and agent-ready-datasets.

Success in this role will rely on marrying a strong analytics background with product and business acumen to deliver highly strategic and compelling insights that accelerate growth and influence adoption. This role also requires a deep understanding of data infrastructure, job orchestration, and lineage, all with the use of AI-tooling as default.

Role Responsibilities


Own the development and maintenance of agent-ready curated datasets end-to-end
Provide analytics support and a strategic perspective to our business partners
Partner with data engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to enable data-driven answers to key business problems
Review Merge Requests created by your team of humans and agents
Take initiative to gather requirements, define, build, and maintain pipelines and metrics
Tell easily digestible and highly actionable stories with data to help stakeholders understand analytical insights



Role Requirements


B.S. or M.S in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or other quantitative fields
Demonstrable proficiency with analytics-relevant AI-tooling
4+ years experience in a centralized data analytics teams in close partnership with business stakeholders
Expert-level proficiency in writing and optimizing complex SQL queries is mandatory, with a proven ability to performance-tune complex queries and manage analysis workflows against large, petabyte-scale datasets (Candidates will be assessed on advanced SQL skills including window functions and common table expressions (CTEs))
3+ years experience working in version control environments using platforms such as Gitlab or Github
2+ years experience working with job orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, both as a pipeline developer and reviewer
2+ years experience with data ingestion and transformation frameworks (e.g., dbt, Fivetran, or custom/in-house developed platforms)
Initiative, curiosity, strong stakeholder engagement, and empathy
Experience translating business questions into analysis frameworks, converting results into business recommendations, and presenting those to stakeholders



Nice-to-Have Experience


Experience and/or a keen interest in internet security, protocols, and edge-development
Analytics experience in a fast-growing technology, SaaS, or subscription-based business
Experience with statistical analysis programming languages (Python, R etc.)



What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

Title: Data Analyst – Fund Management
Description:
Data Analyst – Fund Management | London | Competitive + Bonus




SQL | Python | Data Visualisation (Power BI / Tableau) | Data Warehousing (Snowflake / Databricks)




Our client, a leading US private markets fund manager, is looking for a Data Analyst to join its London office and play a central role in building modern data and analytics capability across the business. This is a hands-on technical role where your SQL, Python, data visualisation, and cloud data warehousing skills will be used daily — and developed further.




The role:

Sitting at the intersection of the commercial business and technology, you'll design and deliver the data infrastructure, analytics, and reporting that drive client-facing and sales decision-making. Day to day you will:

Write and optimise SQL against a Snowflake cloud data warehouse, working across multiple source systems (CRM, sales, client, product, and flows data)
Use Python for analysis, automation of data retrieval and transformation, and prototyping new solutions
Build and maintain polished, well-governed dashboards and data models in Power BI / Tableau that give stakeholders genuine decision-grade insight
Support the development of scalable data pipelines and infrastructure, helping move the business beyond static reporting into automated, workflow-embedded intelligence
Identify and remediate data quality issues, championing governance, consistency, and structured data classification
Partner with sales, client-facing, and technology teams — translating commercial problems into practical data solutions and explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences




The role requires:

Strong SQL — confident querying, joining, and modelling data, ideally in a cloud platform such as Snowflake (or Databricks/similar)
Working knowledge of Python for analytics and automation
Hands-on data visualisation experience with Power BI or Tableau, including data modelling and building scalable, performant datasets
Data warehousing experience — understanding of pipeline design, transformation, and working across multiple source systems
Experience gained as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role; backgrounds ranging from a few years' experience through to established analysts will be considered
Financial services / asset management exposure is a plus, not a prerequisite — as is any experience with AI-assisted analytics or ML use cases
A proactive, curious mindset with strong communication skills and attention to detail
Degree in a quantitative field (Data Science, Computer Science, Business Analytics or similar) preferred




What's on offer:

Hybrid working, generous holiday, strong health and wellbeing benefits, paid volunteering, professional development and qualification support, and genuine scope to shape how data, analytics, and AI are used across a growing function.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst (Insight & Performance)
Description:
Business Intelligence Analyst (Insight & Performance)

Improving lives in Oldham

Salary: £48,750

Location: Oldham (Hybrid Working)

Contract: Permanent

Hours: 37 hours per week

Reporting to: Head of Business Intelligence




About the role

First Choice Homes Oldham (FCHO) has an exciting opportunity for a Business Intelligence Analyst (Insight & Performance) to join our Business Intelligence team and help shape how data and insight are used across the organisation.

This is a key business partnering role where you will work with services across FCHO to understand their priorities, translate business needs into meaningful analysis and provide clear, trusted insight that supports better decisions and service improvement.

You will design and develop dashboards and reports, undertake deep-dive analysis and support statutory and regulatory reporting. You will also help FCHO move beyond hindsight reporting by identifying trends, performance drivers and emerging risks, contributing to a more proactive and insight-led organisation.

Please see the full Job Description attached at the bottom of this page.

The impact you’ll make

You will provide high-quality performance reporting and analysis that gives colleagues, leaders and the Board a clear and consistent view of organisational performance.

Act as a trusted business partner to directorates, translating service priorities into analytical and reporting requirements.
Provide proactive insight into performance, identifying trends, risks, opportunities and the root causes of performance issues.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports aligned to organisational KPIs and the performance management framework.
Support Executive, Board and Committee reporting, ensuring insight is accurate, consistent and clearly presented.
Support statutory and regulatory reporting, including Tenant Satisfaction Measures and Statistical Data Returns.
Undertake quantitative and qualitative analysis, including analysis of survey data and customer feedback.
Translate complex data into clear, engaging and actionable recommendations for non-technical audiences.
Develop and maintain SQL queries and views to support reporting and analysis.
Work closely with Analytics Engineers and Data colleagues to shape and use trusted analytical datasets.
Identify opportunities to improve reporting, automation and analytical processes.
Help embed a data-driven culture by supporting colleagues to understand and use data effectively.

Our ideal candidate

You will be an analytical, curious and collaborative BI professional who can combine strong technical skills with effective stakeholder engagement and data storytelling.

A relevant degree, professional qualification or equivalent practical experience in a data, analytics or technology-related field.
Experience working in a Business Intelligence or Data Analyst role.
Experience developing dashboards and reports in Power BI.
Strong SQL skills, including extracting and manipulating data.
Experience delivering performance reporting and analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data.
The ability to turn data into meaningful, actionable insight that supports decision-making.
Excellent communication, presentation and data storytelling skills.
Strong stakeholder engagement and business partnering capability.
High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and accuracy.
Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
A proactive and collaborative approach, with a commitment to continuous improvement.

It would also be great if you have:

An A Level in Maths or Statistics.
Experience using Python or similar analytical tools.
Knowledge of predictive or advanced analytics techniques.
Experience analysing survey or customer data.
Experience supporting regulatory or statutory reporting.
Experience using Microsoft Fabric or another modern data platform.
Experience with AI-assisted tools such as Copilot, OpenAI or Gemini.
Experience within social housing or another regulated sector.

Why join FCHO?

First Choice Homes Oldham is a housing association providing safe, affordable and high-quality homes across Oldham and the surrounding areas. We own and manage more than 11,500 homes and are proud to hold the highest G1/V1 regulatory rating.

Our work is focused on providing quality homes, excellent services and thriving communities. We care deeply about our customers, colleagues and neighbourhoods and are committed to improving lives across Oldham.

What’s in it for you?

A salary of £48,750 per annum.
A 37-hour working week with hybrid working options.
30 days’ annual leave plus 8 bank holidays.
Option to purchase additional annual leave.
Defined contribution pension scheme with up to 10% employer contribution and salary exchange option.
Death in service benefit.
Healthcare cash plan covering dental, optical and physiotherapy treatments.
Private health insurance.
Employee Assistance Programme offering 24-hour confidential support.
Doctorline, giving you and your family 24/7 GP access.
Access to our colleague benefits platform, including retail discounts and wellbeing tools.
Discounted gym membership.
Professional subscriptions paid where essential for the role.
Enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and sick pay.
Access to our on-site wellbeing room and café.
Long service awards.

Interested?

If you are passionate about using data and insight to improve performance, support better decisions and make a positive difference for customers and communities, we’d love to hear from you.

Please submit your application by 26/08/2026.

Please note that we reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we receive a high volume of suitable applications.

Inclusion and accessibility

We are committed to building an organisation that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and skills, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. As an equal opportunities employer, FCHO is committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective colleagues and does not condone discrimination on the basis of age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, or marriage and civil partnership.

We aspire to have a diverse and inclusive workplace and strongly encourage suitably qualified applicants from a wide range of backgrounds to apply and join us.

Title: Advanced Analytics - Data Analyst - SQL
Description:
Data Analyst - Advanced Analytics

Middlesex / Hybrid - 3 days per week in the office

£40,000 - £60,000 + excellent benefits, depending on experience

Ref: J13172




Join a high-performing analytics team and make an impact at scale.




If you're an ambitious Data Analyst looking for more than just another reporting role, this could be an opportunity worth exploring.

Our client is a highly successful, globally recognised organisation with an established reputation in its sector and a genuinely exciting data agenda. With analytics playing an increasingly important role in how the business operates and makes decisions, they are investing heavily in their people, technology and capabilities.




You’ll join a large, multi-disciplinary Advanced Analytics function that operates almost like an internal consultancy - partnering with teams across the organisation, tackling complex business challenges and delivering insights that genuinely influence decision-making.




This isn't a role where you'll simply be handed a set of requirements and asked to produce a dashboard. You'll be encouraged to ask questions, challenge thinking, uncover opportunities and turn data into meaningful commercial insight.




Why join?




This is an opportunity to become part of a highly successful organisation that puts real investment behind its people and analytics capability.

You’ll benefit from:




• Working within a high-profile, established global organisation

• An internal consultancy-style environment, giving you exposure to a huge variety of business areas and challenges

• The opportunity to work alongside experienced Analytics Leads and talented analytical peers

• Exposure to advanced technologies, data and analytical techniques

• Significant opportunities to develop your technical and commercial skillset

• Regular interaction with stakeholders across the wider business, including senior decision-makers

• The chance to work on exciting, high-impact projects rather than simply maintaining BAU reporting

• A strong package of employee benefits, perks and rewards

• A collaborative culture where ideas are encouraged and analytical thinking is genuinely valued

• Hybrid working, with 3 days per week in the Middlesex office




The opportunity




The Advanced Analytics team is headed up by four Analytics Leads, each working across exciting and innovative projects for the wider business.

As a Data Analyst, you’ll work closely with one of these Leads and your fellow analysts, becoming a trusted analytical partner to different areas of the organisation.




You'll take complex business questions, understand what the data is telling you and turn that into clear, commercially relevant insight.

You'll have plenty of opportunity to build your stakeholder management skills, present your findings to a broad audience and develop your ability to communicate technical concepts in a way that makes sense to non-technical people.




What you'll be doing




• Partner with core business areas to understand their data, reporting, visualisation and analytical requirements

• Work across a portfolio of dashboards, visualisations and data sources, driving their ongoing development and improvement

• Deliver robust and accurate datasets and visualisations within agreed timescales

• Structure complex problems and develop numerical models to support business decision-making

• Work collaboratively with multiple stakeholders, bringing people together and gaining buy-in for new ideas and approaches

• Use data to answer critical business questions and uncover meaningful insights

• Apply a range of analytical tools and technologies, including SQL, Tableau, Python and Excel

• Present your findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences




What we're looking for




We're looking for someone who is naturally curious about data and enjoys understanding the story behind the numbers.




You'll ideally have:




• At least 1 year's experience in a Data Analyst / Analyst position

• Strong SQL skills, alongside experience with Excel and Python (or similar)

• Experience working with large, complex or multiple datasets

• Experience designing and building dashboards and data visualisations, ideally using Tableau

• Experience analysing complex problems and turning findings into clear, actionable insights

• The ability to communicate analytical findings effectively to a broad stakeholder audience

• Experience managing databases and/or blending data from multiple sources

• Experience designing data structures for management information

• Strong presentation and communication skills

• The confidence to challenge and influence stakeholders, including senior audiences

• A creative, solutions-focused approach and a genuine desire to make things better




If you're looking for a role where you can broaden your commercial exposure, work on genuinely interesting problems, develop your technical toolkit and see the impact of your work across a successful global organisation, we'd love to hear from you.




Apply today for a confidential conversation and find out more.

Description:
Salary £40,000 - £45,000

Location: Sunderland

Updated: August 13, 2026

Here at Green Energy Advice Bureau (GEAB), we’re passionate about helping businesses reduce costs, improve operational efficiency, and achieve their sustainability goals through smarter energy solutions.

Due to our continued expansion, we are now searching for a Data & Insights Analyst to join our technical team.

Purpose of the Role

To own the design, accuracy, and insight generation of data and reporting processes across the business.

The role is central to maintaining reliable datasets, developing insightful reports and dashboards, and ensuring the organisation can make confident, data-driven decisions.

A strong command of SQL, familiarity with Zoho CRM and Zoho Analytics, and the ability to build automations natively within Zoho (e.g. Zoho Flow and Deluge scripting) is desired to deliver high-quality analytics, reporting, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities


Data Ownership & Management
Own the structure, integrity, and reliability of data across Zoho CRM and Zoho Analytics.
Design and maintain SQL queries that power core reports, dashboards, and reporting workflows.
Ensure data quality through proactive validation, reconciliation, and exception reporting.
Act as the primary point of contact for all business data requirements, translating stakeholder needs into robust reporting and analytics solutions.
Manage and document data logic, definitions, and relationships across key datasets.
Reporting & Insight Generation
Develop and maintain interactive dashboards and reports in Zoho Analytics to track performance across sales, operations, and finance.
Continuously refine SQL processes to improve the efficiency and accuracy of reporting.
Deliver ad hoc data analysis and clear, actionable recommendations to support operational and strategic decision-making.
Translate data into narrative insight, ensuring stakeholders understand not just the numbers but what they mean.
Ensure all reports and metrics are traceable back to trusted data sources.
Automation & Workflow (Zoho-native)
Build and maintain automations natively within Zoho (Zoho Flow, Deluge scripting, workflow rules) to streamline manual reporting and data processes.
Configure automated refresh schedules and exception alerts within Zoho Analytics and Zoho CRM.
Maintain integrations between Zoho CRM and Zoho Analytics using Zoho’s built-in connectors and tools.
Monitor automated workflows and system syncs, resolving discrepancies promptly.
Continuous Improvement & Governance
Drive ongoing improvements in reporting efficiency, scalability, and transparency.
Document and maintain clear procedures for all data and reporting processes.
Collaborate with finance, product, and operations teams to ensure data processes evolve with changing business needs.
Champion best practices in data governance, security, and version control.


Core Skills & Competencies


Expert SQL for data extraction, transformation, validation, and reporting.
Experience with Zoho CRM and Zoho Analytics (or equivalent relational databases/CRMs).
Strong Python and analytical skills.
Attention to detail, accuracy, and process documentation.
Problem-solving and the ability to identify trends, exceptions, and anomalies.
Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, with the ability to turn data into a compelling narrative and actionable insights.


Tools & Platforms

Zoho CRM, Zoho Analytics, Zoho Flow, SQL, Excel / Power Query, Jira, Microsoft 365 Suite.

Perks & Benefits


Salary £40,000 – £45,000
Office based Monday – Friday 9am-5pm
Private healthcare scheme
23 days holiday plus bank holidays
On-site canteen
Sell annual leave options
Up to £40 per month broadband allowance (no catch – just submit your bill)
Themed incentives, team nights out, summer & Christmas parties
Exciting rewards such as Wembley trips, Cup Finals, Hospitality suites for NUFC & SAFC, Las Vegas, Disneyland Paris holidays, cash prizes and much more!
Generous referral scheme paying up to £2000


A phenomenal office culture – themed days, fun incentives, and a genuinely supportive environment

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
The way people discover and book holidays is changing, and we're rebuilding our technology for what comes next.




We are Awaze, Europe’s largest managed vacation rentals and holiday resorts business, bringing together some of the continent’s most recognised travel brands, including cottages.com, Hoseasons, NOVASOL and James Villa Holidays.




With more than 1.5 million bookings every year, 100,000+ properties and customers across Europe, we already operate at serious scale. But the next chapter for Awaze is about much more than scale.




We’re embarking on an ambitious AI transformation that will reshape how our customers discover, plan and book their holidays, and how our engineering teams build the technology behind those experiences.




Our strategy spans AI-powered search, natural-language discovery, intelligent recommendations, richer property data and AI-assisted engineering, all underpinned by a platform built around speed, trust, quality and real-time data.




Position: Data Analyst

Reports to: Chief Data Officer




The Role




A high-visibility data analytical role sitting directly alongside the Chief Data Officer.




You will turn complex, often ambiguous business questions into clear insight and action, embedded into key commercial projects across Revenue, Marketing, Product, and Finance. You will also collaborate closely with the CDO's wider team (Data Engineering, Data Science, and Business Intelligence), acting as a bridge between the data function and the business, knowing when to self-serve and when to draw on specialist capability.




What you'll do day-to-day




Commercial project support Analytical horsepower on priority initiatives — pricing, demand, segmentation, owner acquisition.
Ad-hoc analysis Rapid-turnaround answers to questions from the CDO and senior leadership.
Cross-team collaboration Working with Data Engineering, Data Science, and BI to ensure insight lands with the right infrastructure and rigour behind it.
Stakeholder communication Clear, concise outputs for non-technical audiences up to C-suite.




What we're looking For:




Analytical mindset: Pattern recognition, sharp follow-up questions, and a restless curiosity, you find the insight others miss.
Commercial instinct: You know data only matters when it drives a decision.
SQL: Strong, confident querying of large datasets. Snowflake experience a plus.
Exce: Model-building, scenario analysis, outputs that speak for themselves.
AI tools: Comfortable with Claude, Copilot, and curious about what's next.
Collaboration: Equally effective working independently or alongside engineering, science, and BI teams.
Communication: Concise by default, credible with senior stakeholders.
Experience: Gained within a commercial or consumer business. Travel, e-commerce, or marketplace a plus.




What will we offer you?




Annual Bonus Scheme
25 days holidays (plus the option to buy an unlimited number of additional days)
Holiday Discounts (across all AWAZE brands)
Pension contribution scheme
Private healthcare
Personal training allowance via Sunlight
35 hour working week
Hybrid working (we work 2 days in our Manchester office every week, with 3 days working from home)




Get in touch, we'd love to chat:




If you're interested in transforming the industry and reinventing how our technology powers everyday amazing holidays, please send your profile to jody.marks@awaze.com and let's chat today.

Title: Data Analyst - FinCrime
Description:
Join Zepz: Breaking Down Borders, Together




Our Meaningful Mission

At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates. Our purpose is deeply personal, we provide a lifeline and deliver opportunities to cross-border communities that need it most through cutting edge finance and tech.Zepz is the power behind WorldRemit and Sendwave, driven by the mission to celebrate the incredible impact migrants have, both at home and abroad. We're not just moving money; we're building a world that truly recognizes and supports global connections.




Who You'll Be Joining

We look for mission-driven builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment connected to a true purpose. We’re an always developing team of experts that enjoy problem solving and bring clarity to tough challenges. At Zepz, we are Relentless Learners, always seeking feedback, and Responsible Owners, treating company resources like your own. We depend on Transparent Communicators who keep the team aligned through open, honest talk.




Our Core Commitments — What We Live By

Our vibrant and truly diverse culture is built on three core commitments, that guide how we work and interact:

Integrity: We always do the right thing. It’s simple, but it’s the foundation of everything we build for our customers and each other.
Outcomes: We work for our customers. Their success and prosperity are the results we focus on delivering.
Velocity: We are fast! We maintain high energy levels and make smart decisions quickly, keeping us nimble and ahead of the curve.




Perks of Joining Our Team

We believe in empowering colleagues because we genuinely trust our team. Our culture is founded on this high trust, which naturally encourages the high ownership that drives us to meet our shared high expectations and deliver high performance. While we have all the tools to work remotely, we value the purpose and benefits of in-person connections so we expect our teams to come to the office on a regular basis, and therefore be within a comfortable commutable distance from our London office. Alongside a great office environment, think unlimited annual leave , great healthcare benefits, and employee discounts. We want you to thrive and focus entirely on making your biggest impact! In turn, we expect you to bring high ownership and commitment to your work. This is a place where we value trust and high performance, and we'll provide the environment and support needed for you to excel.




About the role

Joining Zepz as a Financial Crime Data Analyst, you will play a critical role in detecting, investigating, and preventing illicit financial activity across our global operations. You will leverage large datasets, analyze transactional patterns, and manage system alerts to safeguard the platform. This role involves developing robust SQL-based models, creating actionable dashboards (Mode/Databricks) to visualize financial crime risks, and collaborating closely with the Financial Crime Product and Compliance teams to enhance controls, reduce false positives, and ensure adherence to global regulatory standards.




Reporting to Director of Product (Fincrime) you will:

Drive strategic decision-making by collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to prioritize business requirements and translate them into actionable dashboards and data-driven insights.
Own and manage capacity planning for Financial Crime Operations, including the creation, reporting, and ongoing analysis of capacity plans versus actuals.
Proactively identify and implement data-led improvements across the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) domain, including transaction monitoring and customer risk rating, by setting targets, assessing performance, and modelling various scenarios.
Communicate complex findings effectively by presenting structured, data-driven results to non-technical business leaders, simplifying technical concepts for clear decision-making.
Demonstrate holistic problem-solving by connecting disparate data sources to uncover underlying business questions and deliver comprehensive solutions.
Exhibit a strong passion for learning and the ability to rapidly adopt new business concepts, analytical techniques, and technologies.
Be an independent, curious, and proactive self-starter who takes initiative to drive projects forward.




What you bring to the table

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, or a related field;
4+ years experience in data analysis, analytics engineering, and/or data science roles, building data modeling workflows (using dbt, for example, or other data platform tooling) and analyzing large datasets to solve problems;
Expert SQL skills; proficiency in Python preferable;
Strong statistical knowledge;
Expertise in visualization and surfacing insights using a BI platform (e.g. Mode, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, etc.);
Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with great attention to detail;
Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact;
Comfortable collaborating across functions to identify data analytics problems and execute solutions with technical rigor and thoughtful analysis.




If you want to join us in our journey to help break barriers in financial access and improve lives globally, there's no better place or time to join.




Our global team of 800+ people is spread across six continents. We aspire to hire the best mix of people from former Olympians to YouTube influencers and we speak over twenty languages. This incredible diversity isn't a bonus; it's the engine that lets us serve the world.




Ready to Apply? Let’s Go.

Title: Senior Reporting Analyst
Description:
Why This Role Matters

This is a pivotal role supporting our O+O (Online & Offline) strategy, to deliver trusted performance intelligence that enables better decision-making across our business. As a Senior Reporting Analyst, you will transform complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive the adoption of data driven activity and support profitable customer and commercial growth. Working closely with business stakeholders, analytics teams and decision-makers across multiple functions, you will provide reporting, analysis and performance recommendations that influence strategic priorities and business outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity to shape how data is used to unlock value, improve performance and accelerate growth in a fast-paced international retail environment, that shapes how millions of customers experience our brands so we can put a smile on our customers’ faces today and tomorrow.

What You’ll Be Doing


Create and maintain trusted reporting and performance dashboards that provide a clear, consistent view of customer, commercial and business performance across the organisation.
Analyse complex datasets to uncover trends, opportunities and risks, translating insight into clear recommendations that support better business decisions.
Partner with stakeholders across Group and Business Units to define, measure and align key performance indicators, ensuring performance is understood and acted upon consistently.
Drive the adoption of self-service reporting and analytics tools, enabling teams to independently access reliable insights and make data-led decisions with confidence.
Develop innovative reporting solutions using automation, AI and advanced analytics techniques to improve efficiency, scalability and the speed of insight generation.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business challenges, identify information gaps and deliver reporting that supports customer and commercial growth.
Continuously enhance reporting capabilities, data quality and user experience to strengthen performance visibility and maximise business impact.


What You’ll Bring


Proven experience in data analytics, ideally within eCommerce, digital or retail environments, with a minimum of three years’ experience turning complex data into actionable business insights.
Advanced expertise in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), alongside strong SQL skills and experience developing scalable reporting solutions using Power BI, Looker and Excel.
A strong understanding of KPI governance, performance measurement frameworks and reporting standardisation within complex, multi-stakeholder organisations.
Commercially minded with the ability to identify trends, forecast performance and uncover opportunities that drive customer growth and business performance.
Excellent storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling insights tailored to different audiences.
Demonstrated experience influencing senior stakeholders, building strong relationships across functions and driving the adoption of data-led decision-making.
A proactive and curious mindset, with experience delivering reporting transformation, automation or analytics innovation initiatives that improve efficiency and business outcomes.


How You Will Make An Impact


Empower colleagues across the business with trusted, accessible insights that enable faster, more confident decision-making and improve understanding of performance.
Drive a culture of data-led decision-making by increasing trust in reporting, strengthening KPI alignment and helping teams focus on what matters most.
Identify emerging opportunities and risks early, enabling the business to take proactive action that improves customer, commercial and operational outcomes.
Champion innovation by identifying new ways to leverage automation, analytics and AI to improve insight generation, efficiency and scalability.
Build strong relationships across functions, bringing people together around a shared understanding of performance and creating alignment behind key business priorities.
Simplify complexity by turning data challenges into practical solutions that improve reporting quality, accelerate decision-making and enhance organisational effectiveness.
Contribute to profitable growth by ensuring customer and commercial intelligence is translated into meaningful actions that deliver measurable business value.

You may not have heard of us, but you’ll know our brands! AS Watson is the world’s largest international health and beauty retailer, with over 17,000 stores across 31 markets serving over 5.3 billion customers each year.

From Superdrug, Kruidvat and Watsons to Marionnaud, The Perfume Shop and many more, our brands are loved by customers around the world. Behind them are passionate people who are encouraged to innovate, collaborate and grow.

Title: Actuarial Data Analyst
Description:
Job Role: Actuarial Data Analyst

Salary: £45,000 - £55,000 + 6% performance bonus

Working Location: Milton Keynes/London, Hybrid working, 2 days in office

Employment Type: Full Time, Permanent

Closing Date: 23rd August 2026

Job Summary

We’re looking for a skilled Actuarial Data Analyst with an eye for detail and a passion for turning complex insurance data into clear, actionable insights. Joining our Actuarial Analytics and Business Insights team, you’ll play a key role in building, maintaining, and improving our Power BI reports, helping the business make confident decisions. This is a great opportunity for someone with insurance industry experience to make a real impact, while also developing their skills in tools like Power Query and Snowflake, with plenty of room for career growth.

What You’ll Be Doing


Maintaining and enhancing our Power BI reports to ensure accuracy and consistency
Supporting the comparison of Power BI and legacy Tableau reports for ongoing projects
Running and updating monthly reporting cycles
Building new Power BI reports to meet business needs
Using Power Query to optimise reports (where experience allows)
Working with stakeholders to understand data requirements and provide clear, meaningful analysis
Helping with the transition of data systems from SQL/Access to Snowflake
Collaborating with actuarial, data, and business teams to deliver insight


What We’re Looking For


Proven experience working with Power BI in a data or MI analyst role
Insurance industry knowledge (essential) — general insurance preferred, with actuarial experience a plus
Strong skills in SQL and DAX, with Power Query experience highly desirable
Comfortable with data analysis, validation, and producing clear visualisations
Ability to work independently and meet deadlines while collaborating with multiple teams
Strong communication skills to explain data findings to technical and non-technical audiences
Bonus points for Snowflake or data migration project experience
Degree in a maths, statistics, or similar numerate discipline


What We Offer

Our benefits package includes:


27 days annual leave + bank holidays
holiday purchase scheme
enhanced pension scheme (up to 10.5%)
life assurance
subsidised private medical insurance
employee discounts platform
two days volunteer leave
enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption leave and pay for all new parents
many more!


Who We Are

At NHBC, we pride ourselves on being truly unique. No other organisation in our sector matches the range of services and scale we provide. As the market leader, we are recognised as the go-to for new home warranties and insurance. Our team is united by a core purpose: to raise the standards of house building and protect homeowners.

Why you should join us

As a modern, family-friendly employer, we’re in a phase of rapid growth, embracing technology, data and new ways of working. We’re seeking passionate, skilled and driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey.

Once onboard, you’ll have access to fantastic opportunities for personal and career growth. You’ll receive thorough training, continuous development and the chance to earn recognised qualifications and professional memberships to support your journey.

We support flexible working and encourage our colleagues to find a balance that suits them. While we may not be able to accommodate every request, we’re always happy to have a conversation about flexible working arrangements.

Our inclusive culture

We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive culture where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. We firmly believe in the right of all our employees and customers to be treated fairly, with dignity and respect, and free from discrimination. Our active employee networks support colleagues and their allies, providing safe spaces for open conversations and idea-sharing.

We are a Disability Confident organisation committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. Our first step is to review applications to ensure candidates meet the essential criteria for the role. We assess skills, experience, and potential objectively, and provide support or reasonable adjustments where needed. Candidates who meet the criteria will progress to the next stage.

Title: Expression of Interest - YouTube Data Analyst
Description:
LADbible Group is one of the world’s most engaged digital entertainment businesses, reaching over a billion people globally and amassing more than 13.9 billion social views each month. With a powerhouse portfolio across general lifestyle, entertainment, sport, gaming, and tech, our brands: - including LADbible, UNILAD, GAMINGbible, and UNILAD Tech, are some of the most recognised and culturally relevant on the internet.




YouTube is one of our biggest growth engines, home to some of the most distinctive channels, including LADbible Entertainment, LADbible Stories and SPORTbible. From working with the world’s biggest creators and A-list talent on hit formats like Snack Wars, to powerful storytelling through series such as Minutes With and Honesty Box, we’ve become one of the most exciting and influential players in the industry.




About the Role

Our YouTube team is growing, and we are on the proactive lookout for a Data Analyst. The Data Analyst produces insight that drives decisions across the YouTube team and informs the Originals commissioning pipeline.




What the opportunity looks like

Channel Performance - Analyse YouTube channel performance across watch time, CTR, audience retention, subscriber growth, CPMs, return viewers, and audience share to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
Dashboard Management - Build, maintain, and optimise live reporting dashboards using Looker Studio and BigQuery, ensuring stakeholders have access to accurate, actionable performance data.
External Intelligence - Conduct competitive and market intelligence using tools such as Tubular Labs, Social Blade, and platform analytics to benchmark performance and identify emerging category trends.
Format Growth and Analysis - Deliver audience, content format, and growth analysis to inform channel strategy, content investment decisions, and new channel or format opportunities.
Portfolio Growth Tracking - Monitor portfolio performance against targets, proactively flagging underperformance and providing data-driven recommendations to support business and commercial objectives.




Skills and experience we'd like you to have

Proven experience in data analytics or digital/media analytics, ideally within YouTube, social media, or digital publishing environments.
Experience analysing YouTube performance metrics, including watch time, audience retention, CTR, subscriber growth, RPM/CPM, and viewer behaviour.
Ability to interpret large datasets and translate findings into clear commercial recommendations.
Proficiency in BigQuery, SQL, Looker Studio, and data visualisation best practices.
Familiarity with competitive intelligence and social analytics tools such as Tubular Labs, Social Blade, or similar platforms.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to present insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.

At LADbible Group we've rolled out blended working which means the majority of departments across the business (including London, Manchester and International offices) work in the office 3 days per week.

LADbible Group is an equal opportunities employer. We are determined to create a diverse group at all levels of our company and we welcome all members of the community to apply for openings with us. As the leading social youth publisher, we have a powerful global platform to better represent our audience and enable those that do not have equal opportunities to have their voices heard. As a business, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce, in an environment where everyone feels comfortable to be themselves.

You'll work across functions to influence outcomes, manage key projects, and ensure controls are effective, scalable, and future-ready.

Lead and manage key projects enhancing controls through data, automation, and AI
Engage and influence a broad range of global stakeholders across Risk, Audit, and Technology

Apply advanced data analytics to evaluate control performance and identify emerging risks

Strong technical expertise in data analytics, automation, and AI, including advanced Python skills

Strong understanding of risk & controls frameworks, ideally within a regulated environment
Experience developing analytical and automation solutions that drive measurable outcomes

Experience in managing multiple stakeholders, priorities, and competing demands

Experience working in a regulated environment would be advantageous

Great compensation package and discretionary bonus plan

Title: Category Marketing Manager
Description:
Category Marketing Manager - Global-FMCG Business - Home/Hybrid Working - Office Location in Nottingham - Competitive Salary, Bonus + Benefits




Are you passionate about turning shopper insight into commercial growth?




We're partnering with a leading FMCG business looking to appoint an experienced Category Marketing Manager to join their growing commercial team.




This is an exciting opportunity to influence category strategy across major UK retail and ecommerce customers, working at the intersection of Sales, Marketing and Category. You'll use consumer and shopper insight to shape recommendations, support customer relationships and help drive sustainable growth across a well-known portfolio of brands.




Reporting into the Head of Category, you'll play a key role in developing category strategies that deliver value for both customers and the business. Working closely with Sales, Brand Marketing, Insights and NPD teams, you'll translate market trends and shopper behaviour into actionable recommendations that influence ranging, merchandising, promotions and new product development.




What you will be doing?




Develop category growth strategies across key retail customers.
Analyse market, consumer and shopper data to identify commercial opportunities.
Build compelling category reviews and customer presentations using insight-led recommendations.
Support National Account Managers during customer meetings with category expertise.
Deliver category vision projects that support long-term business growth.
Work closely with Brand and Marketing teams to align category strategies with brand plans.
Provide recommendations around pricing, promotions, assortment and shelf optimisation.
Monitor competitor activity, emerging trends and retailer performance.
Support NPD projects by identifying whitespace opportunities and validating concepts through insight.
Track category performance and provide regular reporting to internal stakeholders.
Become the internal expert on shopper behaviour and market dynamics.




What you will have?




2-5 years Category Management experience within the FMCG industry.
Strong understanding of UK grocery retail channels.
Understanding of Ecommerce platforms would be advantageous.
Experience of using market data (especially Nielsen/IRI/Kantar).
Experience working with major grocery retailers whether in a category or sales focused role.
Strategic thinker with ability to analyse large data sets.
A proactive approach with a passion for understanding consumers and shoppers.




What's on Offer?

Competitive salary.
Annual bonus.
Hybrid working options and a flexible, autonomous working culture.
Enhanced pension scheme and holiday allowance.
Private healthcare.
Ongoing learning and development.
Career progression within a growing FMCG business.




Apply for more information on this exciting Category Marketing Manager role.

Title: Senior Solutions Analyst - Decisioning
Description:
Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We help to redefine lending practices, uncover and prevent fraud, simplify healthcare, create marketing solutions, and gain deeper insights into the automotive market, all using our unique combination of data, analytics and software. We also assist millions of people to realize their financial goals and help them save time and money.

We invest in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. As a FTSE 100 Index company listed on the London Stock Exchange (EXPN), we have a team of 22,500 people across 32 countries. Our corporate headquarters are in Dublin, Ireland. Learn more at experianplc.com.

Internal Grade E/EB9

Job Description

Experian's Consumer Information Services, Analytics, Decisioning Software, and Identity and Fraud division are looking for a Senior Solutions Analyst. You will be responsible for the effective engineering of capability within the Decisioning Solutions content reuse, off-the-shelf, and prefabricated solution (PCCA) space, working closely with other engineering team members in the team, and across wider build and development functions.

Senior Solutions Analysts are pivotal in the design, maintenance and execution of the product backlog and concurrently driving complexity out of client System Integration. Decisioning Engineering's goal, and the role every Senior Solutions Analyst must play is transforming time and cost to deliver.

This is a Hybrid, Nottingham based role (40% in the office) reporting to the Senior Client Delivery Manager

Key Responsibilities

Working within Decisioning Solutions (DS) Engineering you will be a senior member of one of our regional engineering teams, delivering high quality proof-of-concept, template, and accelerator content that will be used by our System Integration Teams to deliver effective integrated Client Solutions.


Responsible for driving the ease of integration across the System Integration Teams to reduce complexity, time to deliver, cost and risk whilst improving customer satisfaction. Working with the Global Engineering teams (who build the core products) and by engineering effective and efficient localised solutions.
Focus on cloud cost optimisation to ensure best practice is adopted across all cloud based client system integrations, driving down cost to serve.
Offer expert consultancy for Pre-Sales, System Integration Teams, Service Support and Risk Management.
You will lead junior members of our delivery "fireteams", steering analysts, project managers, implementers, developers and testers maximising the most appropriate delivery model for the work (Waterfall, Agile etc).
Lead deliveries ensuring that they meet agreed timelines (proactively managing any issue and risks that arise) and cost.
You will build great relationships while consulting with our Global Engineering (ESS), Product Management, Customer Value Office, Go-to-Market (GTM), Product Capability, Systems Integration, Security, Audit and Risk teams to drive efficient / effective processes and outcomes.
You will occasionally be responsibility for maintaining good relationships with our competitors, partners, clients to enable new capability to be engineered effectively.


Qualifications


Expert understanding of Decisioning Solution products and how they can be integrated and deployed to clients.
Experience leading development, build, technical authorship, project management and consultative/delivery teams in a financial services environment.
Understanding of PowerCurve
Project Management experience in a client facing environment.
Demonstratable knowledge of waterfall and agile methodologies and best practice and experience in a scaled agile delivery environment
Commercial acumen in accordance with contracted commitments.
Experience balancing competing projects and providing thought leadership in areas that may be new to stakeholders.
Experience leading and coaching multi-disciplinary teams, developing team members, and supporting them to grow.


Additional Information

Benefits include:-


Great compensation package and discretionary bonus plan
Core benefits include pension, bupa healthcare, sharesave scheme and more!
25 days annual leave with 8 bank holidays and 3 volunteering days. You can also purchase additional annual leave.

Title: Pricing Manager
Description:
Lawfront provides legal services to individuals and businesses through leading regional law firms - Brachers,Farleys, Fisher Jones Greenwood, Field Seymour Parkes, Nelsons, Slater Heelis and Trethowans

The Pricing Manager at Lawfront will be responsible for developing and implementing pricing strategies across the group to maximize profitability and growth. This role involves analysing market trends, competitor pricing, and customer behaviour to set competitive prices for Lawfront's services.

The Pricing Manager will work closely with the Pricing Champion (managing partner of one of our firms), finance, marketing, and regional management to put in place pricing strategies and tactics in line with the company's overall business objectives.

Additionally, the Pricing Manager will support the development of a strong pricing culture within the firms, encouraging confident pricing behaviour among fee earners.

Key Responsibilities


Develop and maintain a group-wide overview of hourly and menu pricing in each firm.
Conduct pricing and profitability analysis and provide recommendations to senior management.
Analyse market trends, competitor pricing, and customer behaviour to set competitive prices.
Monitor and adjust pricing strategies based on market conditions and business needs.
Develop pricing models and tools to support decision-making.
Ensure compliance with pricing policies and regulations.
Organise external pricing training and provide direct support to fee earning teams on pricing strategies and tools.
Encourage strong pricing behaviour among fee earners, mentor, and offer training.
Communicate the benefits of confident pricing and share best practices.
Provide advice on pricing strategy and support management in pricing decisions.


What We Are Looking For?

Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
Professional certification in pricing or related field is a plus.


Skills, Knowledge And Experience


Experience in services pricing, specific exposure to legal services or other professional services environment is a plus.
Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Experience with pricing software and tools.
Knowledge of market research and data analysis techniques.
Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
Strong organizational and time management skills.


Personal attributes

Changee Agility: Availability, aptitude, and appetite to lead and influence others in line with company messaging.

Adaptability: Displays a pro-active approach and the ability to think on their feet

Self-Awareness: Aware of their impact on others, ability to self-regulate when under pressure and sense of self assurance and confidence, that gives others certainty.

Emotional Intelligence: Demonstrates the ability to support others to be at their best, understands what makes each person unique and adjust style accordingly.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation: Constantly curious looking for ways to optimise performance, impact, and efficiency. Seeks opportunities to innovate in small and large ways and support this in others.

Trust and Psychological Safety: Creates a culture of high trust where people feel they can speak up without judgment or blame. Each member of the Department feels psychologically safe and able to reach out if support is required.

Apply now or get in touch for a confidential discussion. Contact Suzanne James at Lawfront - Suzanne.james@lawfront.com

You will have experience in working in clinical trials and be familiar with clinical trial databases, the process of data cleaning and have some experience of Case Report Form design, quality management systems and the writing of system or process documentation.

This post is an exciting opportunity to join the Nottingham Clinical Trials Unit (NCTU) based in the beautiful University of Nottingham’s University Park campus.

In addition, we conduct methodological work to improve the efficiency and quality of trial design, conduct, analysis and reporting. NCTU has close links with NHS Trusts, universities and industry partners.

Please visit www.nctu.ac.uk for further details.

A friendly, diverse, and supportive working environment.
Agile working: This role can either be fully office-based or open to a hybrid working model with a blended approach of home and office working. Typically, you will work a minimum of 2-3 days (pro-rata) per week on campus.
Generous holiday entitlement of 27 days (pro rata) plus standard bank holidays and five university closure days including closure between Christmas and New Year.
Commitment to staff development through the provision of training, continued support, and career progression opportunities.

Well-established in the Luxury Goods, Perfumes & Cosmetics, Pharmaceuticals, Wines & Spirits and Confectionery & Specialties markets, we are broadening our international presence by integrating locally-active sites that share our DNA. Together, we are committed to supporting our customers by providing them with high-performance, sustainable services in the world of cases, labels, boxes and point-of-sale displays.

With more than 50 years of know-how, we create customized, innovative solutions that are always responsive to environmental and social issues. We employ more than 4,000 people across 41 human-scale sites, who contribute to generate sales of 800 millions euros.

Authentic, sharing common values, we recruit individuals who are looking for a personal and collective adventure.

Finance Business Partner

Responsibilities

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

The Finance Business Partner (industrial controller) supports site Directors in strategic and operational decision-making. They provide up-to-date and reliable information through industrial and commercial performance management tools. Working closely with operational teams, the industrial controller delivers analysis of the value chain with the objective of continuously improving site profitability.

Key Responsibilities


Budget Management
Rolling Forecast
Prepare business forecasts in line with Group and site strategy
Analyse costs, cost center structures, financial results, and performance trends
Update hourly rates and costing parameters
Actual Performance Analysis
Identify and explain significant variances between actual performance and forecasts using predefined bridge analyses
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability
Summarise, challenge assumptions where appropriate, and communicate insights to management
Industrial Controlling
Develop and implement profitability indicators and conduct weekly performance reviews with Operations teams
Monitor industrial performance through Group KPIs and site-specific indicators
Ensure proper application of Group and site procedures and standards
Support commercial teams in tender processes and assist operational managers in business decision-making
Capital Expenditure & Investment Management
Participate in investment projects from the earliest stages
Prepare decision-support documentation, including technology/machine selection analyses and ROI assessments
Monitor investment performance and present post-implementation reviews ("post-mortem" analyses)
Group Projects
Actively contribute to the implementation of the new ERP system
Participate in other Group-wide projects as required


Requirements

JOB REQUIREMENTS

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Education

Degree in Accounting, Finance or Business-related subject (Desirable)

Professional Experience

Minimum 5 years of experience in Controlling, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), or Finance Business Partnering roles

Proven experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment

Experience supporting operational management and working closely with plant/site leadership teams

Strong knowledge of standard costing, margin analysis, cost accounting and manufacturing performance indicators

Experience in budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis

Technical Skills

Previous experience within an international group environment is preferred

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial modelling

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Good understanding of industrial KPIs, productivity drivers and profitability analysis

Experience with Business Intelligence and reporting tools (Power BI) is an advantage

Ability to translate complex financial information into actionable business recommendations

PERSONAL COMPETENCIES

Strong business partnering mindset

Ability to challenge

Ability to work autonomously while managing multiple priorities

Strong interpersonal skills and ability to influence cross-functional teams

Results-oriented and proactive

Travel Requirements

Regular travel within the United Kingdom to support across our UK Plants

LANGUAGES

Fluent English (written and spoken).

Additional European languages would be considered an advantage.

Benefits

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION/BENEFITS


Competitive Salary
Hybrid

Finance Business Partner

Responsibilities

 JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

The Finance Business Partner (industrial controller) supports site Directors in strategic and operational decision-making. Working closely with operational teams, the industrial controller delivers analysis of the value chain with the objective of continuously improving site profitability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Budget Management
  • Rolling Forecast
  • Prepare business forecasts in line with Group and site strategy
  • Analyse costs, cost center structures, financial results, and performance trends
  • Update hourly rates and costing parameters
  • Actual Performance Analysis
  • Identify and explain significant variances between actual performance and forecasts using predefined bridge analyses
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability
  • Summarise, challenge assumptions where appropriate, and communicate insights to management
  • Industrial Controlling
  • Develop and implement profitability indicators and conduct weekly performance reviews with Operations teams
  • Monitor industrial performance through Group KPIs and site-specific indicators
  • Ensure proper application of Group and site procedures and standards
  • Support commercial teams in tender processes and assist operational managers in business decision-making
  • Capital Expenditure & Investment Management
  • Participate in investment projects from the earliest stages
  • Prepare decision-support documentation, including technology/machine selection analyses and ROI assessments
  • Monitor investment performance and present post-implementation reviews ("post-mortem" analyses)
  • Group Projects
  • Actively contribute to the implementation of the new ERP system
  • Participate in other Group-wide projects as required

Requirements

 JOB REQUIREMENTS

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Education

Degree in Accounting, Finance or Business-related subject (Desirable)

Professional Experience

Minimum 5 years of experience in Controlling, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), or Finance Business Partnering roles

Proven experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment

Experience supporting operational management and working closely with plant/site leadership teams

Strong knowledge of standard costing, margin analysis, cost accounting and manufacturing performance indicators

Experience in budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis

Technical Skills

Previous experience within an international group environment is preferred

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial modelling

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Good understanding of industrial KPIs, productivity drivers and profitability analysis

Experience with Business Intelligence and reporting tools (Power BI) is an advantage

Ability to translate complex financial information into actionable business recommendations

PERSONAL COMPETENCIES

Strong business partnering mindset

Ability to challenge

Ability to work autonomously while managing multiple priorities

Strong interpersonal skills and ability to influence cross-functional teams

Results-oriented and proactive

Travel Requirements

Regular travel within the United Kingdom to support across our UK Plants

LANGUAGES

Fluent English (written and spoken).

Additional European languages would be considered an advantage.

Benefits

 ADDITIONAL INFORMATION/BENEFITS

  • Competitive Salary
  • Hybrid
  • 35 days holiday (including bank holidays)
  • Opportunity to work out of a newly renovated, modern working environment.
  • The stability and resources of a highly successful international parent group

Title: Business Reporting Accountant
Description:
About The Job

Games Workshop is looking for a Business Reporting Accountant. We’re looking for someone with an inquisitive mindset who can thrive in a business that values honesty and collaboration.

This is a varied position where you’ll play a critical role in supporting effective decision-making through producing high-quality financial performance reporting across the business, including global sales by territory and channel and cost centre reporting. With a questioning mindset and natural ability to foster strong working relationships, you’ll provide insight and rationale into trends and variances against costs and historical performance.

You’ll always maintain the highest standards, and, coupled with your technical ability, this will ensure you produce accurate and insightful reports for our managers, enabling them to track performance and identify key issues. This role involves working across all areas of Games Workshop and we’re looking for someone who uses their commercial acumen to understand our business. You’ll support annual forecasting activities and the financial appraisal of new stores, and monitor ongoing capital investment against departmental plans.

We’re looking for someone confident in producing concise, accurate monthly reports for our managers, digging beneath the data to provide insight when sharing the numbers. You’ll help them to understand and interpret reports, and pose challenges to enable them to make the best decisions for Games Workshop.

Ideally, you’ll be a qualified accountant, proficient in Microsoft Excel and in using financial reporting systems, who can maintain clear and reliable processes. If you’re excited to be part of a Finance team that supports the business to implement robust processes and plan with confidence, we want to hear from you

Working at Games Workshop

At Games Workshop we are looking for people who will do their best to understand the needs of the company and to put those needs first when they are at work. Because of this we believe that what you are like, hence the attitude you show to work and the way you choose to behave is even more important than your skills and experience.

The Warhammer World site is based just outside of Nottingham city centre and benefits from a nearby tram stop and free onsite car parking.

In return for your hard work, you will receive 33 days holiday per year (including public holidays), matching contributory pension scheme up to 7.5%, profit share bonus (subject to GW meeting profit targets) and option to join our Share Save scheme. Oh and let’s not forget, a staff discount of between 25% and 50% on our products!

Other Essential Information

Location: This position is granted on a hybrid working basis where you will be expected to work out of our head office in Lenton, twice a week

Closing date for applications is midnight, UK time, Sunday 23rd August 2026

How to Apply

To apply, please send us a letter or a video telling us why you want this job. This is a great opportunity for you to let us know that you understand what we are looking for.

Please include an up-to-date CV to support your application. When you’re ready, please click apply, below.
